title: Breaking the Token Ceiling: Distilling Smaller, Stronger Byte Models
summary: Small models are made more capable through distillation from a larger one that shares their tokenization scheme. However, do distilled byte and token models behave similarly in terms of scaling trends as compute and data increases? To enable this comparison, we introduce two variants to efficiently convert token logits to Byte Logits: 1) approximate: Marginalize-It, and 2) exact: End-Of-Token. We then present the first large scale study of overtraining decoder-only dense transformer models varying two dimensions simultaneously: the tokenization scheme (Tokens, Bytes, Bytes w/ eot) and the training objective (Distillation vs. Cross-Entropy), sweeping layer-parameter-matched models with roughly 1 billion parameters up to 1 trillion bytes of data. Across eight benchmarks spanning three categories: Multiple Choice QA, Language Generation, and Machine Translation, we find that Token-1B models outperform byte models (End-Of-Token-1B and Bytes-1B) in the low-FLOP regime but eventually plateau; byte models start worse yet surpass Token-1B models with more compute, reaching a higher downstream task performance ceiling. Extrapolating the average top-1 error vs. validation BPB scaling laws predicts that, asymptotically, distilled End-Of-Token-1B outperforms distilled Token-1B by up to 4%. They are also far more data efficient, matching the performance of distilled Token-1B using only one-sixth of the training data. Moreover, by operating over a small vocabulary of 256 bytes instead of on the order of 100K tokens, they circumvent the need for top-k truncation during logit dumping, while also reducing logit storage costs to roughly one-fifth. Finally, our downstream performance scaling laws predict that our distilled End-Of-Token-1B models asymptotically surpass the Llama 3.2-1B, Gemma-3-1B-pt, and Gemma 2B models on averaged downstream tasks by up to 6.5%, 8.1%, and 2.1%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文首次大规模对比了分词方案（Tokens、Bytes、Bytes w/ eot）与训练目标（蒸馏 vs. 交叉熵）对十亿参数级解码器模型缩放趋势的影响，发现字节模型虽在低 FLOP 下落后，却随计算量增加反超 Token 模型并获得更高下游性能上限，蒸馏的 End-Of-Token-1B  asymptotically 领先蒸馏 Token-1B 达 4%，且数据效率高六倍。
AI.motivation: 小模型常通过与大模型蒸馏（共享分词方案）来增强能力，但字节模型与 token 蒸馏模型在计算与数据增长下的缩放趋势是否一致尚不清楚。为支持这一对比，需要解决 token logits 到 byte logits 的高效转换问题，并系统研究分词方案与训练目标的交互作用。
AI.method: 引入两种 token logits 转 byte logits 的变体：1) 近似方法 Marginalize-It；2) 精确方法 End-Of-Token。开展首次大规模研究，同时变化两个维度：分词方案（Tokens、Bytes、Bytes w/ eot）与训练目标（蒸馏 vs. 交叉熵），扫描约 10 亿参数的层-参数匹配模型，数据量最高达 1 万亿字节，覆盖 8 个基准、3 类任务（多项选择 QA、语言生成、机器翻译）。
AI.result: 在低 FLOP 区间，Token-1B 模型优于字节模型（End-Of-Token-1B 与 Bytes-1B），但随后趋于饱和；字节模型起始较差，却随计算量增加反超 Token-1B，达到更高的下游性能上限。外推 top-1 误差 vs. 验证 BPB 缩放律预测：渐近地，蒸馏 End-Of-Token-1B 比蒸馏 Token-1B 高至多 4%；且两者数据效率更高，仅需 1/6 训练数据即可匹配蒸馏 Token-1B。此外，基于 256 字节小词表避免了 logit dump 时的 top-k 截断，并将 logit 存储成本降至约 1/5。下游缩放律还预测蒸馏 End-Of-Token-1B 在平均下游任务上渐近超过 Llama 3.2-1B、Gemma-3-1B-pt 与 Gemma 2B 分别达 6.5%、8.1%、2.1%。
AI.conclusion: 字节级蒸馏模型在缩放趋势上展现出更优的渐近性能上限与数据效率，具备绕过 top-k 截断、降低 logit 存储成本等实用性优势，并在外推预测中超越多个同规模开源模型，表明字节分词结合蒸馏是提升小模型能力的有效方向。

title: ESTS at WMT26: Routing-Informed Expert Pruning for Model Compression
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the Eleventh Conference on Machine Translation (WMT 2026)
summary: We describe six submissions under the team name ESTS to the unconstrained WMT26 Model Compression Shared Task for English--Simplified Chinese and English--Egyptian Arabic. We submit three compression operating points per translation direction, all derived from GPT-OSS-20B. We use task-specific routing mass to rank experts and cross-lingual routing divergence to allocate retained capacity across layers, then physically remove low-importance experts. The resulting specialists are recovery-tuned on GPT-5.1-generated synthetic translation data and further compressed by applying MXFP4 quantization to the retained expert projection weights. We additionally implement a robust inference system for the instruction-conditioned WMT26 setting, including category inference, output validation, retries, segmented fallback, and source-owned JSON reconstruction. Across our six submissions, parameter counts range from 4.186B to 7.770B and packed artifact sizes from 4.55 to 6.33~GiB. Internal xCOMET-XL evaluation using GPT-5.1 pseudo-references provides an internal comparison across the submitted compression operating points.

AI.tldr: EATS 团队向 WMT26 无约束模型压缩共享任务提交了英→简中和英→埃及阿拉伯语共六个压缩模型，均基于 GPT-OSS-20B，通过专家剪枝、恢复微调和 MXFP4 量化实现压缩。
AI.motivation: 面向 WMT26 无约束模型压缩共享任务，在多语言翻译场景下降低大模型参数量与存储占用，同时尽量维持翻译质量，并适配带指令条件的推理设置。
AI.method: 以 GPT-OSS-20B 为基座，每个翻译方向给出三个压缩工作点。先用任务特定路由质量对专家排序，并用跨语言路由散度在层间分配保留容量，再物理移除低重要度专家；随后在 GPT-5.1 生成的合成翻译数据上对专家模型进行恢复微调，并对保留的专家投影权重施加 MXFP4 量化。此外设计了稳健推理系统，包括类别推断、输出校验、重试、分段回退和源端 JSON 重建。
AI.result: 六个提交的参数量介于 4.186B 至 7.770B，打包产物大小介于 4.55 至 6.33 GiB。使用 GPT-5.1 伪参考进行内部 xCOMET-XL 评估，得到各压缩工作点的内部比较结果。
AI.conclusion: 结合路由驱动的专家剪枝、合成数据恢复微调与 MXFP4 量化，可在显著压缩参数与存储的同时覆盖多翻译方向，并配合稳健推理流程满足指令条件化评测需求。

title: Moonworks Lunara: Modeling Artistic Intelligence
summary: We formulate \emph{Artistic Intelligence} as exploration driven world realization, leaving space for creative possibility while preserving the semantic, artistic, and compositional structure that must remain true. Moonworks Lunara, a text-to-image model, implements this framework with a novel Diffusion Mixture Transformer architecture. A new training algorithm iteratively evolves the data distribution through informative sample acquisition and targeted injection of human-created art. We benchmark Lunara against seven image-generation models, including FLUX.2-Klein-4B, Qwen-Image (20B), and GPT-Image-1-Mini. With GPT-5.6 Sol as evaluator, Lunara ranks first in \emph{Aesthetic Quality (8.473 vs. 8.457 GPT-Image-1-mini)}, second in \emph{Emotional Resonance}, and remains competitive in \emph{Content Integrity}. A blind human evaluation over the same evaluation set corroborates the automated metrics, ranking Lunara first. It also stays among the strongest models under conventional measures including CLIPScore and LAION Aesthetic Predictor. On GenEval, Lunara achieves competitive performance against a broader set of 16 models, including GPT Image 2 and Seedream 4.0. These results place Lunara at the frontier with Artistic Intelligence while maintaining a sub-10B active-parameter footprint and sub-10-second inference latency. Lunara advances the general visual intelligence frontier by shifting the question from whether models can get images right to how deeply they can interpret meaning and realize it as imaginative, expressive worlds.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"艺术智能"（Artistic Intelligence）框架，将其定义为以探索驱动的世界实现，并落地为文本到图像模型 Moonworks Lunara，在多项人类与自动评测中达到领先水平，同时保持低于10B激活参数与低于10秒推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成研究多聚焦于"模型能否把图像画对"（语义与结构正确性），而忽视了创造性可能、情感共鸣与艺术表达深度。作者希望将问题从准确性转向模型能否深度解读含义，并将其实现为富有想象力与表现力的世界。
AI.method: 提出"艺术智能"作为探索驱动的世界实现框架，在保留必须为真的语义、艺术与构图结构的同时留出创造性空间；实现为文本到图像模型 Moonworks Lunara，采用新颖的 Diffusion Mixture Transformer 架构，并配合新训练算法——通过信息量采样获取与定向注入人类创作艺术，迭代演化数据分布。
AI.result: 与包括 FLUX.2-Klein-4B、Qwen-Image (20B)、GPT-Image-1-Mini 在内的七个图像生成模型对比，以 GPT-5.6 Sol 为评测者，Lunara 在美学质量上排名第一（8.473 vs. 8.457），情感共鸣排名第二，内容完整性具竞争力；同评测集上的盲测人工评估结果与自动指标一致，Lunara 排名第一。在 CLIPScore 与 LAION Aesthetic Predictor 等常规指标上亦属最强之列；在 GenEval 上与包含 GPT Image 2、Seedream 4.0 在内的16个模型相比表现具竞争力。模型保持低于10B的激活参数量与低于10秒的推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: Lunara 以艺术智能跻身生成模型前沿，同时维持高效的参数与延迟特性；其意义在于推动通用视觉智能前沿，将核心问题从"模型能否画对图像"转变为"模型能否深度解读含义并实现为富有想象力与表现力的世界"。

title: I Am No One: Style-Aware Paraphrasing for Text Anonymization
comment: Accepted at Interspeech 2026
summary: Authorship attribution models can re-identify users from seemingly anonymized text by exploiting stable stylistic fingerprints, even after explicit identifiers are removed, posing a growing privacy risk for text publishing and analytics. This risk extends to speech-derived text such as ASR transcripts of meetings and call-center conversations, where stylometric leakage can persist even after acoustic anonymization. Differential privacy-based anonymization often severely degrades text quality and utility. We propose a style-aware, prompt-driven anonymization approach that uses pretrained large language models to construct compact stylistic profiles from minimal samples and rewrite text to suppress identifiable style markers while preserving meaning. Across blog and review datasets, our approach reduces authorship attribution F1 by 60-70% while maintaining content quality and readability, substantially outperforming DP-based and non-DP baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种风格感知、提示驱动的大型语言模型匿名化方法：用极少样本构建紧凑风格画像并改写文本，在保留语义的同时抑制可识别风格标记。在博客与评论数据集上，作者归属F1下降60-70%，且内容质量与可读性基本保持，优于差分隐私及非差分隐私基线。
AI.motivation: 作者归属模型可利用稳定的文体指纹从看似匿名的文本中重新识别用户，即使显式标识符被移除，仍对文本发布与分析构成隐私风险。该风险还延伸到语音转写文本（如会议ASR转写、呼叫中心对话），即使经过声学匿名化，文体泄露仍可能存在。而基于差分隐私的匿名化往往严重损害文本质量与效用，因此需要一种兼顾隐私保护与文本可用性的匿名化方法。
AI.method: 提出风格感知、提示驱动（prompt-driven）的匿名化方法：利用预训练大型语言模型，从极少量样本中构建紧凑的风格画像（stylistic profile），并据此改写文本，以抑制可识别的风格标记，同时保留原文含义。
AI.result: 在博客和评论数据集上，该方法将作者归属F1降低60-70%，同时保持内容质量与可读性，显著优于基于差分隐私的基线和非差分隐私基线。
AI.conclusion: 提示驱动、风格感知的LLM改写能在显著削弱文体可识别性（隐私保护）的同时维持文本质量，是相较差分隐私方案更具实用性的文本匿名化路径。

title: UniMo: Unifying Human and Animal Motion Generation
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Posters
summary: The conditional generation of 3D motion has emerged as a key research topic due to its wide applicability across robotics, AR/VR, gaming, and content creation. However, extending recent advances in text-driven human motion generation to the animal domain remains challenging due to two core limitations. First, animals exhibit highly diverse skeletal topologies, unlike the standard human structure, making unified modeling across species difficult and leading to inefficient per-species models. Second, existing animal motion datasets suffer from limited scale and annotation quality, constraining model performance. To address these challenges, we propose UniMo, a unified point cloud-based motion generation framework that bypasses topological discrepancies by converting parametric skeletons into unparametric representations, further enhanced by dynamic sampling that allocates more points to active joints. Additionally, we present UniML3D, a large-scale motion-language dataset spanning both human and animal categories, containing 145,907 motion sequences and 433,388 captions-over 102x larger than existing animal datasets. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on UniML3D and three public benchmarks including HumanML3D, KIT-ML, and AnimalML3D, demonstrating the feasibility and effectiveness of unified human-animal motion generation. Website: https://steve-zeyu-zhang.github.io/UniMo.

AI.tldr: 提出UniMo——基于点云的统一人-动物运动生成框架，通过将参数化骨架转为非参数化点云表示绕过拓扑差异，并配合动态采样；同时构建大规模数据集UniML3D（145,907条运动、433,388条标注），在多个基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 将文本驱动的人体运动生成扩展到动物领域存在两大核心限制：一是动物骨骼拓扑高度多样，统一建模困难且导致按物种建模效率低下；二是现有动物运动数据集规模与标注质量受限，约束模型性能。
AI.method: 提出UniMo统一点云运动生成框架：将参数化骨架转换为非参数化表示以绕过拓扑差异，并引入动态采样，为活跃关节分配更多点；同时构建UniML3D大规模运动-语言数据集，覆盖人类与动物类别。
AI.result: UniML3D包含145,907条运动序列与433,388条文本描述，规模比现有动物数据集大102倍以上；方法在UniML3D及HumanML3D、KIT-ML、AnimalML3D三个公开基准上均达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 验证了统一的人-动物运动生成的可行性与有效性，为跨物种运动生成提供了可扩展的数据与建模范式。

title: VS-Splat: Voxel-Selective feed-forward Gaussian Splatting for end-to-end 3D object reconstruction from sparse-views
comment: Main paper: 10 pages, 4 figures. Appendix: 4 pages, 5 figures, Transaction of Multimedia
summary: Feed-forward Gaussian splatting models have demonstrated remarkable effectiveness in reconstructing three-dimensional (3D) objects from a few two-dimensional (2D) images, even if they are unseen. As existing methods typically predict Gaussian primitives uniformly across the 3D space, most primitives are placed in non-object regions. This may hinder the representation of fine object details. This paper proposes a Voxel-Selective Gaussian Splatting model (VS-Splat), a new end-to-endfeed-forward Gaussian splatting framework that predicts many primitives only within selected voxels that are likely to belong to an object, without 3D structural supervision. To achieve this, we propose a new learnable voxel selection approach that identifies object-centric voxels only with 2D rendering supervision. Our sparse-view rendering experiments with three benchmark datasets show that proposed VS-Splat outperforms several state-of-the-art methods. We further demonstrate its effectiveness as a backbone for an existing densification method and show that anoptional extension improves its robustness to inaccurate camera pose estimates.

AI.tldr: 提出VS-Splat，一种端到端前馈高斯泼溅框架，仅通过2D渲染监督学习体素选择，将高斯基元集中预测于可能属于物体的体素内，在三个基准数据集上优于多种SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈高斯泼溅方法在3D空间中均匀预测高斯基元，导致大量基元落在非物体区域，限制了精细物体细节的表示能力。
AI.method: 提出VS-Splat框架，包含一种可学习的体素选择方法，在无3D结构监督的条件下，仅凭2D渲染监督识别以物体为中心的体素，并在被选中的体素内密集预测高斯基元，实现端到端前馈重建。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集的稀疏视图渲染实验中，VS-Splat优于多个现有最先进方法；作为现有稠密化方法的骨干网络亦表现有效；可选扩展提升了其对不准确相机位姿估计的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: VS-Splat通过体素选择将高斯基元集中于物体区域，显著提升稀疏视图3D重建质量，具备良好的通用性与可扩展性。

title: EgoMaize: A First-Person Maize Instance Segmentation Benchmark under Severe Field Occlusion
comment: Accepted to BMVC 2026
summary: Close-range first-person field images are important for mobile maize phenotyping because many plant-level traits depend on in-canopy structures that are difficult to ob serve from overhead views. However, post-seedling maize fields create a difficult in stance segmentation setting: stems, leaves, tassels, and neighboring plants are elon gated, repetitive, and strongly occluded. We introduce EgoMaize, a compact benchmark for first-person maize instance segmentation, where the task is to predict ownership consistent plant masks and plant-owned stem/tassel cues from close-range field images with severe same-class overlap. Existing visible-only labels can fragment one physi cal plant into disconnected supervision, while full-amodal labels may require unverifi able completion behind neighboring plants or field objects. EgoMaize therefore uses an evidence-closed annotation workflow for occluded maize regions and assigns unreli able maize regions to ignore rather than background. Baseline results show that pre trained query-based grouping, boundary refinement, and high-resolution crop refine ment help different aspects of the task, but no architecture solves the coupled chal lenges of fine structure recovery, same-class instance ownership, and occlusion reason ing; occlusion-level analysis further shows that performance decreases as plant visi bility becomes more limited. The dataset and code are publicly available at https: //github.com/JaaaaaaaD/EgoMaize.

AI.tldr: EgoMaize 是一个用于第一人称视角玉米实例分割的紧凑基准数据集，针对近距离田间图像中严重同类别重叠与遮挡问题，提出"证据闭环"标注流程，将不可靠区域标为 ignore 而非背景。
AI.motivation: 移动玉米表型分析需要近距离第一人称图像，因为许多植株级性状依赖冠层内部结构，俯视视角难以观测。但苗后玉米田是困难的实例分割场景：茎、叶、雄穗及邻近植株细长、重复且遮挡严重。此外，现有仅可见标签会把同一物理植株监督信号割裂，而完全非模态标签又需对遮挡区域做无法验证的补全。
AI.method: 提出 EgoMaize 基准，任务为从存在严重同类重叠的近距离田间图像中预测归属一致的植株掩码以及属于植株的茎/雄穗线索。采用"证据闭环"标注流程处理被遮挡玉米区域，并将不可靠的玉米区域归为 ignore 类别而非背景。
AI.result: 基线结果表明，预训练查询式分组、边界细化与高分辨率裁剪细化分别有助于任务的不同方面，但没有任何架构能同时解决细结构恢复、同类别实例归属与遮挡推理这三项耦合挑战。遮挡层级分析显示，随植株可见度下降，性能随之降低。
AI.conclusion: 近距离第一人称玉米实例分割仍未被现有架构充分解决，细结构恢复、同类实例归属与遮挡推理相互耦合，且性能随遮挡加剧而下降。数据集与代码已公开于 https://github.com/JaaaaaaaD/EgoMaize。

title: SynthSentry: Detecting Synthetic Data Contamination in Language Model Training Data
comment: 11 pages, 3 Figures, 2026 IEEE Asia Conference on Innovation in Emerging Technology
summary: Large language models trained recursively on their own or other models' outputs undergo model collapse, in which distributional tails and factual accuracy deteriorate while fluency survives. Prior work diagnoses collapse after training; the actionable problem is screening a corpus of unknown provenance before training. We introduce SynthSentry, a corpus-level, model-agnostic contamination signal requiring no access to the generating model, no generation history, and no synthetic labels. The score is a distributional divergence over three statistics: lexical diversity collapse, n-gram tail truncation, and perplexity variance across reference models. We evaluate on corpora contaminated by small open-weight generators and an instruction-tuned open-weight model under a leave-one-generator-out protocol. A domain-stratified study measures false positives on naturally repetitive human text (legal, clinical, source code). The score ranks corpora by severity with little loss when whole generator families are held out. Per-domain calibration holds near its nominal false-positive budget once covariance shrinkage and a bootstrap threshold replace a naive quantile, which runs four times over budget. A downstream fine-tuning check showed no contamination-driven accuracy deficit at our scale, so whether pruning recovers one remains open; the same run shows over-pruning risk once pruning exceeds the true contamination fraction. We frame screening as a data-curation defense rather than a post-hoc diagnosis and release the scoring toolkit. All results are small-scale; scope is English-language, batch-mode corpus screening. Contamination sources are single-generation or hand-authored rather than recursively generated, so results speak to synthetic contamination generally and not to recursion depth.

AI.tldr: 提出SynthSentry：语料级、与生成模型无关的污染检测信号，在训练前筛查未知来源语料，量化其合成数据污染严重程度。
AI.motivation: 模型在自身或其他模型输出上递归训练会发生模型坍缩，导致分布尾部与事实准确性退化。既有工作多为训练后诊断，而真正可操作的问题是在训练前筛查来源未知的语料。
AI.method: SynthSentry为语料级、模型无关的污染信号，无需访问生成模型、生成历史或合成标签；其分数为基于三项统计的分布散度：词汇多样性坍缩、n-gram尾部截断、跨参考模型的困惑度方差。评估采用留一生成器（leave-one-generator-out）协议，并使用领域分层研究测量在法律、临床、源代码等自然重复人类文本上的假阳性。
AI.result: 该分数能按严重程度对语料排序，在整类生成器家族被留出时性能损失很小；领域校准在使用协方差收缩与bootstrap阈值后接近名义假阳性预算，而朴素分位数方法超标约四倍。下游微调检验显示本规模下未见污染导致的准确率损失，因此剪枝能否恢复性能尚待验证；同一实验表明当剪枝超过真实污染比例时存在过度剪枝风险。
AI.conclusion: 将筛查定位为数据治理式防御而非事后诊断，并发布评分工具包。所有结果为小规模，适用范围限于英语、批处理式语料筛查；污染源为单次生成或人工撰写而非递归生成，因此结论泛指合成污染，不涉及递归深度。

title: CueMem: Cue-Guided Context Reconstruction for Long-Term Conversational Memory
summary: Long-term conversational agents must answer user queries by recalling information from extended dialogue histories, yet directly using the full history is costly and often unreliable, while compressed memory units may lose fine-grained evidence needed for question answering. Motivated by the reconstructive view of autobiographical memory, we propose CueMem, a cue-guided framework that treats extracted memory records as retrieval cues rather than self-contained evidence and reconstructs query-relevant dialogue context from their source turns. During memory construction, CueMem extracts fine-grained memory cues from dialogue turns and links each cue to its source turn. At query time, it retrieves query-relevant cues, maps them to source-turn anchors, and expands from these anchors over a turn graph that captures temporal proximity and semantic relatedness, reconstructing a compact evidence context from the original dialogue for LLM answer generation. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show that CueMem consistently outperforms representative long-term memory baselines. Further analyses show that graph-based context reconstruction helps recover supporting dialogue evidence while reducing query-time input tokens and latency compared with the full-history LLM setting. These results highlight retrieval cues as an effective alternative to self-contained memory evidence for long-term conversational question answering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CueMem，一种线索引导的长期对话记忆框架，将提取的记忆记录视为检索线索而非独立证据，并通过源对话轮重建查询相关上下文。
AI.motivation: 长期对话智能体需从冗长对话历史中回忆信息以回答用户查询。直接使用完整历史成本高且不可靠，而压缩的记忆单元可能丢失问答所需的细粒度证据，因此需要兼顾有效性与效率的解决方案。
AI.method: 受自传体记忆的重建性观点启发，CueMem在记忆构建阶段从对话轮中提取细粒度记忆线索，并将每条线索链接到其源对话轮。查询时，系统检索查询相关线索，映射到源轮锚点，并在融合时间邻近性与语义相关性的对话轮图上从这些锚点扩展，从而从原始对话中重建紧凑的证据上下文，供大语言模型生成答案。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval数据集上，CueMem持续优于代表性长期记忆基线。进一步分析表明，基于图的上下文重建有助于恢复支撑性对话证据，同时相比完整历史的LLM设置减少了查询时的输入token数量和延迟。
AI.conclusion: 检索线索是长期对话问答中替代独立式记忆证据的有效方案，能够在准确性与效率之间取得更好平衡。

title: Pedestrian Crossing Intent Classification From Event-Based Vision Using Convolutional Spiking Neural Networks With Temporal Augmentation
comment: 8 figures, 6 tables
summary: Anticipating whether a pedestrian will cross the road is safety-critical for autonomous vehicles, requiring real-time inference under challenging conditions including motion blur, high dynamic range, and class imbalance. Conventional frame-based deep networks process redundant RGB data at fixed frame rates, limiting their temporal resolution and energy efficiency. In this work we present an end-to-end pipeline that (i) converts real-world driving footage from the Joint Attention in Autonomous Driving (JAAD) dataset into synthetic dynamic vision sensor (DVS) event streams using the v2e simulator, (ii) augments training with the CARLA-simulated DVS sequences of the DVS-PedX dataset under both normal and adverse weather conditions, and (iii) trains a novel convolutional spiking neural network (Conv-SNN) with clip-consistent DVS augmentation to classify pedestrian crossing intent as binary: crossing or non-crossing. We detail all architectural decisions, the exact leaky-integrate-and-fire neuron dynamics with surrogate-gradient learning, the class-balanced loss formulation, JAAD oversampling at 6x, and a 70/15/15 stratified splitting protocol. The trained model achieves 95.83% accuracy and F1 = 0.9695 on the JAAD DVS test set, 97.79% accuracy and F1 = 0.9478 on normal CARLA DVS, and 94.78% accuracy and F1 = 0.8369 on adverse-weather CARLA DVS, all from a 1.07M-parameter architecture trained on CPU. Compared to prior frame-based approaches on JAAD, our method closes or surpasses the reported accuracy while operating natively on sparse temporal representations. We include a thorough analysis of the convergence behaviour across all 15 training epochs, domain transfer characteristics, and a quantitative comparison with representative related work.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端事件流管线（v2e+DVS-PedX增强）训练1.07M参数卷积脉冲神经网络（Conv-SNN），在JAAD DVS及CARLA正常/恶劣天气DVS上实现行人过街意图二分类，准确率95.83%/97.79%/94.78%。
AI.motivation: 行人过街意图预判对自动驾驶安全关键，需在运动模糊、高动态范围、类别不平衡下实时推理；传统基于帧的深度网络以固定帧率处理冗余RGB数据，限制时间分辨率与能效。
AI.method: (i) 用v2e将JAAD真实驾驶视频转为合成DVS事件流；(ii) 引入CARLA仿真的DVS-PedX（正常与恶劣天气）序列增强训练；(iii) 训练新型Conv-SNN，采用clip一致的DVS增强、LIF神经元动力学与替代梯度学习、类别平衡损失、JAAD 6倍过采样、70/15/15分层划分。
AI.result: JAAD DVS测试集95.83%准确率、F1=0.9695；CARLA正常DVS 97.79%、F1=0.9478；恶劣天气CARLA DVS 94.78%、F1=0.8369；均为1.07M参数、CPU训练。相较JAAD上既有帧基方法，在原生稀疏时序表示下追平或超越其精度，并给出15个epoch收敛分析、域迁移特性与定量对比。
AI.conclusion: 事件驱动稀疏表示结合Conv-SNN可在低参数量、CPU训练条件下有效完成行人过街意图预测，跨数据集与恶劣天气下具备一定域迁移能力，为能效敏感的车载实时感知提供可行路线。

title: ORQA: An Occupation-Realistic Question and Answer Framework for LLM Professional Knowledge
comment: 45 pages, 17 figures, 6 tables. Data, code, and an interactive dashboard at orqabench.org
summary: We present ORQA, a method for testing occupation-level knowledge in large language models. Prior methods either map abstract LLM skills to occupations via task definitions or utilize expert knowledge which is difficult to obtain at scale and expensive. ORQA complements both of these methods by connecting O*NET occupations to trusted occupation-specific websites (such as regulatory agencies, licensing bodies, professional organizations, and government publications) and converting these into source-traceable question-answer pairs. A combination of an automated pipeline and human review produces a set of high quality questions about occupations. The question set created via our method covers 116 occupations from all 21 major groups in the SOC, with 480 questions sourced from 187 different websites. Each question is designed to probe a real-world skill question that is relevant to the occupation in question. We test 15 state-of-the-art frontier and open-weight models via this method. Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.4 and Claude Sonnet 4.6 all perform the best at approximately 58-62% while smaller open-weight models achieve approximately 33-41% performance. Performance varies significantly across occupations. Healthcare-related occupations achieve the highest performance (78%) while Office and Administrative Support achieve approximately 40%. Performance on individual occupations (e.g. Sheet Metal Workers and Fish and Game Wardens) is essentially zero. We also find that open-ended questions and weighting by wage bill do not significantly affect the ranking of models on this benchmark. We believe that leveraging existing trusted occupation-specific information to test LLM knowledge in professional domains may be a scalable and useful method for evaluating occupation-level AI performance in the future. Results and data are available at orqabench.org.

AI.tldr: 提出ORQA方法，通过将O*NET职业映射到可信职业专属网站并转化为可溯源问答对，构建覆盖116个职业、480道题的基准，测试15个模型，最高约58-62%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么通过任务定义将抽象LLM技能映射到职业，要么依赖难以大规模获取且昂贵的专家知识，缺乏可扩展且低成本的职业级知识评测手段。
AI.method: 将O*NET职业与可信的职业专属网站（监管机构、许可机构、专业组织、政府出版物）关联，并转化为可溯源的问答对；采用自动化流水线结合人工审核生成高质量职业问题。
AI.result: 题集覆盖SOC全部21个主要组中的116个职业，480道题源自187个网站。测试15个前沿与开源模型：Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6表现最佳（约58-62%），较小开源模型约33-41%。职业间差异显著：医疗相关职业最高（78%），办公与行政支持约40%，部分职业（如钣金工、渔猎监督员）近乎为零。开放式问题与按工资总额加权不影响模型排名。
AI.conclusion: 利用既有可信的职业专属信息来评测LLM在专业领域的知识，可能是一种可扩展且有价值的职业级AI表现评估方法。数据与结果见orqabench.org。

title: Context-Aware Causal Gaze Forecasting for Human-Vehicle Interaction During In-Cabin Tracking Dropouts
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: Dashboard-mounted gaze trackers often lose sight of the driver's eyes during large head rotations, including shoulder checks, mirror glances, and intersection scanning. These maneuvers occur when information about the driver's visual attention is most useful. Offline gap-filling methods may reconstruct a missing interval using observations from both sides, but an online driver-monitoring system cannot rely on measurements that have not yet occurred. We therefore formulate causal gaze recovery: forecasting unavailable gaze at time t without target-tracker gaze at t or later. We introduce the Causal Context-Gated Forecaster (CCGF), which encodes a 60-frame pre-dropout history of gaze and head pose and combines it with DINOv3 scene features. A learned reliability gate controls the contribution of the history and scene representations as the dropout progresses. We evaluate two scene conditions: Live, in which the scene representation continues to update during tracker loss, and Frozen, in which the final pre-dropout representation is used throughout the missing interval. We evaluate CCGF on 2,047 eligible, naturally occurring GazeSense head\_lost events drawn from 10.5 h of naturalistic driving by ten drivers. Across all recordings, head\_lost accounts for 8.5 percent of GazeSense recording time. Synchronized gaze coordinates from a head-mounted Neon tracker provide supervision and evaluation targets but are never used as model inputs. Under leave-one-driver-out evaluation, CCGF achieves a mean per-driver median error of 175.7 px (10.5 deg) with Live scene updates, a 33 percent reduction relative to history-only causal forecasting. With Frozen scene input, the error increases to 210.8 px (12.9 deg), indicating that scene observations acquired during the dropout provide useful predictive information. We will release the dataset, evaluation protocol, and causal baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"因果注视恢复"任务，并设计Causal Context-Gated Forecaster（CCGF），仅利用丢失前的注视/头部姿态历史与DINOv3场景特征，在驾驶员头部大幅转动导致仪表盘眼动仪丢失眼睛时在线预测其注视位置。
AI.motivation: 仪表盘安装的注视跟踪器在驾驶员大幅转头（如回头检查、扫视后视镜、交叉路口观察）时常丢失眼睛，而这些时刻恰恰是驾驶员视觉注意力信息最有价值的时候。离线插补方法可利用丢失区间两侧的观测，但在线驾驶员监控系统无法使用尚未发生的测量值，因此需要一种因果（仅依赖当前及过去信息）的注视恢复方法。
AI.method: 提出CCGF模型：编码丢失前60帧的注视与头部姿态历史，并与DINOv3场景特征融合；通过学习到的可靠性门控（reliability gate）随丢失进程动态调节历史表征与场景表征的贡献权重。设置两种场景条件：Live（丢失期间场景表征持续更新）与Frozen（整个缺失区间沿用丢失前最后一帧的场景表征）。监督与评估使用头戴式Neon跟踪器的同步注视坐标，但该数据绝不作为模型输入。在10名驾驶员10.5小时自然驾驶中提取的2,047个自然发生的GazeSense head_lost事件上，采用留一驾驶员（leave-one-driver-out）评估。
AI.result: 全部记录中head_lost占GazeSense记录时长的8.5%。采用Live场景更新时，CCGF的每驾驶员中位误差均值为175.7 px（10.5°），相较仅用历史的因果预测降低33%；改用Frozen场景输入时误差升至210.8 px（12.9°），表明丢失期间获取的场景观测提供了有用的预测信息。
AI.conclusion: 在线因果注视恢复可行且有效，损失期间的场景动态观测对预测有显著贡献。作者将公开数据集、评估协议与因果基线方法。

title: Representation-based Masked Diffusion Model
comment: 22 pages, 2 figures, and 10 tables
summary: Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) have emerged as a compelling paradigm for language modeling, offering the capability for efficient parallel text generation. However, existing parallel sampling methods typically update multiple masked tokens independently and ignore the complex mutual dependencies among the masked tokens. This independent updating mechanism lacks global coordination and might lead to incoherent outputs. To address this limitation, we propose Representation-based Masked Diffusion Model (RMDM), a framework that leverages the text representation to explicitly encode global semantics and help to parallel update tokens more precisely. Specifically, we first encode text into a continuous semantic space using a pretrained encoder and learn an invertible transformation that normalizes the representation distribution to a Gaussian prior, facilitating efficient sampling during generation. Conditioned on this latent semantic representation, we train a masked diffusion model to learn the conditional text distribution, where the representation serves as global semantic guidance to coordinate parallel token updates and faithfully approximate the target distribution. Empirical results demonstrate that RMDM significantly improves generation quality, particularly in aggressive few-step sampling regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出RMDM框架，利用文本表征编码全局语义，以协调掩码扩散模型的并行token更新，显著提升生成质量，尤其在少步采样场景。
AI.motivation: 现有掩码扩散模型的并行采样方法独立更新多个掩码token，忽略掩码token间复杂的相互依赖关系，缺乏全局协调，易导致输出不连贯。
AI.method: 用预训练编码器将文本编码到连续语义空间，学习可逆变换将表征分布归一化为高斯先验以便采样；在此潜在语义表征条件下训练掩码扩散模型学习条件文本分布，以表征作为全局语义引导来协调并行token更新并逼近目标分布。
AI.result: 实验表明RMDM显著提升生成质量，尤其在激进的少步采样（few-step sampling）情形下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入基于表征的全局语义引导，RMDM缓解了并行采样的独立更新问题，改善了并行文本生成的连贯性与采样效率，为掩码扩散语言模型提供了一种有效范式。

title: UFO: Chain-of-Evaluation for Omni-Condition Alignment in Multi-Modal Image Generation
comment: 13pages, 6 figures, accepted at the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Multi-modal image generation, particularly subject-driven customization, has garnered growing attention in recent years. Despite the rapid advancement of generative models, their evaluation remains largely lagging. Existing methods, whether embedding-based or Multi-modal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based, evaluate alignment with each modal condition in isolation, which contradicts the simultaneous condition alignment objective of multi-modal image generation, leading to poor consistency with human judgments. To address this challenge, we propose UFO, the first unified framework for omni-condition alignment simultaneous evaluation. Specifically, UFO introduces a novel Atomized Chain-of-Evaluation paradigm, i.e., it first decomposes omni-condition alignment into a sequential chain of fine-grained, disentangled Atomic Evaluation Units (AEUs), categorizes them into distinct modality-relevance classes, and then employs general or dedicated functional calls for accurate verification of different AEU types. Experimental results demonstrate that UFO achieves the highest correlation with human evaluation preferences, delivering an average improvement of 15.25%. Furthermore, we present UFO-Bench, a dedicated benchmark designed to holistically evaluate the performance of existing customization models under the diverse mutual interactions of textual and visual conditions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出UFO，首个面向多模态图像生成全条件对齐的同时评估框架，通过"原子化评估链"范式提升与人类判断的一致性，并发布UFO-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 多模态图像生成（尤其是主体驱动定制）发展迅速，但其评估方法滞后。现有基于嵌入或MLLM的方法将各模态条件孤立评估，与多模态生成中条件需同时对齐的目标相矛盾，导致与人类判断一致性差。
AI.method: 提出UFO统一评估框架，采用"原子化评估链"（Atomized Chain-of-Evaluation）范式：先将全条件对齐分解为有序的、细粒度且解耦的原子评估单元（AEU）链，按模态相关性分类，再通过通用或专用功能调用对不同类型的AEU进行准确验证。
AI.result: 实验表明UFO与人类评估偏好的相关性最高，平均提升15.25%；并构建UFO-Bench基准，用于在文本与视觉条件多样交互下全面评估现有定制模型性能。
AI.conclusion: UFO统一了多模态全条件的同时对齐评估，显著提升与人类判断的一致性，并提供UFO-Bench推动主体驱动定制模型的系统性评测。

title: Beyond ID Embeddings: Process-Grounded Language Modeling for Cognitive Diagnosis
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 20 pages, including references and appendices
summary: Cognitive Diagnosis Models (CDMs) play a pivotal role in personalized online learning. Traditional CDMs rely on discrete, ID-based embeddings to represent students, exercises, and concepts. This paradigm diverges from the nature of learner cognition, where knowledge is not stored and retrieved as isolated symbols. As a result, CDMs suffer from semantic limitations when new exercises or concepts appear. In this paper, we propose a Process-aware Language Cognitive Diagnosis (PLCD) framework that uses language-derived structures as cognitive priors and response records to calibrate student posterior states. PLCD leverages large language models (LLMs) to construct concept schemas and cognitive process graphs, and uses target-conditioned semantic memory to retrieve historical responses that are relevant to each target exercise. A process-grounded Language-to-Cognition Mapper with DA-MoE experts and process-level contrastive learning then maps the textual evidence into a unified cognitive space. Experimental results show that PLCD not only outperforms traditional baselines in predicting student performance but also exhibits strong cognitive transfer capabilities. These results connect the computational power of LLMs with the psychometric goal of measuring latent knowledge states, suggesting that structured language priors calibrated by response records can improve cold-start robustness and cognitive grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PLCD 框架，用语言结构（概念图式、认知过程图）作为认知先验，结合作答记录校准学生后验状态，实现更鲁棒和具认知迁移能力的认知诊断。
AI.motivation: 传统认知诊断模型依赖离散的 ID 嵌入表示学生、题目和概念，这与学习者认知中知识并非以孤立符号存储和检索的本质相悖，导致在新题目或新概念出现时存在语义局限。因此作者希望用语言派生的结构作为认知先验，缓解冷启动问题并提升认知根基。
AI.method: PLCD 利用大语言模型构建概念图式和认知过程图，并使用目标条件语义记忆检索与目标题目相关的历史作答记录；再通过带 DA-MoE 专家和过程级对比学习的、基于过程的 Language-to-Cognition Mapper 将文本证据映射到统一认知空间。
AI.result: 实验表明 PLCD 在预测学生表现上优于传统基线，并展现出较强的认知迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将 LLM 的计算能力与测量潜在知识状态的心理测量目标相结合，说明经作答记录校准的结构化语言先验可提升冷启动鲁棒性和认知根基。

title: GSO-Net: Visual State Machines for Hazardous Freight Transfer Compliance at Petrochemical Logistics Nodes
summary: Hazardous-freight operations at petrochemical logistics nodes are safety-critical for intelligent transportation systems, yet existing vision benchmarks rarely address procedural compliance under realistic deployment constraints. In large infrastructure networks, cameras often operate under sparse round-robin polling, so transfer status must be inferred from incomplete observations and localized evidence. We present GSO-Net, a large-scale benchmark for visual understanding of standard operating procedures (SOPs) in petrochemical unloading scenarios. To our knowledge, GSO-Net is the first public benchmark dataset dedicated to visual SOP understanding in petrochemical hazardous-freight transfer scenarios. It contains over 50,000 independently sampled frames from 64 real expressway petrochemical logistics nodes and adopts an SOP-derived hierarchy linking 9 macroscopic procedural steps with 15 microscopic operational states. Two tasks are defined: joint detection of microscopic states and macroscopic steps as the core benchmark, and frame-level step classification as a diagnostic reference. Experiments with lightweight, transformer-based, open-vocabulary, and holistic models reveal a clear gap between object perception and transfer-stage understanding. Current models remain weak on contact-level state grounding, transient step recognition, and stage consistency, especially under sparse polling, tiny critical targets, and long-tailed operational evidence. GSO-Net provides a practical benchmark for fine-grained state perception and vision-based safety monitoring in hazardous freight transportation. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/yuxieHarrison/GSO-Net

AI.tldr: GSO-Net：首个面向石化危化品装卸SOP视觉理解的公开大规模基准，含6.4万个物流节点、5万余帧、9个宏观步骤与15个微观状态的分层标注，揭示现有模型在状态接地与步骤识别上的明显不足。
AI.motivation: 石化物流节点的危化品货运属安全关键场景，但现有视觉基准很少关注真实部署约束下的作业流程合规性；大规模基础设施网络中摄像头常采用稀疏轮询采样，导致转运状态只能从不完整观测与局部证据中推断，缺乏相应评测基准。
AI.method: 构建GSO-Net数据集：采集自64个真实高速公路石化物流节点、逾5万独立采样帧；采用由SOP推导的分层标注体系，将9个宏观流程步骤与15个微观操作状态关联。定义两项任务：微观状态与宏观步骤联合检测为核心基准，帧级步骤分类为诊断参考；并评测轻量级、Transformer类、开放词汇及整体式多类模型。
AI.result: 实验显示目标感知与转运阶段理解之间存在明显鸿沟；现有模型在接触级状态接地、瞬态步骤识别与阶段一致性方面表现薄弱，在稀疏轮询、微小关键目标与长尾操作证据条件下尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: GSO-Net为危化品运输中的细粒度状态感知与基于视觉的安全监控提供了实用基准，数据集已公开于 https://github.com/yuxieHarrison/GSO-Net。

title: OphBiWSSD: Scaling Temporal Action Localization in Ophthalmic Surgeries with Bidirectional Weight-tied State Space Duality
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Image Processing. Under review
summary: High-frequency surgical maneuvers in ophthalmology necessitate high-fidelity temporal modeling, yet characterizing long-range procedural dependencies remains computationally prohibitive for attention-based architectures. Existing models often require aggressive temporal downsampling, which compromises the detection of fine-grained action boundaries and instrument-tissue interactions. To address these scalability constraints, we present OphBiWSSD, a framework that reformulates surgical temporal action localization leveraging Bidirectional State Space Duality. By employing a weight-tied selective scan mechanism that incorporates both preceding and succeeding surgical contexts, our approach facilitates the global synthesis of non-causal temporal cues with linear complexity. This streamlined architecture is well-suited to capture the bidirectional dependencies present in ophthalmic workflows, effectively bridging the gap between local boundary precision and long-range procedural context without incurring the quadratic memory overhead of traditional Transformers. Extensive experiments on the OphNet benchmark demonstrate that OphBiWSSD achieves state-of-the-art temporal localization performance, with mean Average Precisions of 44.42% on phases and 43.08% on operations, surpassing the baselines by 6.80% and 6.66%, respectively. Empirical validation indicates that our approach ensures precise temporal localization and offers a computationally viable pathway for deploying surgical intelligence systems in clinical environments. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/yo3nglau/OphBiWSSD.

AI.tldr: 提出 OphBiWSSD 框架，利用双向状态空间对偶（BiWSSD）建模眼科手术长程时序依赖，以线性复杂度实现高精度时序动作定位，在 OphNet 基准上达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 眼科高频手术操作需要高保真时序建模，但注意力架构刻画长程手术依赖的计算代价过高；现有方法往往依赖激进的时间下采样，损害了细粒度动作边界与器械-组织交互的检测。
AI.method: 将手术时序动作定位重构为基于双向状态空间对偶（Bidirectional State Space Duality）的框架；采用权重共享（weight-tied）的选择性扫描机制，同时融入前向与后向手术上下文，以线性复杂度实现非因果时序线索的全局综合，避免传统 Transformer 的二次内存开销。
AI.result: 在 OphNet 基准上取得 SOTA 时序定位性能：phases mAP 44.42%、operations mAP 43.08%，分别超越基线 6.80% 和 6.66%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保证精确时序定位的同时，提供了计算可行的路径，利于手术智能系统在临床环境中的部署；代码已开源。

title: A Multimodal Explainable Deep Learning Framework for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis using 3D Magnetic Resonance Imaging and Clinical Data
summary: Dementia is a major and growing global health burden, with Alzheimer's disease (AD) accounting for most cases. Timely and accurate diagnosis is central to managing this burden and increasingly depends on integrating complementary clinical and imaging information. Multimodal deep learning can combine these modalities for AD diagnosis, but how its explanations behave across modalities, fusion strategies, and cohorts remains unclear. We developed an explainable multimodal framework pairing a 3D CNN encoder for T1-weighted MRI with a feedforward network for harmonized clinical and demographic data, comparing varied model setups on three-way and pairwise diagnostic tasks using 6,479 internal records from the ADNI and 1,703 independent records from the OASIS-3. On ADNI, the tabular-only model achieved the highest three-class AUC-ROC of 0.879 and best discriminated cognitively normal (CN) versus mild cognitive impairment (MCI; 0.903), while cross-attention performed best for MCI versus AD (0.861); CN versus AD was highly discriminative overall. On OASIS-3, the vision-only model performed best (three-class AUC-ROC 0.910); CN versus MCI remained difficult, and no fusion strategy consistently outperformed single modalities across tasks and cohorts. SHAP and Integrated Gradients identified the MMSE as the dominant tabular feature in both cohorts, with global feature rankings agreeing strongly in ADNI ($ρ=0.94$) and OASIS-3 ($ρ=0.96$); CAM-based explanations, however, changed with model configuration and cohort. These findings show that multimodal performance and explanations are task, modality, fusion, and cohort-dependent: a dominant cognitive signal persisted across cohorts, but feature contributions and CAM explanations did not, underscoring the need to evaluate explainability under cohort shift rather than as a stable, intrinsic property.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了可解释的多模态深度学习框架（3D CNN处理T1加权MRI，前馈网络处理标准化临床与人口学数据），在ADNI与OASIS-3两个队列上比较不同融合策略。结果显示多模态性能与解释性均依赖任务、模态、融合方式与队列：认知信号（MMSE）在队列间稳定占主导，但特征贡献与CAM解释随模型配置和队列变化。
AI.motivation: 痴呆（尤其阿尔茨海默病）是全球日益加重的健康负担，及时准确诊断依赖临床与影像信息的整合。多模态深度学习可用于AD诊断，但其解释在不同模态、融合策略与队列间如何表现尚不清楚，缺乏对可解释性稳定性的系统评估。
AI.method: 提出可解释多模态框架：3D CNN编码器处理T1加权MRI，前馈网络处理经harmonization的临床与人口学数据；在三分类与两两诊断任务上比较多种模型配置与融合策略。数据为ADNI的6,479条内部记录与OASIS-3的1,703条独立记录；采用SHAP与Integrated Gradients评估表格特征贡献，并用CAM类方法分析影像解释。
AI.result: ADNI上，仅表格模型三分类AUC-ROC最高（0.879），CN vs MCI判别最佳（0.903），交叉注意力在MCI vs AD最佳（0.861），CN vs AD整体判别性强。OASIS-3上仅影像模型表现最佳（三分类AUC-ROC 0.910），CN vs MCI仍难区分，且无任何融合策略在各任务与队列中稳定优于单模态。SHAP与Integrated Gradients均显示MMSE为两队列主导表格特征，全局特征排序一致性高（ADNI ρ=0.94，OASIS-3 ρ=0.96）；但CAM解释随模型配置与队列变化。
AI.conclusion: 多模态性能与解释性均呈任务、模态、融合与队列依赖性：主导性认知信号跨队列稳定存在，但特征贡献与CAM解释并不稳定。因此可解释性应在队列漂移条件下评估，而非视为稳定、内在的属性。

title: DERA: Detached Edge-Residual Adaptation for Prohibited item Detection
summary: Prohibited-item detection in X-ray imagery remains challenging due to object superposition, weak texture, and material clutter which obscure both semantic appearance and object boundaries. We propose \textbf{DERA}, a \textbf{D}etached \textbf{E}dge-\textbf{R}esidual \textbf{A}daptation framework for prohibited item detection under X-ray imagery. DERA combines hierarchical visual features with a parallel pixel-difference edge pyramid and learns an object-specific boundary prior from training-time contours of the instance masks. The detached prior gates edge-sensitive features, which are injected into the early visual stages through residual heads. This staged design preserves the foundation detector at the start of adaptation, isolates boundary supervision from semantic feature learning, and restricts the final adaptation stage to only \(14.7\)K trainable parameters. Evaluated on PIDray, CLCXray, and STCray, DERA improves the baseline by \textbf{3.1}, \textbf{1.6}, and \textbf{2.4} AP points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出DERA框架，通过解耦边缘残差适配提升X射线违禁品检测性能。
AI.motivation: X射线图像中物体重叠、纹理微弱和材质杂乱，导致语义外观与物体边界模糊，违禁品检测困难。
AI.method: DERA融合分层视觉特征与并行像素差分边缘金字塔，从实例掩码的训练期轮廓学习物体特定边界先验；该解耦先验对边缘敏感特征进行门控，并通过残差头注入早期视觉阶段。分阶段设计保持基础检测器在适配初期的完整性，将边界监督与语义特征学习隔离，最终适配阶段仅含14.7K可训练参数。
AI.result: 在PIDray、CLCXray和STCray数据集上，DERA相较基线分别提升3.1、1.6和2.4 AP。
AI.conclusion: DERA以极少参数量有效增强X射线违禁品检测的边界感知能力，取得一致性能提升。

title: Spectral Consistency-Guided Multiview Point Cloud Registration for Low-Overlap Scenes
summary: Multiview point cloud registration is particularly challenging in low-overlap scenes, where reliable correspondences are limited and incorrect pairwise transformations can affect global pose estimation. In addition, registering all scan pairs is computationally expensive because many pairs provide weak geometric information. To address these problems, we propose GMPCR, a non-learning-based spectral consistency-guided framework for efficient and robust multiview point cloud registration. GMPCR builds a refined second-order compatibility structure from initial correspondences and uses its dominant spectral response to evaluate both correspondence reliability and scan-pair confidence. This allows unreliable correspondences to be filtered and informative scan pairs to be selected before relative transformation estimation, leading to a sparse pose graph and reduced pairwise registration cost. For each retained scan pair, maximal-clique-based hypothesis generation is used to estimate reliable relative transformations. The resulting pose graph is further refined by an adaptive history-aware synchronization scheme, in which the effect of residual history is adjusted according to changes in the global rotation residual. A recovery mechanism also allows down-weighted edges to regain confidence when their global consistency improves. Experiments on 3DMatch, 3DLoMatch, ScanNet, and ETH demonstrate the effectiveness of GMPCR. It achieves registration recalls of 97.2% and 89.6% on 3DMatch and 3DLoMatch, respectively, while maintaining competitive performance on ScanNet and ETH. The results show that GMPCR provides a favorable balance among registration accuracy, robustness to low overlap, and computational efficiency. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/swccj/gmpcr.

AI.tldr: 提出GMPCR，一种基于谱一致性引导的非学习多视图点云配准框架，通过筛选可靠对应与信息量高的扫描对构建稀疏位姿图，结合极大团假设生成与自适应历史感知同步，实现低重叠下高效鲁棒的配准。
AI.motivation: 多视图点云配准在低重叠场景中极具挑战：可靠对应稀少，错误的成对变换会污染全局位姿估计；同时对所有扫描对进行配准计算代价高昂，且许多扫描对几何信息贫弱。因此需要一种能同时评估对应可靠性与扫描对信息量、降低计算成本的鲁棒配准方法。
AI.method: GMPCR为非学习框架：1）从初始对应构建精炼的二阶兼容性结构，利用其主谱响应对应可靠性与扫描对置信度进行评估，在相对变换估计前过滤不可靠对应并选择有信息量的扫描对，形成稀疏位姿图；2）对保留的扫描对采用基于极大团的假设生成估计可靠相对变换；3）使用自适应历史感知同步方案精炼位姿图，依据全局旋转残差变化调整残差历史影响，并设恢复机制使被降权边在全局一致性改善后重获置信。
AI.result: 在3DMatch、3DLoMatch、ScanNet与ETH数据集上验证有效性：3DMatch与3DLoMatch配准召回率分别达97.2%和89.6%，在ScanNet与ETH上保持有竞争力性能，在配准精度、低重叠鲁棒性与计算效率间取得良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: GMPCR通过谱一致性引导的对应过滤与扫描对选择，结合极大团假设生成和历史感知同步，有效解决低重叠多视图配准中可靠性不足与计算冗余问题，实现精度、鲁棒性与效率的兼顾，代码已开源。

title: RiPPLE: Cross-Space Performance Prediction from Early Training for Neural Architecture Search
summary: Neural architecture search (NAS) evaluates candidate networks, but fully training enough architectures to rank an entire space is expensive. Zero-cost proxies score architectures at initialization, yet their ranking quality varies across search spaces. Learned predictors reduce evaluation cost but typically require fully trained labels or partial-training features for individual candidates. We introduce $\textbf{RiPPLE}$, $\underline{\textbf{R}}$anking v$\underline{\textbf{i}}$a $\underline{\textbf{P}}$refix-$\underline{\textbf{P}}$ropagated $\underline{\textbf{L}}$abel $\underline{\textbf{E}}$xtrapolation, which treats partial training as a source of labels for a small coverage set of anchors. RiPPLE trains these anchors to an early prefix, extrapolates their learning curves to surrogate labels, and propagates the labels over label-free architecture features. The early-training signal remains a label on the anchors rather than a per-candidate feature. Feature, readout, and encoding rules are selected without held-out accuracy and reused across search spaces. We evaluate the method on twelve benchmark cells from four search-space families and on the larger DARTS space. The results examine ranking quality, label efficiency, architecture selection, and the roles of readout, coverage, and propagation. RiPPLE provides a whole-space ranking from a fractional anchor-training budget, with comparisons interpreted under their respective evaluation and cost protocols.

AI.tldr: RiPPLE将部分训练视作少量锚点网络的标签来源：将锚点训练至早期前缀，外推其学习曲线得到代理标签，再在无标签架构特征上传播这些标签，从而实现低成本的全空间架构排序。
AI.motivation: NAS需要对候选网络进行评估，但完整训练足够多的架构以对整个搜索空间排序代价高昂；零成本代理虽在初始化时打分，但其排序质量在不同搜索空间间波动；已学习的预测器虽降低评估成本，却通常需要完整训练标签或针对单个候选的部分训练特征。
AI.method: 提出RiPPLE（Ranking via Prefix-Propagated Label Extrapolation）：将部分训练作为一小部分覆盖性锚点的标签来源；先把锚点训练到早期前缀，外推其学习曲线得到代理标签，再将标签在无标签的架构特征上传播。早期训练信号作为锚点上的标签而非每个候选的特征。特征、读出与编码规则不依赖留出准确率进行选择，并可跨搜索空间复用。
AI.result: 在来自四个搜索空间族的十二个基准单元以及更大的DARTS空间上进行评估，考察了排序质量、标签效率、架构选择，以及读出、覆盖与传播各自的作用；在仅需部分锚点训练预算的情况下即可给出全空间排序，相关比较在各自评估与成本协议下进行解读。
AI.conclusion: RiPPLE通过将早期训练信号作为锚点标签并跨无标签架构特征传播，以小数量的锚点训练预算实现全搜索空间的架构排序，且其规则选择无需留出准确率并可跨搜索空间复用。

title: An End-to-End Automated Pipeline for Controllable Crack Data Synthesis
summary: Vision-based crack inspection depends on segmentation networks whose reliability depends on the quantity, diversity and label quality of their training data. Pixel-level annotations are costly, and crack images of specific structures are scarce. Generative augmentation can supply additional data, but existing methods address isolated steps. They reuse annotated masks, offer limited control over crack geometry, and adopt the conditioning mask as the label without checking it. This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline that produces labelled crack data without manual annotation and assesses the reliability of these data and of the detectors trained on them. Procedurally sampled Bézier skeletons with guaranteed geometric properties are converted into crack masks by a generative adversarial network (GAN). A dual-ControlNet Stable Diffusion model renders the masks as crack images, either on text-described surfaces or on user-provided backgrounds. An ensemble of segmentation networks trained on real images combines its agreement with the inherited label and its internal disagreement into a pixel-wise label confidence. This confidence weights the training loss instead of removing samples with a threshold. The trained detectors are evaluated with image-space probability of detection (POD) and calibration analyses. On CRACK500 and CrackTree200, the pipeline improves five segmentation networks over conventional, diffusion-based and flow-matching-based augmentation, and on CRACK500 confidence weighting yields a higher accuracy than threshold filtering at every tested threshold. On CRACK500, the crack width that U-Net detects with 90\% probability at 95\% confidence decreases from 8.0 to 4.3 pixels, and the expected calibration error decreases from 14.2\% to 9.6\%.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端无人工标注的裂缝数据生成流水线：程序化贝塞尔骨架→GAN生成裂缝掩膜→双ControlNet Stable Diffusion渲染图像，并利用分割网络集成的一致性与分歧计算像素级标签置信度加权训练；在CRACK500与CrackTree200上优于常规、扩散及流匹配增强方法，且置信度加权优于阈值过滤。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的裂缝检测依赖分割网络的可靠性，而可靠性受训练数据的数量、多样性与标注质量制约。像素级标注成本高，特定结构的裂缝图像稀缺。现有生成式增强方法只处理孤立环节：复用已标注掩膜、对裂缝几何控制有限，并直接采用条件掩膜作为标签而不做可靠性检验。因此需要一套无人工标注、且能评估所生成数据及其训练检测器可靠性的端到端方案。
AI.method: 1) 程序化采样具备几何属性保证的贝塞尔骨架；2) 用GAN将骨架转换为裂缝掩膜；3) 用双ControlNet Stable Diffusion将掩膜渲染为裂缝图像，可置于文本描述的表面或用户提供的背景上；4) 用真实图像训练的分割网络集成，将其与继承标签的一致性及内部分歧结合为像素级标签置信度；5) 以该置信度加权训练损失，而非按阈值剔除样本；6) 用图像空间检测概率(POD)与校准分析评估检测器。
AI.result: 在CRACK500与CrackTree200上，该流水线使五种分割网络相较常规增强、基于扩散的增强和基于流匹配的增强均获得提升；在CRACK500上，置信度加权在所有测试阈值下都取得高于阈值过滤的精度。U-Net在95%置信度下达到90%检测概率所需的裂缝宽度由8.0像素降至4.3像素，期望校准误差由14.2%降至9.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，将几何可控的程序化骨架生成、GAN掩膜合成、双ControlNet扩散渲染与基于集成一致性的像素级置信度加权整合为端到端流水线，可在无需人工标注的条件下生成带标签裂缝数据，并提升多种分割网络的性能与校准质量，为生成式数据增强提供了可评估、可加权利用的完整范式。

title: IMPLY: Physically Anchored Consistency for World-Model Rollouts
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: A world model asked what happens if an object is pushed at several speeds produces several futures. If the model has the object in mind, those futures agree about it: each implies the same mass and friction. The consistency checks now used to vet world-action models ask whether a model's futures agree with each other, and none of them knows any physics. We show that this is not enough, and what to do instead. IMPLY reads the physics each rollout implies by inverting a simulator and scores a set of rollouts by how well one object explains all of them, anchored to two calibration pushes the model has observed. In a controlled setting, self-consistency gives a perfect score to a model that ignores the object and always predicts a typical push; anchoring exposes it (AUROC 0.70 versus 1.00). On a real model, V-JEPA 2-AC adapted to the scene, the same thing happens. Given its own calibration pushes the model tracks the object (per-object correlation with the truth 0.91); given another object's, it does not (0.05). Self-consistency cannot tell these apart, preferring the right evidence on 52% of objects, chance level, while anchored disagreement prefers it on 73% and correlates 0.92-0.99 with the rollouts' error. Used to choose among candidate rollout sets, it comes within 0.003 of an oracle that sees the truth. A model that has internalised the wrong object is exactly as self-consistent as one that has internalised the right one; consistency has to be anchored to evidence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出IMPLY方法：通过反演模拟器读取每个rollout所隐含的物理参数，并以模型已观测的两次校准推动作为锚点，评估一组rollout能否被同一物体物理解释，从而弥补现有自洽性检验缺乏物理意义的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有用于评估world-action模型的"自洽性"检验只考察模型生成的多个未来之间是否彼此一致，但其完全不具备物理知识。一个内部建模了错误物体的模型与建模正确物体的模型同样自洽，因此自洽性检验无法区分二者，需要引入外部证据锚定。
AI.method: IMPLY反演模拟器以读取每次rollout隐含的物理量（如质量、摩擦），然后以模型观测过的两次校准推动为锚点，用"同一个物体能否解释全部rollout"的标准对rollout集合打分，衡量锚定后的不一致程度。
AI.result: 在受控环境中，自洽性给"忽略物体、永远预测典型推动"的模型满分，而锚定方法将其暴露（AUROC 0.70 对 1.00）。在真实模型V-JEPA 2-AC上同样如此：使用自身校准推动时，模型追踪物体（与真值每物体相关性0.91）；使用另一物体的推动时则不追踪（0.05）。自洽性无法区分，仅在52%物体上偏好正确证据（随机水平），而锚定不一致在73%上偏好正确证据，并与rollout误差相关性达0.92–0.99。用于在候选rollout集合间选择时，其性能距看到真值的oracle仅差0.003。
AI.conclusion: 内部建模错误物体的模型与建模正确物体的模型同样自洽，因此单纯的自洽性不足以验证world-action模型，一致性必须锚定到外部证据上。

title: Diverse Minds, Divided Networks? Personality Composition, Polarization, and Collective Intelligence in LLM-Based Social Simulations
summary: Simulated societies of large language model agents are used to study online polarization, and separately to study collective intelligence, but the two are rarely measured in the same system. It is therefore difficult to say whether a society's personality composition shapes both, or whether reducing polarization costs collective competence. We present TraitMix, an experimental design in which the Big Five composition of a simulated social network, both trait levels and trait heterogeneity, is a controlled experimental variable, and in which polarization and collective performance are measured in the same runs. Across 991 simulations of hundred-agent societies, spanning six contested topics and six language models, trait heterogeneity has the largest measured effects, acting in opposite directions on two faces of polarization: varied societies hold more dispersed opinions while being less segregated into camps, so homogeneous societies are not moderate but consensual echo chambers. Trait effects are not additive, as Agreeableness determines the sign of Openness, an interaction that replicates across models although the primary model's estimate is influence-driven. Contrary to the trade-off the study was designed to measure, no polarization measure predicts poorer collective performance, and cross-cutting interaction is the only one of four whose association with collective accuracy survives partialling on the aggregation identity. We report ablations removing two potential measurement circularities, an induction gate applied to every model, and the measures that failed them.

AI.tldr: TraitMix将大五人格构成（水平与异质性）作为模拟社交网络的可控实验变量，在同一批运行中同时测量极化和集体表现；991次百智能体社会模拟显示，特质异质性效应最大且对极化两方面作用相反，未发现极化与集体表现的权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 已有研究分别用大语言模型智能体社会模拟研究网络极化和集体智能，但很少在同一系统中同时测量两者。因此无法判断社会的人格构成是否同时塑造二者，也无法判断降低极化是否需要牺牲集体能力。
AI.method: 提出TraitMix实验设计：将模拟社交网络的大五人格构成（特质水平与特质异质性）作为受控实验变量，并在同一次运行中测量极化与集体绩效。共进行991次百智能体社会模拟，覆盖6个争议话题和6个语言模型；同时进行消融以排除两处潜在测量循环性，并对每个模型施加诱导门控，报告未通过门控的测量指标。
AI.result: 特质异质性测得效应最大，且对极化的两个方面作用方向相反：异质性高的社会意见更分散，但更少分裂为对立阵营，因此同质社会并非温和，而是共识型回音室。特质效应非加性：宜人性决定开放性的符号，该交互在多个模型上可复现，但主模型的估计受影响力驱动。与设计初衷相反，没有任何极化指标能预测更差的集体表现；在四种交互中，只有交叉性交互与集体准确率的关联在部分掉聚合身份后仍然成立。
AI.conclusion: 人格构成（尤其是特质异质性）是同时影响极化形态与集体绩效的关键变量，且极化与集体能力之间不存在预期的权衡；交叉性交互是与集体准确率稳健相关的唯一因素，研究同时通过消融与诱导门控剔除了测量循环性导致的人为效应。

title: Do LLMs Trust the Accuser or the Accusation? Measuring Belief Shifts in Werewolf
comment: Accepted by the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026 Main Conference)
summary: Social-deduction games such as Werewolf are increasingly used to evaluate LLM agents, but existing evaluations often rely on final game outcomes. We propose a belief-shift evaluation benchmark in Werewolf for analyzing communication skills through belief updating. Using LLM-played games, we annotate suspicion and accusation messages and measure how an observing village-side model's beliefs change after each message. We evaluate 40 open-weight LLM configurations on 1,224 annotated messages. Our results show that larger models better distinguish true wolves from villagers based on game history, but accusations still strongly influence their beliefs. Models become more suspicious of the accused target and less suspicious of the accuser, especially when the accuser is trusted, even if the accuser is wolf-aligned. Larger models better resist accusations from accusers they already distrust. Overall, our findings suggest that current open-weight LLMs up to 120B parameters still struggle to integrate accusation content with source trust in strategic communication. Our benchmark and code are available at https://rlg.iis.sinica.edu.tw/papers/werewolf-accusation-benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出狼人杀“信念转移”评测基准，通过标注怀疑与指控消息并测量旁观村民模型信念变化，评估40个开源权重LLM配置。结果显示大模型更能区分狼人与村民，但仍受指控影响，难以将指控内容与消息来源可信度整合。
AI.motivation: 现有社交推理游戏（如狼人杀）对LLM智能体的评测多依赖最终游戏胜负结果，无法细致分析其沟通与信念更新能力，缺乏对交流技能的细粒度评估手段。
AI.method: 构建狼人杀信念转移评测基准：在LLM对局中标注怀疑与指控消息，测量旁观村民阵营模型在每条消息后的信念变化；在1,224条标注消息上评测40个开源权重LLM配置。
AI.result: 更大模型能更好地依据对局历史区分真狼人与村民；但指控仍强烈影响其信念：模型对被指控者更怀疑、对指控者更少怀疑，尤其当指控者受信任时，即使指控者属于狼人阵营；更大模型更能抵抗来自其原本不信任的指控者的指控。
AI.conclusion: 当前至120B参数的开源权重LLM仍难以在策略性沟通中将指控内容与来源可信度进行整合。基准与代码已开源。

title: GraphProfiler: Source-Linked Sensitive Attribute Inference via Personal Knowledge Graphs
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)
summary: Sensitive attributes such as age, income, and occupation can be inferred from user-generated content by aggregating indirect cues across many ordinary posts. LLM-based profilers can perform this aggregation automatically and with high accuracy, which makes large-scale personal attribute inference a major privacy threat. Existing LLM-based profilers, however, offer limited insight into which specific posts, concepts, and relationships made an inference possible, which is key to targeted privacy mitigation, i.e., redacting or rewriting only the few posts that actually leak an attribute, rather than perturbing entire histories. We introduce GraphProfiler, an auditable LLM-based profiler that represents each user's post history as a source-linked personal knowledge graph where nodes and edges trace back to the originating post and resolves attribute predictions to cited graph records and source texts. GraphProfiler reaches 86.7% attack success rate on the eight-attribute SynthPAI benchmark, within two points of strong text-only baselines, and 84.6% on PANDORA, while citing supporting evidence for over 98% of predictions. Our controlled ablation experiments provide evidence that the cited posts contribute to attack success, as removing them reduces the attack success rate substantially more than removing an equal number of random posts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GraphProfiler，一种可审计的基于 LLM 的用户画像推断器，将用户帖子历史建模为可溯源的个人知识图谱，在保持接近纯文本基线攻击成功率的同时，为超过 98% 的推断提供可追溯的引用证据。
AI.motivation: 敏感属性（如年龄、收入、职业）可通过聚合大量普通帖子中的间接线索被推断。基于 LLM 的画像器能自动、高精度地完成这种聚合，构成大规模隐私威胁。然而，现有 LLM 画像器难以揭示具体是哪些帖子、概念及其关系导致了推断，而这恰恰是精准隐私缓解（仅删改真正泄露属性的少数帖子，而非扰动全部历史）的关键。
AI.method: GraphProfiler 将每个用户的帖子历史表示为带来源链接的个人知识图谱，图中节点与边均可追溯到原始帖子；推断结果被解析为被引用的图谱记录与源文本，从而实现可审计性。
AI.result: 在八属性的 SynthPAI 基准上攻击成功率达 86.7%，与强纯文本基线相差不到两个百分点；在 PANDORA 上达 84.6%，同时为超过 98% 的预测提供支持性证据引用。消融实验表明，移除被引用帖子对攻击成功率的降低幅度显著大于移除等量随机帖子，说明被引用帖子确实对攻击成功有贡献。
AI.conclusion: GraphProfiler 在基本不损失推断能力的前提下实现了可审计性，所引用的证据经实验验证具有因果贡献，为精准的隐私缓解（定位并删改真正泄露属性的帖子）提供了可行基础。

title: A deep dictionary network-based foundation model for ultra-low-dose CT denoising
summary: Ultra-low-dose computed tomography (ULDCT) reduces radiation exposure but suffers from severe noise that degrades diagnostic image quality. Existing deep learning-based denoising methods are typically trained in an organ-specific fashion, resulting in limited generalization across heterogeneous multi?organ imaging scenarios. Foundation models present a promising all-in-one paradigm for unified multi-organ denoising. However, their architectures suffer from poor interpretability and rely on heuristic training strategies. To address these limitations, we propose an architecture?interpretable foundation model based on the deep dictionary network (DDN) for unified multi-organ ULDCT denoising. Inspired by multilayer sparse representation theory, DDN cascades convolutional sparse coding layers with iterative soft-thresholding, providing inherent architectural interpretability. Furthermore, a dynamic dictionary module and a threshold generation module are embedded within each layer to enhance representation ability. We conduct DDN pre-training on more than one million multi-organ normal-dose CT images by recovering clean images from Gaussian-noised inputs. Sparse regularization is additionally imposed on latent feature representations, guiding the network to learn compact and noise-robust priors. The complete architecture is jointly fine-tuned on multi-organ ULDCT datasets, enabling a single unified model to perform denoising across diverse anatomical regions. Extensive experiments validate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the?art performance and consistently surpasses competing ULDCT methods across all mul

AI.tldr: 提出基于深度字典网络（DDN）的架构可解释基础模型，用于统一多器官超低剂量CT（ULDCT）去噪，通过百万级正常剂量CT预训练与多器官ULDCT联合微调，取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: ULDCT可降低辐射暴露，但噪声严重、图像质量下降。现有深度学习去噪方法多按器官单独训练，跨多器官场景泛化能力有限；基础模型虽提供"一体化"统一去噪范式，但存在可解释性差、依赖启发式训练策略的问题。
AI.method: 以多层稀疏表示理论为启发，构建深度字典网络，将卷积稀疏编码层与迭代软阈值级联，实现内在的架构可解释性；每层嵌入动态字典模块与阈值生成模块增强表示能力；在超百万张多器官正常剂量CT图像上以"高斯加噪输入恢复干净图像"进行预训练，并对潜在特征施加稀疏正则以学习紧致、抗噪先验；随后在多器官ULDCT数据集上联合微调，使单一模型可跨解剖区域去噪。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提方法达到最先进性能，并在所有多器官ULDCT任务上持续优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了基于DDN的架构可解释基础模型在统一多器官ULDCT去噪中的有效性，兼顾可解释性与统一建模能力，为多器官低剂量CT去噪提供了新范式。

title: Bridging Vision Foundation Model Priors with CLIP for Spatial-aware Few-shot Anomaly Detection in Medical Images
comment: Accepted by MICCAI 2026
summary: Vision-Language Models such as CLIP enable effective few-shot medical anomaly detection (AD) via strong image-text semantic alignment. However, their globally contrastive pretraining lacks explicit spatial supervision, limiting precise lesion localization. In contrast, Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) such as DINO learn spatially coherent patch representations via self-distillation and local-to-global consistency, better capturing fine-grained anatomical structures. Leveraging this complementarity, we propose Spatial-FAD, a spatial-aware few-shot medical AD framework that improves lesion localization by combining VFM spatial priors with CLIP semantics. Specifically, we introduce a VFM-enhanced adapter that injects a structural affinity prior derived from DINO into CLIP features. This structure-guided refinement encourages visual embeddings to better adhere to lesion boundaries while maintaining semantic alignment. To address the loss of spatial detail from patchification and the limited input resolution of CLIP, we adopt a sliding-window aggregation strategy. This generates high-resolution, spatially dense embeddings to further enhance localization granularity. Moreover, we introduce a prototype-enhanced support memory scheme to efficiently exploit the few-shot support set. This module stores compact prototypes for normal and abnormal patterns, reducing memory costs while boosting performance by fusing patch-to-prototype and image-text similarities. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets, including Liver CT, Retinal OCT, and Brain MRI, demonstrate that Spatial-FAD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, especially in lesion segmentation. Notably, in the 4-shot scenario, our method achieves an average improvement of over 11.4% in Dice score and 1.8% in AUC. Code is available at: https://github.com/JuzhengMiao/Spatial-FAD.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spatial-FAD，一种空间感知的少样本医学异常检测框架，将 VFM（DINO）空间先验与 CLIP 语义结合以提升病灶定位与分割性能。
AI.motivation: CLIP 类视觉-语言模型虽凭借强图文语义对齐支持有效的少样本医学异常检测，但其全局对比预训练缺乏显式空间监督，导致病灶定位不精确；而 DINO 等视觉基础模型通过自蒸馏与局部-全局一致性学习到空间连贯的 patch 表征，更擅长捕捉细粒度解剖结构。二者具有互补性，作者希望借此互补提升定位能力。
AI.method: 1) VFM 增强适配器：将 DINO 衍生的结构亲和先验注入 CLIP 特征，进行结构引导的特征精炼，使视觉嵌入更贴合病灶边界并保持语义对齐；2) 滑动窗口聚合策略：应对 patch 化导致的空间细节损失与 CLIP 输入分辨率受限问题，生成高分辨率、空间稠密的嵌入以提升定位粒度；3) 原型增强的支撑记忆机制：为正常与异常模式存储紧凑原型，融合 patch-原型相似度与图文相似度，在降低内存开销的同时高效利用少样本支撑集。
AI.result: 在 Liver CT、Retinal OCT、Brain MRI 三个基准数据集上，Spatial-FAD 显著优于现有最先进方法，尤其在病灶分割方面表现突出；在 4-shot 场景下，Dice 分数平均提升超过 11.4%，AUC 提升 1.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合 VFM 的空间先验与 CLIP 的语义对齐能力，并结合滑动窗口聚合与原型增强记忆，Spatial-FAD 有效提升了少样本医学异常检测的定位与分割性能，验证了两类基础模型互补结合的有效性。代码已开源。

title: Not All Speech Is Intent: Adaptive Self-Correcting Inference Layer for Post-ASR False Wake-Up
summary: False wake-up activations remain a persistent challenge in conversational AI. Speech phonetically similar to a device's wake word can produce a syntactically valid and semantically coherent ASR transcript that the assistant incorrectly executes. Most existing systems make a single intent decision in isolation, without a mechanism to learn from recurring errors over time or adapt to individual users through personalized learning. We introduce the Feedback-Driven Adaptive Self-Correcting Inference Layer (ASCIL), a complementary post-ASR correction framework that re-evaluates wake-up intent before response generation by fusing acoustic embeddings, linguistic cues, device context, and patterns from past misclassifications. ASCIL interprets implicit signals, including hesitation, disengagement, and silence, and explicit signals, including cancellation and repetition, as automatically inferred, noisy behavioral indicators of potential misclassification. These signals drive online pattern updates without manual annotation, whereas the intentional/unintentional reference labels used for offline evaluation are human-annotated. It generalizes from prior errors, applies corrective adjustments at inference time, and continuously updates in parallel with natural-language execution. Evaluated on a proprietary dataset of 3,667 interactions with human-annotated intentional/unintentional reference labels spanning 14 acoustic and contextual conditions, ASCIL achieves 54.27% relative error reduction on a session-disjoint subset constructed from baseline failures, and up to 24.39% relative error reduction at threshold 0.90 on the issue-tagged evaluation slice. These gains are achieved while improving intentional acceptance rates, with a median added latency below 60 ms in the reported benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出ASCIL——一种ASR后的自适应自校正推理层，通过融合声学、语言、设备上下文与历史误分类模式，并利用隐式/显式行为信号实现无标注在线更新，降低误唤醒错误，中位附加延迟低于60 ms。
AI.motivation: 误唤醒激活是对话AI的持续性难题：与唤醒词发音相似的语音可能生成语法有效、语义连贯的ASR转写并被错误执行。现有系统多在孤立条件下做单次意图判定，缺乏从历史错误中学习以及通过个性化学习适应用户的机制。
AI.method: ASCIL作为ASR后的补充性纠正框架，在响应生成前重新评估唤醒意图，融合声学嵌入、语言线索、设备上下文以及过往误分类模式；将犹豫、脱离、静音等隐式信号与取消、重复等显式信号作为自动推断的含噪行为指标，驱动在线模式更新而无需人工标注（离线评估所用的有意/无意参考标签由人工标注）。该层可从既往错误泛化，在推理时施加纠正调整，并与自然语言执行并行持续更新。
AI.result: 在包含3,667次交互、覆盖14种声学与上下文条件、带人工标注有意/无意参考标签的自有数据集上评估：在由基线失败构建的会话不相交子集上取得54.27%的相对错误率降低；在问题标记评估切片上、阈值0.90时相对错误率最高降低24.39%；同时提升有意唤醒的接受率，报告基准下中位附加延迟低于60 ms。
AI.conclusion: ASCIL以低成本、低延迟的方式有效缓解误唤醒问题，验证了融合同步多模态证据与行为反馈进行在线自适应纠错的可行性，并可作为一种互补层与现有对话系统集成。

title: AMDKernelVault: Large-Scale Datasets and Agentic Training for AMD GPU Kernel Optimization
comment: N pages, 3 figures, including appendix. First four authors contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/AMD-AGI/hip_kernel_llm_lab Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/amd/AIG-Datasets
summary: We introduce AMDKernelVault, an open HIP and Triton kernel corpus and training framework for recent AMD CDNA GPUs. Existing LLM-based kernel agents are largely CUDA/NVIDIA-centric and often depend on repeated frontier-LLM calls for generation, reflection, and optimization. To address this gap, we develop HIPKernelGen and TritonKernelGen, agent-driven pipelines that transform PyTorch references into HIP or Triton kernels, compile and validate candidates under ROCm, and latency-profile them on AMD hardware. The corpus contains 62,153 execution-verified HIP kernel samples, 2,377 production-grounded ROCm Libraries QA entries, and 39,893 Triton kernels. We further train Qwen3-8B with supervised fine-tuning and execution-aware reinforcement learning as a demonstration of the corpus's utility. Under fixed evaluation budgets, it achieves the highest correctness among the compared models on PyTorch-to-HIP (34.0% Pass@1), TritonBench-G (33.2% Corr@3), and ROCmBench (41.94% Corr@3), but does not uniformly lead compilation or speed metrics. The corpus and documentation are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/amd/AIG-Datasets, and the associated training and kernel-generation code is available at https://github.com/AMD-AGI/hip_kernel_llm_lab.

AI.tldr: 提出 AMCDKernelVault：面向 AMD CDNA GPU 的开源 HIP/Triton 内核语料库与训练框架，并训练 Qwen3-8B 在多个基准上取得最高正确率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的内核智能体大多以 CUDA/NVIDIA 为中心，且常依赖反复调用前沿 LLM 进行生成、反思与优化，缺乏面向 AMD ROCm 生态的语料与训练资源。
AI.method: 构建 HIPKernelGen 与 TritonKernelGen 智能体驱动流水线，将 PyTorch 参考实现转换为 HIP 或 Triton 内核，在 ROCm 下编译验证并在 AMD 硬件上进行延迟剖析；语料包含 62,153 条执行验证的 HIP 内核样本、2,377 条 ROCm Libraries QA 条目及 39,893 个 Triton 内核；并以监督微调与执行感知强化学习训练 Qwen3-8B。
AI.result: 在固定评估预算下，PyTorch-to-HIP 达 34.0% Pass@1，TritonBench-G 达 33.2% Corr@3，ROCmBench 达 41.94% Corr@3，均为对比模型中最高的正确率，但在编译与速度指标上并非全面领先。
AI.conclusion: AMDKernelVault 为 AMD GPU 内核智能体提供了可复用的语料与训练框架，验证了其在提升内核生成正确性方面的价值，语料与代码已开源。

title: Partition-Invariant Tuning for 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Scene-level point cloud understanding remains challenging due to diverse geometries and spatial layouts. While pre-trained 3D point cloud foundation models (PFMs) offer strong transferability, full fine-tuning (FFT) incurs substantial computational and storage costs. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) provides a promising alternative, but existing PEFT methods largely focus on object-level point clouds and overlook serialization-induced partition variations in large-scale scenes. To address this issue, we propose PointPiT, a partition-invariant tuning framework for scene-level point clouds. Specifically, a Scene-aware Structural Adapter (SSA) integrates local geometric patterns with global scene context to mitigate partition-induced representation shifts. Moreover, Gradient Subspace Optimization (GSO) selects informative and partition-stable update directions, suppressing partition-dependent variations during optimization. Extensive experiments across multiple scene-level benchmarks demonstrate that PointPiT achieves competitive or even superior performance to full fine-tuning with less than 1% of backbone's parameters, while achieving consistent state-of-the-art performance among representative PEFT methods.

AI.tldr: 提出PointPiT，面向场景级点云的分区不变参数高效微调框架，通过场景感知结构适配器与梯度子空间优化实现分区不变性。
AI.motivation: 场景级点云理解因几何多样与空间布局复杂而困难；预训练3D点云基础模型虽迁移性强，但全量微调计算与存储开销大。现有PEFT方法主要面向物体级点云，忽视大规模场景中序列化导致的分区变化问题。
AI.method: 提出分区不变的微调框架PointPiT，包含两个组件：(1) Scene-aware Structural Adapter (SSA)，融合局部几何模式与全局场景上下文，缓解分区引起的表示漂移；(2) Gradient Subspace Optimization (GSO)，选择信息量大且分区稳定的更新方向，抑制优化过程中的分区依赖变化。
AI.result: 在多个场景级基准上，PointPiT以不足骨干网络1%的参数达到与全量微调相当甚至更优的性能，并在代表性PEFT方法中取得一致的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: PointPiT有效解决了场景级点云PEFT中的分区不变性问题，验证了在极低参数开销下实现高性能场景理解的可行性。

title: Zipbench: Low-Cost Framework for Compressing Comprehensive Benchmarks of Large Language Models
comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 main track
summary: Comprehensive benchmark suites are essential for improving large language models (LLMs), but many widely used benchmarks are redundant, making evaluation unnecessarily expensive. Although recent benchmark compression methods (BCMs) can mitigate this cost, many strong BCMs rely on large collections of per-sample evaluation results from numerous LLMs to identify representative samples. Building such collections is also expensive unless they are already public, making these methods difficult to extend to newly released benchmarks. To address this challenge, we present ZipBench, a simple and low-cost BCM with theoretical error and rank-consistency guarantees. ZipBench evaluates only a small set of anchor LLMs, synthesizes pseudo evaluation results to broaden coverage, learns compact sample representations, and selects a small yet representative subset. Building on it, we create ZipBench Zoo, a collection of compact versions of 100+ benchmark proxies spanning text, multimodal, and agent tasks. These benchmark achieve mean absolute errors of 0.002--0.02 and average Spearman correlations of ~0.98 with the full benchmarks. Overall, ZipBench reduces the cost of both LLM evaluation and compact benchmark construction, lowering the barrier to broad LLM research for compute-constrained researchers. The code has been released in https://github.com/MilkThink-Lab/ZipBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ZipBench，一种低成本基准压缩方法（BCM），仅评估少量锚 LLM、合成伪评估结果、学习紧凑样本表示并选出小而有代表性的子集，具备理论误差与排序一致性保证；并构建覆盖文本、多模态与智能体任务的 100+ 基准代理，与完整基准的 MAE 为 0.002--0.02、平均 Spearman 相关约 0.98。
AI.motivation: 现有广泛使用的 LLM 基准存在大量冗余，导致评测成本过高；而许多强 BCM 依赖大量 LLM 的逐样本评测结果来筛选代表性样本，这类集合构建成本同样高昂，且多为依赖已公开的现成数据，难以扩展到新发布的基准。
AI.method: ZipBench 是一种简单低成本的 BCM：只评测一小组锚 LLM，据此合成伪评估结果以扩大覆盖范围，学习紧凑的样本表示，并在此基础上选择一个小而具代表性的子集；方法附带理论误差与排序一致性保证。基于该方法构建了 ZipBench Zoo，包含 100+ 个覆盖文本、多模态和智能体任务的基准代理。
AI.result: ZipBench Zoo 的紧凑基准与完整基准相比，平均绝对误差为 0.002--0.02，平均 Spearman 相关系数约 0.98。
AI.conclusion: ZipBench 同时降低了 LLM 评测与紧凑基准构建的成本，降低了算力受限研究者开展广泛 LLM 研究的门槛；代码已开源于 https://github.com/MilkThink-Lab/ZipBench。

title: Confidence-Gated Transductive Test Generation for Code Reranking
summary: Test case synthesis is crucial for evaluating and ranking programs generated by large language models (LLMs). However, constructing high-quality test cases remains challenging because reliable expected outputs are often difficult to obtain. We propose Confidence-Gated Transductive Test Generation (CoTT), which first uses an efficient inductive procedure and invokes transductive generation only when inductive confidence is low. This adaptive design improves output reliability while allocating extra computation only when needed. On code reranking benchmarks, CoTT outperforms prior baselines across the reported metrics while reducing cost relative to applying transductive generation to every input. These results show that confidence-based allocation of test-time computation provides a favorable efficiency-effectiveness trade-off with a single efficient LLM.

AI.tldr: 提出CoTT（Confidence-Gated Transductive Test Generation），先用高效的归纳式生成，仅在归纳置信度低时才调用转导式生成，从而在测试用例合成中兼顾可靠性与计算成本。
AI.motivation: 测试用例合成对评估和排序LLM生成的程序至关重要，但构建高质量测试用例的难点在于难以获得可靠的期望输出。
AI.method: CoTT采用自适应的置信度门控机制：先使用高效的归纳式（inductive）流程生成测试用例；只有当归纳置信度较低时，才触发转导式（transductive）生成，从而按需分配额外计算资源。
AI.result: 在代码重排序（code reranking）基准上，CoTT在各项报告指标上均优于已有基线，同时相比对所有输入都应用转导式生成，显著降低了成本。
AI.conclusion: 基于置信度分配测试时计算量，在仅使用单个高效LLM的情况下，可实现效率与效果的良好权衡。

title: PhysioAI: Clinical Knowledge-Guided Semantic Supervision for Skeleton-Based Physiotherapy Action Recognition
comment: Includes supplementary material and ancillary data files
summary: Skeleton-based action recognition can support automated tracking of physiotherapy exercises, particularly in remote rehabilitation settings where continuous in-person supervision is impractical. However, most existing methods are developed for large-scale daily-action benchmarks rather than rehabilitation scenarios. Public rehabilitation exercise datasets are typically small, with only subtle kinematic differences between exercise classes. For participants with motor impairments, exercise execution may also deviate from standard movement patterns in amplitude, speed, and coordination, increasing intra-class variability and making reliable recognition more difficult for skeleton-based models. We propose PhysioAI, a clinical knowledge-guided semantic supervision framework that injects structured physiotherapy knowledge into skeleton representation learning. PhysioAI combines graph-based spatiotemporal modelling of human movement with training-time semantic anchors derived from a structured Clinical Knowledge Dictionary (CKD). The CKD descriptions are encoded using a frozen Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) model and projected into an anchor space, where they provide class-specific semantic targets for skeleton representation learning. The resulting CKD-derived anchors are used only during skeleton-model training; inference requires only skeleton inputs. Under subject-disjoint evaluation, PhysioAI achieves $99.03\pm1.34\%$ on KiMoRe Overall, $94.64\pm7.36\%$ on the Hard-67 stress test, and $87.44\pm7.69\%$ on UI-PRMD Overall. These results exceed the strongest comparator for each endpoint by $0.27$, $2.87$, and $1.33$ percentage points (pp), respectively. These findings demonstrate that structured clinical knowledge can serve as an effective source of training-time supervision for physiotherapy action recognition.

AI.tldr: PhysioAI 通过将结构化临床知识字典（CKD）的 CLIP 语义锚点用于训练期监督，提升骨架康复动作识别性能，在 KiMoRe、Hard-67 与 UI-PRMD 上均超越最强对比方法。
AI.motivation: 骨架动作识别可用于远程康复理疗动作的自动追踪，但现有方法多面向大规模日常动作基准，而非康复场景。康复数据集规模小、类别间运动学差异细微；运动障碍受试者的动作在幅度、速度和协调性上偏离标准模式，导致类内差异增大，识别可靠性下降。
AI.method: 提出 PhysioAI——临床知识引导的语义监督框架，将结构化理疗知识注入骨架表征学习。方法结合基于图的时空人体运动建模与训练期语义锚点；语义锚点来自结构化临床知识字典（CKD），用冻结的 CLIP 模型编码并投影到锚空间，为骨架表征学习提供类别特定的语义目标。CKD 锚点仅在训练阶段使用，推理时仅需骨架输入。
AI.result: 在受试者不重叠（subject-disjoint）评估下，PhysioAI 在 KiMoRe Overall 达 99.03±1.34%，Hard-67 压力测试达 94.64±7.36%，UI-PRMD Overall 达 87.44±7.69%，分别比各指标最强对比方法高 0.27、2.87 和 1.33 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结构化临床知识可作为理疗动作识别中有效的训练期监督来源，在推理不增加额外输入的前提下提升康复动作识别性能。

title: Information Specialization and Constrained Synthesis in Multi-Agent LLM Forecasting: A Prospective Live-Study of the 2026 FIFA World Cup
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 1 table
summary: Large language models are being organized into multi-agent systems with specialized roles, but whether such specialization produces distinct forecasts and whether subsequent synthesis improves utility remains unclear. In this study, we carried out a live, prospective evaluation over the final 56 matches of the information-dense 2026 FIFA World Cup, keeping a frontier foundation model constant while assigning two primary forecasting agents contrasting specialist roles: a quantitative specialist focusing on structured performance statistics and a news specialist focusing on current injuries, tactics and information from press conferences. Their forecasts were then reviewed by a separate critic before being combined by a meta-agent, resulting in a sequential four-agent model. Forecasts from the betting market served as an external benchmark. The news specialist obtained the highest mean probability-weighted Top-3 utility and matched the betting market in Top-3 exact-score hits. Nevertheless, the two specialist forecasters agreed on at least two of the three scorelines in 50 out of 56 matches, and the meta-agent never generated more than one scoreline outside the specialists' forecast set. These findings show that rapidly changing, unstructured information can provide a valuable forecasting signal alongside structured statistics, whereas adding critic and meta-agent stages does not necessarily create complementary information or improve on the strongest specialist.

AI.tldr: 以大模型为基础构建四智能体（定量专家、新闻专家、批评者、元智能体）预测序列，在2026世界杯最后56场比赛进行实时前瞻性评估，并与博彩市场对比。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统被广泛用于专业分工，但角色专门化是否产生差异化预测、后续的评审与综合阶段是否真正提升效用，尚缺乏实证。
AI.method: 固定同一前沿基础模型，设置两类角色对立的主要预测智能体：定量专家（结构化表现统计）与新闻专家（伤病、战术、发布会等即时非结构化信息）；其预测经独立批评者审阅后由元智能体综合，构成顺序式四智能体流程；以博彩市场预测作为外部基准，在2026世界杯最后56场比赛中做实时前瞻性评估。
AI.result: 新闻专家取得最高的平均概率加权Top-3效用，并在Top-3精确比分命中数上与博彩市场持平；然而两名专家智能体在56场中有50场至少两个比分一致，且元智能体从未给出超过一个超出专家预测集合的比分。
AI.conclusion: 快速变化的非结构化信息可与结构化统计一样提供有价值的预测信号；而增加批评者与元智能体阶段未必带来互补信息，也未必优于最强的单一专家智能体。

title: RoES: Rotational Equivariant Selective-frequency Fusion for Multimodal Images
comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26). 10 pages, 6 figures. Code: https://github.com/BryceLosky/RoES-Fusion
summary: Infrared-visible image fusion facilitates robust multimodal perception by integrating complementary textural nuances from visible sensors with thermal signatures from infrared systems.
