Due to the task's inherently ill-posed nature, existing methods heavily rely on structural priors but typically enforce rotation equivariance uniformly across all features. Such a holistic approach overlooks a critical distinction where low-frequency shared structures strictly adhere to equivariant constraints while high-frequency modality-specific details require greater flexibility to preserve unique information. To bridge this gap, we propose RoES, a Rotational Equivariant Selective-frequency fusion network. Instead of employing static decomposition, we introduce a trainable rotation-enhanced updater/predictor module to dynamically decouple low- and high-frequency components. The resulting representations are then processed through a dual-branch fusion module tailored for spectral consistency. Specifically, a rotation-equivariant Mamba is employed to capture long-range structural dependencies in the low-frequency domain, while a polar spectral attention-based Dual-Fourier block refines high-frequency details under explicit low-frequency guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RoES consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in both fusion quality and downstream object detection, establishing a robust solution for multimodal fusion by reconciling frequency-selective features with equivariant constraints. The source code is available at https://github.com/BryceLosky/RoES-Fusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoES，一种旋转等变选择性频率融合网络，用于红外-可见光图像融合。通过可训练的旋转增强更新/预测模块动态解耦高低频，结合旋转等变Mamba与双傅里叶注意力模块实现频谱一致性融合。
AI.motivation: 红外-可见光图像融合任务本身病态，现有方法依赖结构先验并对所有特征统一施加旋转等变约束，忽略了低频共享结构应严格等变、高频模态特有细节需更大灵活性的关键差异。
AI.method: 提出RoES网络：采用可训练的旋转增强updater/predictor模块动态解耦低频与高频分量；对解耦后的表示使用双分支融合模块，低频域用旋转等变Mamba捕获长程结构依赖，高频域用极坐标谱注意力双傅里叶块在低频显式引导下细化细节。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RoES在融合质量和下游目标检测任务上均持续达到最先进性能，验证了频率选择性特征与等变约束相协调的多模态融合方案的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过频率选择性等变约束，RoES为多模态图像融合提供了鲁棒解决方案，代码已开源。

title: When2Talk: When Should a Proactive In-Car Agent Talk?
summary: Proactive in-cabin agents can help passengers understand automated-vehicle (AV) behavior, but communicating every ride event may introduce unnecessary interruptions. We investigated how communication should adapt to event priority and passenger activity. In a mixed-methods within-subject study, 41 participants rode as passenger in a VR simulated fully-automated vehicle. We compared an event-triggered (ET) policy that communicated immediately at every event with a context-sensitive (CS) policy that selected \textit{Immediate}, \textit{Delayed}, or \textit{Silent} communications. CS increased communication appropriateness and substantially reduced perceived interruption. Perceived trust did not differ between policies, although baselines dispositional trust differentiated communication preferences. Findings highlight event consequence, passenger activity, continuing information value, and confirmation need as key considerations for selective in-cabin communication.

AI.tldr: 在VR模拟全自动驾驶汽车中比较事件触发与情境敏感两种车内通信策略，发现情境敏感策略更具适切性并显著降低干扰感，且不损害信任。
AI.motivation: 主动式车内智能体有助于乘客理解自动驾驶汽车行为，但事无巨细地通报每个行车事件会造成不必要的打扰，因此需探究通信策略如何随事件优先级与乘客活动状态自适应调整。
AI.method: 采用混合方法、被试内设计，41名被试在VR模拟的全自动驾驶汽车中作为乘客乘车；对比事件触发策略（每个事件即时通报）与情境敏感策略（在即时、延迟、静默三类通信间进行选择）。
AI.result: 情境敏感策略提升了通信适切性，并大幅降低感知到的干扰；两种策略在感知信任上无差异，但基线特质性信任可区分通信偏好。
AI.conclusion: 事件后果、乘客当前活动、信息的持续价值以及确认需求，是设计选择性车内通信时的关键考量因素。

title: LettuceVisSim: A Simulator That Generates Lettuce Image Time-series for Vision-Based Reinforcement Learning
comment: 45 pages, 15 figures, Submitted to Biosystems Engineering
summary: Vision-based reinforcement learning holds strong potential for decision-making in controlled environment agriculture (CEA). However, its development is hindered by the scarcity of labelled crop images. To address this gap, LettuceVisSim, a lettuce growth simulator that generates labelled time series of crop images, was developed and validated. The simulator contains a process-based model (PBM) for shoot dry weight dynamics, a canopy layout algorithm for deriving canopy layout representations from shoot dry weight, and a Unity rendering engine for image generation. Five findings support the simulator. First, the PBM reproduced shoot dry weight under dynamic plant-density management with $\mathrm{R}^{2}=0.84$. Second, a piecewise cubic regression mapped shoot dry weight to potential projected area with $\mathrm{R}^{2}=0.94$. Third, the canopy layout representation was validated using 12 experimental datasets each having different dynamic environmental and spacing conditions. It reproduced the ground coverage ratio dynamics observed in measured images, achieving $\mathrm{R}^{2}=0.84$ when driven by measured shoot dry weight and $\mathrm{R}^{2}=0.40$ (0.76 excluding one outlier) when driven by PBM-simulated values. Fourth, the Unity rendering engine converted canopy layout representations into RGB and segmentation images at less than 10~ms. Fifth, a demonstration showed that a lighting-control policy can be learned and applied by observing only crop images that were generated with LettuceVisSim, providing a proof of concept of vision-based reinforcement learning in CEA using LettuceVisSim.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发并验证了LettuceVisSim生菜生长模拟器，可生成带标注的作物图像时序数据，为受控环境农业中的视觉强化学习提供数据支持。
AI.motivation: 受控环境农业（CEA）中视觉强化学习潜力巨大，但受限于带标注作物图像的稀缺。为填补这一数据空白，作者开发了LettuceVisSim生菜生长模拟器。
AI.method: 模拟器包含三部分：用于地上部干重动态的过程模型（PBM）、由地上部干重推导冠层布局表示的冠层布局算法，以及用于图像生成的Unity渲染引擎。
AI.result: 五项发现支持该模拟器：（1）PBM在动态植株密度管理下复现地上部干重，R²=0.84；（2）分段三次回归将地上部干重映射到潜在投影面积，R²=0.94；（3）冠层布局表示经12个不同动态环境与间距条件的实验数据集验证，可复现实测图像的地面覆盖率动态，驱动量测地上部干重时R²=0.84，驱动PBM模拟值时R²=0.40（剔除一个离群值后为0.76）；（4）Unity渲染引擎在10 ms以内将冠层布局表示转换为RGB与分割图像；（5）演示表明仅通过观察LettuceVisSim生成的作物图像即可学习并应用光照控制策略。
AI.conclusion: LettuceVisSim为在CEA中开展基于视觉的强化学习提供了概念验证，可缓解标注作物图像稀缺问题。

title: ChitraMiti: Benchmarking Visual Grounding and Modality Reliance in Bengali Geometric Reasoning
summary: Evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs) for multimodal mathematical reasoning remains limited for low-resource languages and for geometry problems that require reading a diagram and a question together. We introduce ChitraMiti-12.8k, a synthetic benchmark of 12,874 Bengali planar geometry problems paired with structured 15-attribute descriptions, and NCTB-500, a complementary set of 500 diagrams manually extracted from Bengali school textbooks. Using a three-phase protocol that separates diagram-only, diagram-plus-description, and description-only inputs, we show across five open-weight and closed-source VLMs that description-only performance is statistically indistinguishable from diagram-plus-description performance, establishing structured descriptions as a sufficient textual proxy for controlled evaluation. Despite this, models remain poor at cross-modal verification, frequently misled by a swapped spatial relation even when they answer the unmodified item correctly. We further evaluate supervised adaptation on ChitraMiti-12.8k, finding that fine-tuning improves performance on both ChitraMiti-1k and NCTB-500, although a substantial gap to the strongest zero-shot model remains. Together, ChitraMiti-12.8k, NCTB-500, and our evaluation protocol offer a standardized way to study Bengali multimodal geometry reasoning and, more broadly, whether VLMs actually check their text against what they see. Our dataset and code are publicly available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/RaiyanKhaan/ChitraMiti.

AI.tldr: 本文提出孟加拉语平面几何多模态基准 ChitraMiti-12.8k（12,874 道题配 15 属性结构化描述）与 NCTB-500（500 张教科书图），并通过三阶段评测协议揭示：仅描述输入与图文联合输入性能无显著差异，说明结构化描述可作为充分文本代理；但模型跨模态校验能力薄弱，且监督微调仍与最强零样本模型存在明显差距。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）在多模态数学推理上的评测对低资源语言覆盖不足，且缺乏需要同时阅读几何图与题干的几何问题评测。孟加拉语等低资源场景缺少标准化基准，难以系统考察模型是否真正将文本与所见图像进行核对。
AI.method: 构建 ChitraMiti-12.8k 合成基准（12,874 道孟加拉语平面几何题，配结构化 15 属性描述）及 NCTB-500（500 张人工从孟加拉语教材抽取的图）。设计三阶段评测协议：仅图、图+描述、仅描述三种输入。在 5 个开放权重与闭源 VLM 上评测，并进行监督适配（微调）实验及空间关系互换的跨模态校验测试。
AI.result: 仅描述输入性能与图+描述输入在统计上无显著差异，表明结构化描述足以作为受控评测的文本代理；但模型跨模态校验表现差，即使原始题答对，也常被互换的空间关系误导。微调可提升 ChitraMiti-1k 与 NCTB-500 表现，但与最强零样本模型仍有较大差距。
AI.conclusion: ChitraMiti-12.8k、NCTB-500 与评测协议为研究孟加拉语多模态几何推理提供了标准化途径，并可用于更广泛地检验 VLM 是否真正核对文本与图像内容。数据集与代码已在 Hugging Face 公开。

title: Conditioning noise is a free regularizer for LoRA fine-tuning: no pathology encoder required for diffusion-based artifact detection in histopathology
comment: 23 pages, 3 figures. Code and laboratory record: https://github.com/kmouts/condnoise-histoqc (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22702198). Data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.22702800. Companion study: arXiv:2608.30835
summary: Diffusion-based artifact detectors score whole-slide image patches by reconstruction error under a model fine-tuned on clean tissue. We show that conditioning this fine-tuning on random Gaussian embeddings -- resampled at every step from approx. 200 KB of precomputed embedding statistics, with no encoder, no cache, and no change to inference -- consistently widens the clean/artifact separation. A four-step ablation chain shows the benefit requires neither content (shuffled real embeddings), provenance (synthetic Gaussians), a tuned intensity (flat across an 8x variance range), nor per-patch identity (fresh per-step noise); a LoRA-dropout control shows the conditioning pathway specifically, not generic weight perturbation, carries the effect. Patch-level gains of +0.25-0.48 Cohen's d replicate across nine trainings; honest leave-one-slide-out evaluation clears a pre-registered bar in 2/2 seeds; and two pre-registered external endpoints on a 281-case set confirm pooled Delta F1 = +0.0073 (95% CI) and +0.0129 (97.5% CI, two-look corrected). We release the full evaluation protocol, including measured seed noise and selection-optimism pricing.

AI.tldr: 在扩散式伪影检测器中，用约200KB预计算嵌入统计随机采样高斯嵌入对干净组织微调进行条件化，可在不改动推理的前提下持续扩大干净/伪影分离度，并经多重消融与预注册外部验证证实。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式伪影检测方法依赖在干净组织上微调的模型以重建误差评分，但干净区与伪影区的分离度有限。作者希望在不增加编码器、不缓存特征、不改动推理流程的低成本前提下，提升检测器的判别能力。
AI.method: 在干净组织微调阶段引入条件化：从约200KB预计算的嵌入统计中逐步重采样随机高斯嵌入作为条件，推理阶段保持不变。通过四步消融链检验该收益是否依赖内容（打乱真实嵌入）、来源（合成高斯）、强度调参（8倍方差范围内平坦）及逐块身份（每步新噪声），并用LoRA-dropout对照检验条件化通路的作用。评价采用9次训练的块级Cohen's d复现、留一幻灯片外评估及两项预注册外部终点（281例数据集）。
AI.result: 块级增益为+0.25～0.48 Cohen's d，在9次训练中复现；诚实的留一幻灯片外评估在2/2种子下通过预注册阈值；两项预注册外部终点确认合并Delta F1=+0.0073（95% CI）与+0.0129（97.5% CI，双次校正）。
AI.conclusion: 该条件化收益不依赖内容、来源、调参强度或逐块身份，而由条件化通路本身携带；作者公开完整评估协议，含实测种子噪声与选择乐观性定价，为低成本提升扩散伪影检测提供可复现证据。

title: One Skill Does Not Fit All: Automatic Discovery and Taxonomy-Guided Routing of Frame-Selection Skills for Long-Video Question Answering
comment: A step toward recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video understanding by enabling multimodal agents to autonomously discover, evaluate, and route reusable skills for long-video reasoning
summary: Long-Video Question Answering (LVQA) requires locating decisive evidence in hour-scale videos under a limited frame budget. Most training-free methods apply the same frame-selection strategy to all questions, despite substantial variation in the evidence required by different question types. Our analysis shows that the relative effectiveness of frame-selection strategies varies across semantic categories and benchmarks, motivating adaptive evidence acquisition. In this paper, we introduce AutoSkill, a source-supervised framework for automatically discovering and routing executable frame-selection skills. Starting from a small labelled source pool, LLM agents iteratively propose, implement, evaluate, and refine candidate skills. For a target benchmark, AutoSkill uses only unlabelled question and option text to induce a shared semantic taxonomy, rewrite labelled source examples into the target style, and estimate a category-to-skill mapping. Neither target videos nor target answers are used in this process. At inference time, each question is assigned one skill, which selects the frames used in a single inference of the frozen video MLLM. Across five long-video benchmark splits, AutoSkill improves Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3.5-4B by 2.4% and 1.2%, respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of our AutoSkill.

AI.tldr: AutoSkill：一种源监督框架，可自动发现并路由可执行的帧选择技能，实现长视频问答的自适应证据获取，在五个基准上提升冻结视频MLLM的性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答需在有限帧预算下定位小时级视频中的决定性证据。现有免训练方法对所有问题采用同一帧选择策略，但不同问题类型所需的证据差异巨大，且帧选择策略的相对有效性随语义类别和基准而变化，因此需要自适应证据获取。
AI.method: AutoSkill从一个小规模有标注源池出发，由LLM智能体迭代提出、实现、评估并精炼候选技能。针对目标基准，仅使用无标注的问题与选项文本：诱导共享语义分类体系、将已标注源示例改写为目标风格、估计类别到技能的映射（不使用目标视频与答案）。推理时，每个问题分配一个技能，由该技能选出帧，供冻结视频MLLM单次推理使用。
AI.result: 在五个长视频基准划分上，AutoSkill分别将Qwen2.5-VL-7B和Qwen3.5-4B提升2.4%和1.2%。
AI.conclusion: AutoSkill证明了自适应帧选择技能发现与路由的有效性，可在不访问目标视频与答案的条件下提升冻结视频MLLM的长视频问答性能。

title: Aligned Radiometric RGB-Thermal Fusion for UAV Facade Anomaly Screening
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Preprint. Submitted to IEEE Sensors Journal
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle facade inspection can combine red, green, and blue (RGB) imagery with thermal measurements to screen surface and subsurface anomalies. However, geometric discrepancies between the sensors and thermal image rendering can obscure spatial correspondence and weak temperature contrasts. This article presents a sensor-level pipeline comprising per-sensor correction, RGB-to-thermal registration, common-support cropping, and signed local contrast encoding of 16-bit radiometric measurements. The encoding preserves the distinction between locally hotter and colder regions and supplies the fourth input channel of a compact single-stream detector. We introduce M3T, a dataset of 674 paired RGB and radiometric thermal samples from five facade-inspection projects covering eight component and anomaly categories. The median residual registration error is 3.384 pixels, and a controlled-displacement analysis characterizes how the local contrast response changes under controlled displacement. Project-grouped four-fold evaluation yields mean average precision of 0.168 over intersection-over-union thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95, using 28.50 billion floating-point operations per image. A separate single-split ablation shows improved delamination detection over RGB-only and alternative thermal inputs, although aggregate accuracy does not improve over RGB alone. Evaluation on RGBT-Tiny shows mixed performance with rendered thermal imagery. These results characterize the category-specific benefits and limitations of aligned radiometric contrast for compact facade screening.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套传感器级RGB-热辐射配准与有符号局部对比编码流程，并发布M3T数据集，用于无人机立面缺陷检测；配准中位残差3.384像素，配准后模型mAP(0.5:0.95)为0.168，对分层缺陷有增益，但整体精度未超过纯RGB。
AI.motivation: 无人机立面巡检可结合RGB与热成像筛查表面及亚表面异常，但多传感器几何差异与热像渲染方式会破坏空间对应关系并削弱微弱温差对比，因此需要从传感器层面建立可靠的对齐与对比度编码方法，以支持紧凑型检测器利用热辐射信息。
AI.method: 构建传感器级处理管线：逐传感器校正、RGB到热像的配准、共同支撑区域裁剪，以及对16位辐射测量进行有符号局部对比编码；该编码保留局部偏热/偏冷的方向性差异，作为紧凑单流检测器的第4个输入通道。同时构建M3T数据集，包含来自5个立面巡检项目的674对RGB与辐射热样本，覆盖8类构件与异常类别；并采用按项目分组的四折评估与单划分消融实验，以及在RGBT-Tiny上的外部评估。
AI.result: 配准中位残差为3.384像素，并通过受控位移分析刻画局部对比响应随位移的变化。按项目分组四折评估在IoU 0.5–0.95上的平均精度为0.168，单图计算量为28.50 GFLOPs。单划分消融显示，相比纯RGB和替代热输入，分层（delamination）检测有所改善，但总体精度未超过纯RGB。在RGBT-Tiny上使用渲染热像的评估结果表现不一。
AI.conclusion: 对齐后的辐射对比度对紧凑型立面筛查具有类别特异性收益，主要体现在分层类缺陷，但整体精度提升有限；结果界定了该方法在配准误差、热输入形式与数据集差异下的适用边界与局限。

title: Earth-Agent-Pro: Towards Real-World Full-Chain Earth Observation with Agents
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures. The code and datasets of this work will be released soon
summary: Real-world Earth observation (EO) agents must translate high-level scientific questions into executable workflows to acquire observations, prepare data, perform domain computations, and derive conclusions from runtime evidence. Existing EO agents typically start from supplied observations, while benchmarks typically provide prepared inputs or candidate answers, leaving full-chain open-world EO execution largely untested. We present Earth-Agent-Pro, an execution-adaptive Plan-and-Execute framework using expert-authored skills to constrain planning and runtime tool use. Workflow-centered structured memory records planned steps, accepted evidence, and their dependencies, enabling repair of only the affected workflow suffix when runtime evidence invalidates a step. Separate large language model adapters use sequence-level supervised fine-tuning for planner workflow composition and node-level group relative policy optimization with locally verifiable rewards for executor tool-argument grounding. Earth-Bench-Pro instantiates 248 expert-curated task cores as 744 questions under three matched regimes. Its 248 Open-World Execution questions span RGB imagery, spectral observations, and remote sensing products, pairing high-level requests with runtime data requirements, executable trajectories, and open-ended answers grounded in execution evidence. With a shared GPT-5 backbone, Earth-Agent-Pro achieves 66.13% LLM-as-Judge accuracy, exceeding ReAct by 20.95 points in this metric and 24.44 points in Tools-In-Order. Joint adapter tuning raises Qwen3.5-9B LLM-as-Judge accuracy from 38.31% to 50.00%, an 11.69-point gain over the untuned configuration. Planning-only evaluation and execution with the reference workflow show that the adapters improve workflow composition and argument grounding, respectively. Code and datasets will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 提出 Earth-Agent-Pro 执行自适应 Plan-and-Execute 框架与 Earth-Bench-Pro 基准，用于全链路开放世界地球观测任务，性能显著超越 ReAct。
AI.motivation: 现有地球观测智能体多从已提供观测或候选答案起步，基准通常给定预处理输入，导致从高层科学问题到观测获取、数据处理、领域计算与结论推导的全链路开放世界执行能力未被充分检验。
AI.method: 采用专家编写的技能约束规划与运行时工具使用；以工作流为中心的结构化记忆记录规划步骤、已接受证据及其依赖关系，当运行时证据使某步骤失效时仅修复受影响的工作流后缀；分离式大语言模型适配器：规划器用序列级监督微调进行工作流组合，执行器用节点级 GRPO 结合局部可验证奖励进行工具参数接地。
AI.result: Earth-Bench-Pro 将 248 个专家任务核心实例化为三种匹配机制下的 744 个问题，其中 248 个开放世界执行问题覆盖 RGB 影像、光谱观测与遥感产品；共享 GPT-5 主干下，Earth-Agent-Pro 的 LLM-as-Judge 准确率达 66.13%，较 ReAct 分别高出 20.95 个百分点（LLM-as-Judge）与 24.44 个百分点（Tools-In-Order）；联合适配器调优将 Qwen3.5-9B 的 LLM-as-Judge 准确率从 38.31% 提升至 50.00%。
AI.conclusion: 规划与执行分离的适配器分别提升了工作流组合与参数接地能力，验证了执行自适应框架在全链路开放世界地球观测任务中的有效性。

title: The House with a Million Windows: Interactive Fiction for Narrative Restorying
comment: Kommers & Immel contributed equally to this research
summary: AI-assisted writing can flatten meaning in human storytelling, enabling the production of homogeneous outputs without the intentional effort and sense-making writing entails. To address this challenge, we present The House with a Million Windows (HWAMW), an LLM-based interactive fiction system designed to help users explore both the breadth and depth of potential meanings within their personal stories -- drawing on a psychological paradigm called the restorying intervention. In HWAMW, users play through a text-based narrative in which they tell a story, then encounter a set of LLM-generated "windows" reframing it according to different literary styles. Empirical evidence shows that HWAMW increases users' sense of narrative identity, while an expert review explores how this effect is achieved. Our findings suggest that HWAMW facilitates restorying and offers a valuable paradigm for AI-assisted writing, wherein LLMs do not tell our stories but rather help us see greater potential in the stories we tell.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出互动小说系统 HWAMW，借"重新叙事"心理学范式，用 LLM 生成多种"窗口"重述用户故事，帮助其探索个人故事的多元意义，避免 AI 写作带来的意义扁平化。
AI.motivation: AI 辅助写作易使人类叙事意义趋于扁平，产出同质化内容，缺失写作本应具备的意向性与意义建构过程。
AI.method: 设计并实现基于 LLM 的互动小说系统 The House with a Million Windows（HWAMW），用户以文本叙事方式讲述个人故事，随后与一组由 LLM 生成、按不同文学风格重述该故事的"窗户"互动；采用实证研究评估用户叙事认同感，并通过专家评审分析其作用机制。
AI.result: 实证结果显示 HWAMW 提升了用户的叙事认同感；专家评审进一步探讨了该效果的实现方式。
AI.conclusion: HWAMW 有助于实现"重新叙事"，为 AI 辅助写作提供了有价值的范式：LLM 不是替我们讲故事，而是帮助我们发现自己所讲故事中的更大潜能。

title: Agent as Policy for Robotic Manipulation
summary: We demonstrate that a general-purpose agent can directly drive a physical robot throughout task execution without any task-specific or environment-specific training. We introduce Agent as Policy (AGP), which places task planning and execution under the agent's control. Given a task and a robot interface, the agent interprets visual evidence, writes executable programs, issues motion commands, and revises its actions in response to physical outcomes. This brings the agent's reasoning and programming capabilities into continuous interaction with the physical world. We study AGP across multiple real-world manipulation tasks spanning precision manipulation, dynamic motions, and deformable objects. These include assembly from human videos, block construction from goal images, dice flipping, targeted throwing, and bimanual towel folding. AGP achieves success rates of at least 80% in seven of eight task configurations and significantly outperforms previous agentic robot systems. We further study efficiency through task experience accumulation and find that reusing saved procedures and programs shortens execution time across repeated trials. These findings support a path for general-purpose agents to act as robot policies, extending their autonomy to physical manipulation through runtime reasoning, programming, and interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出"智能体即策略"（AGP）框架，让通用型智能体无需任何任务或环境特定训练即可直接驱动物理机器人完成操作任务。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人策略通常依赖任务特定或环境特定的训练，泛化能力受限；作者希望验证通用型智能体能否凭借其推理与编程能力，直接充当机器人策略并适应物理世界。
AI.method: AGP将任务规划与执行置于智能体控制之下：给定任务描述与机器人接口，智能体解读视觉证据、编写可执行程序、发出运动指令，并根据物理执行结果修正自身行为，使推理与编程同物理世界形成持续交互。
AI.result: 在涵盖精细操作、动态运动和可变形物体的多类真实操作任务（人类视频装配、目标图像积木搭建、掷骰、定点投掷、双臂毛巾折叠）中，八种任务配置中的七种成功率不低于80%，显著优于以往智能体式机器人系统；同时通过任务经验积累，复用已保存的流程与程序可缩短重复试验的执行时间。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持通用型智能体作为机器人策略的发展路径，即通过运行时推理、编程与交互将其自主性扩展至物理操作领域。

title: Meddies-PII: A Multilingual Framework for Personally Identifiable Information Extraction in Clinical De-identification
summary: Clinical de-identification relies on accurately identifying personally identifiable information (PII). However, manually annotated datasets are costly to construct, while existing synthetic alternatives often provide limited details about their generation process or rely on relatively simple synthesis strategies. We introduce Meddies-PII-Dataset, a corpus of one million synthetic clinical documents spanning seventeen languages and nine PII labels. The documents are generated using attribute-conditioned prompts and validated through thirteen deterministic gates that enforce structural and annotation consistency. To evaluate the dataset's utility, we train Meddies-PII-Model, a BIOES token classifier, and compare it with existing PII extraction systems using exact-match entity-level F1. Meddies-PII-Model achieves the highest performance among the evaluated systems on all reported benchmarks, with a mean F1 of 0.827 across fifteen external benchmarks, compared with 0.658 for the strongest baseline. Upon acceptance, we will publicly release the dataset, benchmark suite, model, generation framework, and evaluation code to support research on multilingual clinical de-identification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Meddies-PII-Dataset，一个覆盖17种语言、9类PII标签的百万级合成临床文档数据集，采用属性条件提示生成并通过13个确定性校验门控验证，并训练了BIOES分词分类器Meddies-PII-Model，在15个外部基准上取得0.827平均F1，显著优于最强基线0.658。
AI.motivation: 临床去标识化依赖对个人可识别信息（PII）的准确识别，但人工标注数据集构建成本高昂，而现有合成替代方案往往生成过程披露不足或采用较为简单的合成策略。
AI.method: 构建Meddies-PII-Dataset，包含100万份合成临床文档，覆盖17种语言和9类PII标签；文档通过属性条件提示（attribute-conditioned prompts）生成，并经由13个确定性门控（deterministic gates）进行结构一致性与标注一致性校验；在此基础上训练BIOES分词分类器Meddies-PII-Model，并以实体级精确匹配F1与现有PII抽取系统对比。
AI.result: Meddies-PII-Model在所有报告的基准上均取得最优性能，在15个外部基准上平均F1为0.827，而最强基线为0.658。数据集、基准套件、模型、生成框架与评测代码将在论文录用后公开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过高质量、多语言、多标签的合成临床PII数据集及配套模型，有效缓解了临床去标识化研究中标注数据稀缺的问题，并在跨基准评测中展现出显著优势，为多语言临床去标识化研究提供公开资源支持。

title: RelateAnything: Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Relation Prediction From Any Inputs
summary: Open-vocabulary detection accepts any class list at inference, and promptable segmentation returns regions without class names: the taxonomy has left the model and become an input. Relation prediction has not. Scene-graph models are still trained and evaluated on the 50 or 56 predicates of one annotation style, their relation head conditioned on object labels and so tied to one detector. Three obstacles explain this, none primarily modelling: no relation corpus is both free-text and verified, a label-conditioned architecture cannot accept a vocabulary it was not trained on, and the standard metric rewards agreement with the training corpus, so a larger vocabulary scores as a regression. We present RelateAnything, a 53M-parameter model taking an image and regions from any source and returning scored relations over a predicate vocabulary supplied at inference as strings. Object labels are never an input, so the region source can change without retraining, and the vocabulary is a bank of text embeddings, not a learned classifier. It runs at 20 ms/frame. Training over 19,103 predicates requires positive-unlabeled supervision and a text encoder that separates antonyms, which contrastive encoders embed at cosine 0.95. To supply the supervision we build RA-4M, 474k images and 4.3M relations over 10,102 free-text predicates, generated against numbered box markers and geometrically verified. To measure it we build OV-SGG-Bench, six axes scored across datasets that the priors standard recall rewards cannot satisfy. On three cross-dataset benchmarks and a fourth zero-shot, RelateAnything has 2.3-3.5x the mean recall of the strongest open-vocabulary method of comparable scale, margins that survive a real detector, and leads a 3B-VLM scene-graph model on both metrics at under 2% of its parameters. In-domain measurement overstates transfer gains ~5x. Model, corpus and benchmark are public.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RelateAnything，一个 53M 参数的开词汇关系预测模型：以图像与任意来源的区域为输入，在推理时接受字符串谓词词表，输出带分数关系，无需对象标签输入，速度 20 ms/帧；并构建 RA-4M 语料与 OV-SGG-Bench 基准，跨数据集平均召回率达同类最强开词汇方法的 2.3–3.5 倍。
AI.motivation: 开词汇检测与可提示分割已把类别词表变为推理期输入，但关系预测仍受限于某一标注风格的 50/56 个谓词，且关系头以对象标签为条件、绑定单一检测器。作者指出三大障碍并非建模问题：缺乏既自由文本又经验证的关系语料；标签条件化架构无法接受未训练词表；标准指标奖励与训练语料的一致，导致扩大词表反而被记为性能下降。
AI.method: RelateAnything 以图像和任意来源区域为输入，谓词词表以字符串在推理时提供，表示为文本嵌入库而非学习式分类器，对象标签从不作为输入。在 19,103 个谓词上训练需正-未标注（PU）监督，以及能区分反义词的文本编码器（对比编码器会将反义词嵌到余弦 0.95）。为此构建 RA-4M：474k 图像、4.3M 关系、10,102 个自由文本谓词，基于编号框标记生成并做几何验证；同时构建 OV-SGG-Bench，含六个评估轴，覆盖先验标准召回无法满足的数据集设定。
AI.result: 在三个跨数据集基准及第四个零样本设定上，RelateAnything 的平均召回率为同规模最强开词汇方法的 2.3–3.5 倍，该优势在真实检测器下依然保持；以不足 2% 的参数在两项指标上超过 3B VLM 场景图模型。域内测量会将迁移增益高估约 5 倍。模型、语料与基准均已公开。
AI.conclusion: 关系预测可像检测与分割一样实现开词汇化：谓词词表作为推理期输入，且无需对象标签条件化，从而解耦区域来源与检测器。经几何验证的自由文本语料、PU 监督与适配反义词区分的文本编码器是关键支撑；现有域内指标会显著高估跨域迁移能力，需以多轴跨数据集基准衡量。

title: DRS-VPT: Directly Relocalizing in a Scan with Vision Point Transformers
summary: We present DRS-VPT, a feed-forward transformer architecture for foundational image-to-scan registration. Given query images and a reference 3D point cloud, the model predicts the scan pose and point map alongside the poses and point maps of each camera, all expressed in the first camera's frame. It additionally predicts a coarse-to- fine pyramid of per-point and per-pixel features for direct reprojective alignment of the scan to the first image. This formulation unifies downstream tasks such as camera-LiDAR calibration in autonomous driving and indoor camera-to-map relocalization. A single DRS-VPT model achieves state-of-the-art performance for image-to-LiDAR registration in autonomous driving, competitive indoor relocalization without training map-specific weights, and strong zero-shot transfer to unseen environments. We also show qualitatively that the model learns complex scan-to-image projection properties such as occlusion of back-facing points.

AI.tldr: 提出DRS-VPT前馈Transformer架构，实现图像到点云的基础配准，统一预测扫描位姿与点图及相机位姿，在自动驾驶标定与室内重定位任务上达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 图像与3D扫描（如LiDAR点云）之间的配准是自动驾驶相机-LiDAR标定、室内相机-地图重定位等任务的核心，但现有方法通常针对单一场景或任务设计，需要特定地图权重，缺乏统一且可泛化的基础模型。
AI.method: 提出DRS-VPT前馈Transformer架构。输入查询图像与参考3D点云，模型在第一个相机坐标系下预测扫描位姿和点图，以及各相机的位姿和点图；同时预测由粗到细的逐点与逐像素特征金字塔，用于将扫描直接重投影对齐到第一张图像。
AI.result: 单一DRS-VPT模型在自动驾驶图像-LiDAR配准上取得SOTA性能；在无需训练地图专属权重的情况下实现有竞争力的室内重定位；对未见环境具有强零样本迁移能力。定性结果显示模型学到了复杂的扫描到图像投影特性，如背面点的遮挡。
AI.conclusion: 该公式化方法统一了相机-LiDAR标定与相机-地图重定位等下游任务，验证了前馈Transformer作为图像到扫描配准基础模型的可行性与泛化性。

title: KAD-Net: Kinematics-Aware Decoupled Learning for Robust 3D Hand Pose Estimation from a Single Depth Image
summary: Due to the complexity of hand kinematics and self-occlusion, existing 3D hand pose estimation methods based on single depth images struggle to comprehensively model the topological dependencies among hand joints. Furthermore, traditional hierarchical multitask architectures enforce a shared feature space for both 2D joint localization and depth estimation, which can induce mutual interference. To address these challenges, we propose a Kinematics-Aware Decoupled Learning Network (KAD-Net) for robust 3D hand pose estimation. Specifically, we first design a Finger Topology Constraint (FTC) module to enhance the representation of distal joints. This module utilizes three consecutive finger joints to construct a local kinematic representation to impose topological constraints, which supplements the kinematic features of the distal joints. The FTC module leverages the structural context from visible joints to assist in locating occluded distal joints, thereby improving robustness to occlusion. Additionally, we propose a task-decoupled hierarchical multitask framework. This framework separates 2D joint localization from depth estimation and incorporates a dedicated multitask learning strategy for depth regression, effectively isolating the UV and depth features to mitigate mutual interference and negative transfer. Extensive experiments demonstrate that KAD-Net outperforms existing methods on several benchmark datasets (ICVL, NYU, and MSRA), achieving state-of-the-art accuracy in 3D hand pose estimation. Potential applications of KAD-Net include human-computer interaction, virtual reality and gesture-based control systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出KAD-Net（运动学感知解耦学习网络），通过手指拓扑约束模块与任务解耦的多任务框架，解决单张深度图下3D手部姿态估计的拓扑依赖建模不足与任务间干扰问题，在ICVL、NYU、MSRA数据集上达到SOTA精度。
AI.motivation: 1) 手部运动学结构复杂且存在自遮挡，现有基于单张深度图的方法难以全面建模手部关节间的拓扑依赖关系，尤其远端关节特征不足、遮挡下鲁棒性差；2) 传统分层多任务架构强制2D关节定位与深度估计共享特征空间，导致两个任务相互干扰（负迁移）。
AI.method: 1) 设计手指拓扑约束（FTC）模块：利用三根连续手指关节构建局部运动学表示以施加拓扑约束，补充远端关节的运动学特征，并借助可见关节的结构上下文辅助定位被遮挡的远端关节；2) 提出任务解耦的分层多任务框架：将2D关节定位与深度估计分离，并为深度回归引入专门的多任务学习策略，隔离UV特征与深度特征，缓解相互干扰与负迁移。
AI.result: 在ICVL、NYU、MSRA等多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，KAD-Net优于现有方法，在3D手部姿态估计上取得state-of-the-art精度。
AI.conclusion: KAD-Net通过运动学感知的拓扑约束与任务解耦设计，有效提升了遮挡鲁棒性与多任务协同效果，可应用于人机交互、虚拟现实及基于手势的控制系统等场景。

title: An Ultra-Widefield Swept-Source OCTA Dataset and a Polar-Gated Mamba Network for Retinal Vessel Segmentation
comment: Submitted to IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics. Under review
summary: Ultra-widefield (UWF) swept-source optical coherence tomography angiography (SS-OCTA) enables large-area retinal vascular imaging, yet vessel segmentation at this scale lacks dedicated public benchmarks and comprehensive evaluation for quantitative vascular analysis. We introduce WOIVES, to our knowledge the first publicly available UWF SS-OCTA vessel-segmentation dataset, comprising 206 eyes from 152 participants with a 24x20mm^2 field of view. WOIVES spans emmetropia to high myopia and provides soft probability vessel annotations. We further propose PG-Mamba, a visual state space model that enhances conventional directional scans with two complementary polar-coordinate scan orders. An auxiliary Dynamic FOV Gating module performs spatial modulation at the bottleneck. PG-Mamba outperformed seven competitive approaches on broad segmentation metrics under cross-validation. It achieved the lowest median absolute errors for vessel density, fractal dimension, and vessel length density. WOIVES is publicly available on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21904672), and the PG-Mamba code is available at https://github.com/syb1234567/PG-Mamba.

AI.tldr: 本文发布首个公开的超广角SS-OCTA血管分割数据集WOIVES，并提出PG-Mamba模型，在血管分割与定量指标上均优于七个对比方法。
AI.motivation: 超广角扫频OCT血管成像（UWF SS-OCTA）可实现大面积视网膜血管成像，但该尺度下的血管分割缺乏专用公开基准，也缺少面向定量血管分析的系统评估，制约了相关研究与临床量化应用。
AI.method: 构建WOIVES数据集：来自152名参与者的206只眼，视野24×20 mm²，覆盖正视至高�度近视，提供软概率血管标注。提出PG-Mamba视觉状态空间模型：在常规方向扫描基础上增加两个互补的极坐标扫描顺序，并在瓶颈处引入辅助的动态FOV门控（Dynamic FOV Gating）模块进行空间调制。
AI.result: 在交叉验证下，PG-Mamba在多项分割指标上优于七个竞争方法；在血管密度、分形维数和血管长度密度上取得最低中位绝对误差。
AI.conclusion: WOIVES填补了UWF SS-OCTA血管分割公开基准的空白，PG-Mamba验证了极坐标扫描与门控调制在该任务中的有效性，数据集与代码均已公开，便于后续研究与复现。

title: Calibrated Ambiguity in Multimodal Language Models: Humans reach for cultural references, while models describe the picture
comment: Kommers and Ye contributed equally to this research
summary: Ambiguity is often treated as a bug for AI systems to resolve---but in human communication and culture, ambiguity can also be a generative resource. From humour to politics to art, people express themselves in words and images that are open enough to invite different interpretations, yet constrained enough to be interpretable. We operationalise this notion of calibrated ambiguity with a task drawn from the parlour game Dixit. We compare differences in clues generated by human vs multimodal language models, based on a novel coding rubric for calibrated ambiguity, and find that models consistently exhibit ambiguity collapse (i.e., their outputs are over-specified, leaving no room for multiple legitimate interpretations). Unlike human clues, AI-generated clues also exhibit cultural flattening; they almost never make reference to culturally-situated knowledge, even when prompted to use allusion and figurative language.

AI.tldr: 该论文以Dixit桌游任务操作化"校准歧义"概念，发现多模态语言模型相较人类表现出"歧义坍缩"（输出过度具体化）与"文化扁平化"（缺乏文化情境知识引用）。
AI.motivation: 歧义通常被视为AI系统需要消解的缺陷，但在人类交流与文化中，歧义（如幽默、政治、艺术领域）反而是具有生成性的资源——表达既开放以容纳多重解释，又受约束以保证可解读。作者希望检验AI模型能否复现这种"校准歧义"能力。
AI.method: 以Dixit桌游任务操作化"校准歧义"概念，构建新的歧义校准编码量表（coding rubric），对比人类与多模态语言模型生成的线索差异。
AI.result: 模型持续表现"歧义坍缩"（ambiguity collapse），即输出过度具体化，不留多重合法解释空间；AI线索还表现出"文化扁平化"（cultural flattening），即使被提示使用典故与比喻语言，也几乎不引用文化情境化知识。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态语言模型缺乏人类式的校准歧义能力，其表达过度具体且文化贫瘠，说明在需要生成性歧义的文化交流场景中AI与人类存在系统性差异。

title: SCORE: SubDistribution-aware Collaborative Knowledge Reinforcing for Cloth-Hybrid Lifelong Person Re-Identification
comment: Accept by ECCV 2026
summary: Lifelong Person Re-Identification (LReID) aims to train a unified person retrieval model from a non-stationary data stream. Existing LReID methods mainly focus on scenarios where the clothing of each person is consistent. Recently, the Cloth-Hybrid LReID (CH-LReID) where cloth-consistent and cloth-changing data alternately occur, has emerged as a more practical and challenging scenario. Due to the conflict between clothing-relevant and clothing-irrelevant knowledge, the well-known catastrophic forgetting problem is significantly exacerbated in this task. To address this issue, we propose a SubDistribution-aware COllaborative Knowledge REinforcing (SCORE) framework, where our key idea is explicitly modeling the intra-identity diversity to continually consolidate distinct cloth-consistent and cloth-changing knowledge. Specifically, an Adaptive SubDistribution Modeling mechanism is developed, where a set of distributional subprototypes is assigned to each identity to capture the intra-identity diversity, improving the compatibility between cloth-consistent and cloth-changing knowledge. Then, a Distributional Knowledge Reinforcement scheme is introduced, where the knowledge of old distributional subprototypes is retained in the new ones by a collaborative aligning mechanism. Extensive experiments show that our SCORE achieves the state-of-the-art performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhoujiahuan1991/ECCV2026-SCORE

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCORE框架，通过显式建模身份内部多样性，在布衣混合终身行人重识别场景中协同强化衣着相关与衣着无关知识，缓解灾难性遗忘，取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 终身行人重识别（LReID）现有方法多假设每人衣着一致。更具实用性与挑战性的布衣混合LReID（CH-LReID）场景中，衣着一致与换衣数据交替出现，衣着相关与衣着无关知识之间存在冲突，导致灾难性遗忘问题被显著加剧。因此需要一种能持续整合两类知识的机制。
AI.method: 提出SubDistribution-aware COllaborative Knowledge REinforcing（SCORE）框架，核心思想是显式建模身份内部多样性。包含两个机制：（1）自适应子分布建模机制，为每个身份分配一组分布子原型以捕获身份内部多样性，提升衣着一致与换衣知识之间的兼容性；（2）分布式知识强化方案，通过协同对齐机制将旧分布子原型的知识保留到新的子原型中。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SCORE取得了state-of-the-art性能。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模身份内部多样性与分布子原型协同对齐，SCORE有效缓解CH-LReID中的灾难性遗忘，实现最优性能。

title: RA-SOD: Reliability-Aware RGB-T Salient Object Detection under Modality Degradation
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026
summary: RGB-Thermal (RGB-T) salient object detection leverages complementary cues from visible and thermal modalities to improve robustness in challenging environments. However, in real-world scenarios, the reliability of each modality is inherently unstable: RGB images degrade under low illumination, motion blur, and noise, while thermal imagery often suffers from contrast compression and sensor artifacts. Such degradation introduces unreliable perceptual evidence that can mislead cross-modal fusion and significantly deteriorate detection performance. To address this challenge, we propose RA-SOD, a reliability-aware RGB-T salient object detection framework that explicitly models modality reliability and integrates it into feature learning and cross-modal fusion. First, we introduce a reliability-conditioned representation that adaptively compensates degraded modality features while preserving structural cues. Second, an uncertainty-guided dual-stream refinement strategy progressively corrects cross-modal representations while suppressing unreliable evidence. Finally, we propose a pixel-wise modality competition mechanism that dynamically selects modality cues according to spatial reliability for fine-grained fusion. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks (VT821, VT1000, VT5000, and VT-IMAG) demonstrate that RA-SOD achieves state-of-the-art performance and exhibits strong robustness under severe modality degradation. Code and models are available at https://github.com/zaoxienian/RA-SOD.

AI.tldr: 提出可靠性感知的RGB-T显著目标检测框架RA-SOD，显式建模模态可靠性并融入特征学习与跨模态融合，在四个基准上达到SOTA并具备强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中各模态可靠性不稳定：RGB图像在低照度、运动模糊和噪声下退化，热成像常受对比度压缩和传感器伪影影响，由此产生不可靠感知证据，误导跨模态融合并显著降低检测性能。
AI.method: RA-SOD包含三个模块：1）可靠性条件表征，自适应补偿退化模态特征并保留结构线索；2）不确定性引导的双流细化策略，逐步校正跨模态表征并抑制不可靠证据；3）像素级模态竞争机制，依据空间可靠性动态选择模态线索以实现细粒度融合。
AI.result: 在VT821、VT1000、VT5000和VT-IMAG四个基准上开展大量实验，RA-SOD取得state-of-the-art性能，并在严重模态退化下表现出强鲁棒性。代码与模型已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模模态可靠性并将其贯穿特征学习与跨模态融合，可有效缓解模态退化带来的不可靠证据问题，提升RGB-T显著目标检测的精度与鲁棒性。

title: SteerDuplex: Steerable Duplex Speech Dialogue Models
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures
summary: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models support low-latency turn taking, interruption handling, and backchanneling, yet a key capability remains underexplored: steerability, the ability to reliably shift conversational behavior along attributes such as tone, persona, speaking rate, and voice style in response to user instructions. We introduce a taxonomy of text- and audio-based steerability that identifies substantial gaps in current full-duplex models. To address this gap, we introduce SteerDuplex, a Moshi-based full-duplex speech model fine-tuned on natural conversations and synthetic dialogues targeting instruction following, vocal delivery, reasoning, and duplex interaction. We further apply two-stage reinforcement learning (RL) with hybrid rewards, combining verifiable interaction checks and judge-based semantic feedback to improve timing and response continuity. To evaluate full-duplex spoken steerability, we introduce SteerBench, a benchmark with 390 spoken prompts and 1,067 human-authored binary audio and text rubrics spanning tone, persona, style/accent, and speed/length. On SteerBench, supervised training improves audio-steering average pass rate by 44.5 percentage points over the strongest evaluated open baseline. On Audio MultiChallenge, task average pass rate improves by 7 points over its strongest evaluated open baseline. RL further raises source-clean interruption response from 72.5% to 82.5% and reduces synthetic pause barge-in from 26.5% to 9%. Steering and aggregate task scores remain comparable or higher, while reward probes reveal reward hacking through incomplete responses. Our model and benchmark support systematic research on spoken steerability, with reward analysis showing why timing gains must be evaluated alongside response completeness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出全双工语音对话模型的"可操控性"（steerability）分类体系与 SteerDuplex 模型及 SteerBench 基准，通过两阶段混合奖励强化学习提升打断处理与回复连续性，在音频操控任务上显著超越现有开源基线。
AI.motivation: 全双工口语对话模型虽支持低延迟轮转、打断处理与反馈（backchanneling），但其"可操控性"——即按用户指令沿语气、人格、语速、音色等属性可靠地调整对话行为——仍缺乏系统研究。现有全双工模型在文本与音频两类操控维度上存在明显能力空白，且缺少专门的评估基准。
AI.method: 1) 提出文本与音频两类可操控性分类体系，定位现有全双工模型的差距；2) 构建 SteerDuplex：基于 Moshi 的全双工语音模型，在自然对话与面向指令跟随、发声表达、推理及双工交互的合成对话上微调；3) 采用两阶段强化学习，混合奖励包含可验证的交互检查与基于评判模型的语义反馈，以优化时序与回复连续性；4) 构建 SteerBench 基准，含 390 条口语提示与 1,067 条人工撰写的二元音/文评分细则，覆盖语气、人格、风格/口音与语速/长度四类。
AI.result: 在 SteerBench 上，监督训练相较最强开源基线将音频操控平均通过率提升 44.5 个百分点；在 Audio MultiChallenge 上任务平均通过率提升 7 个百分点；RL 阶段将源干净打断响应率从 72.5% 提升至 82.5%，并将合成停顿抢话（barge-in）从 26.5% 降至 9%；操控与整体任务分数保持相当或更高；奖励探针揭示因回复不完整导致的奖励投机（reward hacking）现象。
AI.conclusion: SteerDuplex 与 SteerBench 为口语可操控性研究提供了模型与评测基础；奖励分析表明，时序类增益必须与回复完整性联合评估，以避免不完整回复带来的奖励投机问题。

title: Global-Local Contextual Progressive Expansion Network for Martian Landslide Segmentation in Multimodal Remote Sensing Imagery
comment: 21 pages, 12 figures
summary: Automated landslide segmentation on Mars is one of the important tasks for understanding its surface processes, and all will aid in future space exploration. However, it remains a relatively underexplored open challenge because landslide morphology is highly variable, foreground regions are often sparse or irregular, and orbital observations combine heterogeneous spectral and topographic cues. In this context, this work investigates the capability of deep learning to address Martian landslide segmentation through an extensive assessment of modern neural segmentation models. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to provide such a comprehensive exploration in this domain. We further propose TransCPLES, a U-shaped network that couples Contextual Progressive Layer Expansion feature extraction with Transformer-based contextual reasoning, enabling the model to capture local geomorphic patterns and broader spatial dependencies for more reliable landslide delineation. Experiments on MMLSv2, a seven-band multimodal Martian landslide dataset, show that TransCPLES achieves the best overall performance when evaluated on geographically distinct samples, with consistent delineation across different landslide extents, stable foreground discrimination, and a favorable balance between accuracy and computational cost compared with several state-of-the-art convolutional, attention-based, and Transformer-based segmentation models. With this work, we hope to provide a useful reference and encourage further research and development in deep learning for planetary remote sensing. Code will be available after publication.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统评估现代神经分割模型在火星滑坡分割任务上的能力，并提出TransCPLES——一种结合上下文渐进层扩展特征提取与Transformer上下文推理的U型网络，在七波段多模态火星滑坡数据集MMLSv2上取得最优综合性能。
AI.motivation: 火星滑坡分割对理解其地表过程与未来空间探测具有重要意义，但该任务仍属探索不足的开放挑战：滑坡形态高度多变、前景区域稀疏或不规则，且轨道观测融合了异质的光谱与地形线索，传统方法难以应对。
AI.method: 提出TransCPLES，一种U型网络：将"上下文渐进层扩展"（Contextual Progressive Layer Expansion）特征提取与基于Transformer的上下文推理相耦合，从而同时捕获局部地貌模式与更广域的空间依赖关系，实现更可靠的滑坡轮廓刻画。同时在七波段多模态火星滑坡数据集MMLSv2上，与多种卷积、注意力及Transformer类先进分割模型进行对比评估。
AI.result: 在地理分布上具有差异的样本上评估时，TransCPLES取得最佳综合性能：对不同规模滑坡保持一致的轮廓刻画、稳定的前景判别，并在精度与计算开销之间取得良好平衡，优于多个当前最先进的卷积、注意力及Transformer分割模型。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为行星遥感中的深度学习滑坡分割提供了有价值的参考基准，并期望推动该方向在深度学习与行星遥感交叉领域的进一步研究与发展，代码将于发表后公开。

title: Geometric-to-Semantic Spherical Transfer Learning for Cortical Sulci Labeling
comment: Submitted to MICCAI 2026 on February 26, 2026; early accepted on May 7, 2026. This is the original submitted version (preprint) of the paper. The final camera-ready version will appear in the MICCAI 2026 proceedings
summary: Deep learning on cortical surfaces faces a dilemma: capturing the complex topology of over 60 nomenclature-dependent sulci per hemisphere requires high-capacity models, yet the extreme scarcity of expert annotations ($N=62$ subjects) inevitably causes overfitting. Standard supervised approaches fail to generalize in this data-scarce regime, particularly for variable and small sulci where topological ambiguity is high. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a Geometric-to-Semantic Spherical Transfer Learning framework. First, we leverage massive unlabeled data (UK Biobank, $\approx$30,000 subjects) to pre-train a spherical encoder using a locally-optimized strategy. By relying solely on continuous surface features (curvature and depth), the relevance of this pre-training is confirmed by the model's ability to detect localized and rare topological traits, such as sulcal interruptions. The downstream labeling task, however, introduces extracted sulcal fundi (lines) as an explicit semantic input. To bridge this dimensional domain gap (from purely geometric to semantic) without causing catastrophic forgetting, these anatomical lines are integrated into the pre-trained backbone via a soft-initialized Topological Prior Injector. Our experiments demonstrate that this approach outperforms fully supervised baselines trained from scratch, achieving a mean Dice of 0.77. Crucially, a local analysis reveals that the self-supervised geometric priors yield the largest performance gains on variable and tertiary sulci (up to 14.8%), confirming that learning the cortex shape is highly beneficial for identifying its rarest parts.

AI.tldr: 提出"几何到语义的球面迁移学习"框架：先在3万例无标注数据上自监督预训练球面编码器，再通过软初始化拓扑先验注入器引入脑沟底线索，解决标注稀缺（仅62例）下的皮层脑沟分割任务。
AI.motivation: 皮层表面深度学习面临两难：单半球60余条命名脑沟的复杂拓扑需要高容量模型，但专家标注极度稀缺（仅62名被试），必然导致过拟合。标准监督方法在数据稀缺场景下泛化能力差，尤其对拓扑歧义大的可变小脑沟表现不佳。
AI.method: 1）利用海量无标注数据（UK Biobank约30,000例），采用局部优化策略预训练球面编码器，仅使用曲率和深度等连续表面几何特征。2）下游标注任务引入提取的脑沟底（线）作为显式语义输入；为跨越从纯几何到语义的维度域差且避免灾难性遗忘，通过软初始化的"拓扑先验注入器"将这些解剖线条整合进预训练主干网络。
AI.result: 该方法优于从零训练的完全监督基线，平均Dice达0.77。局部分析显示，自监督几何先验在可变和三级脑沟上带来最大性能提升，最高达14.8%，表明学习皮层形状对识别其最稀有的部分极为有益。
AI.conclusion: 自监督几何预训练结合语义先验注入可有效缓解标注稀缺问题，验证了"先学皮层形状、再学语义标签"的迁移策略对稀有可变脑沟分割的价值。

title: LM-PCVMNet: Pediatric Cervical Vertebral Maturation Analysis with Deep Fusion of Landmarks and Metadata
comment: 12 pages accepted by Information Fusion
summary: Cervical vertebral maturation (CVM) assessment plays a pivotal role in orthodontic diagnosis and determining the optimal timing of treatment, especially for pediatric patients. In this paper, we propose LM-PCVMNet, a novel deep learning framework for automatic pediatric CVM staging. Specifically, our method integrates vertebral anatomical landmark information, heatmap-guided feature modulation, and metadata-informed similarity modeling into a unified learning framework. We introduce a heatmap-guided feature modulation module that enhances feature extraction by leveraging landmark-centered heatmaps to highlight morphologically relevant vertebral regions. A vertebral landmark-prompting block is designed to incorporate anatomical geometry into the representation learning process. Furthermore, we develop a learnable metadata supervised contrastive loss that adaptively modulates positive-pair similarity based on metadata similarity, enabling the model to learn more biologically consistent and discriminative features. To facilitate further research in pediatric orthodontic treatment, we additionally release PCVM+. It contains 1800 lateral cephalometric radiographs from real-world patients aged 3-15 years, with expert-annotated CVM stages, 13 vertebral anatomical landmarks, and corresponding metadata. We perform comprehensive experiments on two datasets, and the results show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively improving landmark localization and classification accuracy over existing models. Code and dataset will be available at github.com/ybupengwang/LM-PCVMNet.

AI.tldr: 提出LM-PCVMNet深度学习框架，融合椎体解剖标志点、热图引导特征调制与元数据监督对比学习，实现儿科颈椎成熟度（CVM）自动分期，并发布PCVM+数据集，在两个数据集上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 颈椎成熟度评估对正畸诊断及儿科患者治疗时机选择至关重要，但自动分期仍面临解剖结构信息利用不足、特征判别性有限等挑战，且缺乏面向儿科的真实世界数据集。
AI.method: 统一学习框架整合三类信息：热图引导特征调制模块，以标志点为中心的热图突出形态相关椎体区域；椎体标志点提示块，将解剖几何先验注入表征学习；可学习元数据监督对比损失，依据元数据相似度自适应调节正样本对相似度。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上开展综合实验，方法达到state-of-the-art，在标志点定位与分期分类精度上均优于现有模型。
AI.conclusion: LM-PCVMNet有效提升儿科CVM自动分期性能，同时发布含1800例3-15岁真实患者侧位头影X光片、专家标注CVM分期、13个椎体解剖标志点及元数据的PCVM+数据集，推动该领域后续研究。

title: SWARM: A Multilingual Human-Annotated Dataset for Russian Propaganda Detection in Search Engine Results
comment: Accepted at the 10th Workshop on Online Abuse and Harms (WOAH 2026)
summary: Russian state propaganda spreads across many languages and online spaces. Yet, most computational work examines only one such space, usually social media, in one or two languages, and analyses sources rather than content. We introduce SWARM (Search-Web documents Annotated for Russian propaganda, Multilingual), a dataset of 2,183 search engine results across nine languages and diverse web domains (e.g., news, blogs, government sites), each annotated by trained coders for whether it supports a recurring Russian propaganda narrative. We benchmark a source-based blocklist, supervised classifiers, and zero-shot LLMs against these labels. The blocklist misses most propaganda-supporting documents, because such content is not confined to flagged "propaganda" outlets but also appears on mainstream ones. Content-level analysis helps, though how much depends on the model: the strongest LLM reaches a positive-class F1 of 0.73, whereas the supervised classifiers reach only about 0.5, with the smaller LLMs over-predicting support, mistaking topical relevance for endorsement. Detecting search-borne propaganda thus requires per-language, content-level evaluation, which we hope SWARM and our evaluation code enable.

AI.tldr: 提出SWARM数据集（2,183条搜索引擎结果，覆盖9种语言与多类网络域名，标注是否支持俄方叙事），并基准测试黑名单、监督分类器与零样本LLM，发现基于来源的黑名单漏检严重，内容级分析更有效但效果依赖模型。
AI.motivation: 既有计算研究多局限于单一社交媒体空间、一两种语言，且侧重分析信息"来源"而非"内容"，难以刻画跨语言、跨域名的俄方宣传传播全貌。
AI.method: 构建SWARM数据集：收集2,183条搜索引擎结果，覆盖9种语言及新闻、博客、政府站点等多样域名，由受训标注员逐条判定其是否支持反复出现的俄方宣传叙事；据此对来源黑名单、监督分类器和零样本LLM进行基准评测。
AI.result: 来源黑名单漏检大多数支持宣传的文档，因这类内容并非仅存在于被标记的"宣传"媒体，也出现在主流媒体上；内容级分析有增益但依模型而异：最强LLM正类F1达0.73，监督分类器仅约0.5，较小LLM过度预测支持，将主题相关误判为立场支持。
AI.conclusion: 检测搜索引擎传播的宣传需进行分语言、内容层面的评估，作者期望SWARM数据集与评测代码能推动该方向研究。

title: LifeMem: Enabling Lifelong Experience Reuse for LLM Agents
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Large language model agents are expected to continuously adapt to new tasks and environments over their lifetime by reusing past experience. However, existing memory-based agents struggle to transfer reusable experience across environments and suffer from catastrophic forgetting as experience accumulated. To address these challenges, we propose LifeMem, a lifelong learning framework that enables agents to transfer knowledge across multiple environments. During learning, LifeMem clusters accumulated interaction trajectories based on underlying workflows to extract reusable skills. When solving a new task at inference time, the agent recalls relevant skills and trajectories to guide actions. To validate our method, we conduct experiments across 10 environments and over 13k tasks with 2k newly annotated interaction trajectories. Results show that LifeMem enables effective experience reuse in lifelong learning, achieving both reduced forgetting on learned tasks and superior cross-task transfer. Further analysis reveals that task streaming impacts learning, while consolidating structurally similar trajectories within memory boosts performance.

AI.tldr: 提出LifeMem终身学习框架，通过聚类交互轨迹提取可复用技能，实现跨环境知识迁移并缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有基于记忆的LLM智能体难以将可复用经验跨环境迁移，且随经验积累出现灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: 学习阶段按潜在工作流对累积交互轨迹聚类以提取可复用技能；推理阶段检索相关技能与轨迹引导动作。
AI.result: 在10个环境、超13k任务及2k条新标注轨迹上验证：降低对已学任务的遗忘并实现更优的跨任务迁移；任务流顺序影响学习，记忆内结构化相似轨迹的整合可提升性能。
AI.conclusion: LifeMem支持有效的经验复用，兼顾抗遗忘与跨任务迁移，为LLM智能体的终身学习提供可行方案。

title: What Did the MLLM Hear? Token-Level Spectro-Temporal Grounding for Audio MLLM Explainability
summary: Audio-based Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can generate detailed natural-language descriptions of complex acoustic scenes, yet it remains unclear which parts of the input audio support each generated token. This is particularly challenging because acoustic evidence is distributed across time and frequency, and concurrent sound events may overlap temporally while occupying different spectral regions. We introduce STAG, to our knowledge the first post-hoc framework for token-level spectro-temporal grounding of captions generated by audio-based MLLMs. STAG estimates the temporal support for each generated token using target-token-specific vocabulary projections of the encoded audio representations, measures frequency-band relevance through controlled spectral occlusion, and combines the two signals into a spectro-temporal relevance map. We evaluate STAG against ten post-hoc explanation methods across four grounding benchmarks, where it achieves the best event-localization performance on every dataset, and apply it to eight audio-language backbones without parameter updates. Counterfactual deletion further shows that removing the identified evidence selectively reduces confidence in the corresponding event and frequently removes it from the regenerated caption. These results provide behavioral support for the faithfulness and selectivity of the explanations.

AI.tldr: 提出STAG，首个面向音频多模态大模型生成caption的token级时频归因（grounding）事后解释框架。
AI.motivation: 音频MLLM能生成复杂声学场景的自然语言描述，但哪些输入音频部分支撑了每个生成token尚不清楚；声学证据分布在时间与频率上，且并发声事件可能在时间上重叠而占据不同频谱区域，使token级归因尤为困难。
AI.method: STAG为事后（post-hoc）框架：1）利用目标token特定的词表投影，从编码音频表示估计每个生成token的时间支撑；2）通过受控频谱遮挡（spectral occlusion）测量频带相关性；3）融合两类信号得到时频相关性图。
AI.result: 在四个grounding基准上与十种事后解释方法对比，STAG在每个数据集上均取得最佳事件定位性能；无需参数更新即应用于八种音频-语言骨干模型。反事实删除实验表明，移除所识别证据会选择性降低对应事件的置信度，并常使其从重新生成的caption中消失。
AI.conclusion: 结果为解释的忠实性（faithfulness）与选择性（selectivity）提供了行为层面的支持，STAG可作为音频MLLM的可插拔token级时频归因工具。

title: Beyond Ambiguous Visual Cues: Studying Physiological Disruptions and Cross-Modal Inconsistencies in Deepfake Videos
summary: Recent deepfake detection studies increasingly suggest remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) signals as an authenticity cue. However, existing benchmarks lack physiological ground truth, and current detectors underexplore the cross-level relationship between facial features and physiological dynamics, often relying on late fusion or rPPG features alone. In this paper, we construct high-fidelity deepfake manipulations on established real rPPG datasets (COHFACE and UBFC-rPPG) to investigate how forgeries disrupt natural physiological signals and facial behavior at the same time. Building on this analysis, we propose a bidirectional co-attention fusion detector that jointly models rPPG and facial behavior tokens. This mechanism explicitly captures the cross-level dependencies between pulse dynamics and facial motion to learn a robust, joint authenticity representation. Extensive experiments using a subject-disjoint 5-fold evaluation demonstrate the superiority of our approach. Achieving a 92.80\% AUC on constructed datasets using face swapping and 96.78\% AUC on motion transfer, our model outperforms both the rPPG-only single modality baseline and the best feature-level fusion methods. Furthermore, transfer-learning result of the fusion detector on Celeb-DF-v2 while keeping both feature extractors fixed achieves 91.20\% accuracy and 86.08\% AUC, which suggests applicability under target-domain adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该文构建带生理真值的高保真换脸数据集，提出rPPG与面部行为的双向共注意力融合检测器，性能超越单模态及特征级融合基线。
AI.motivation: 现有deepfake检测基准缺乏生理真值，检测器多依赖晚期融合或仅用rPPG特征，未充分挖掘面部特征与生理动态的跨层级关联。
AI.method: 在真实rPPG数据集COHFACE与UBFC-rPPG上构造高保真伪造样本，分析伪造对生理信号与面部行为的影响；提出双向共注意力融合检测器，联合建模rPPG与面部行为token，显式捕捉脉搏动态与面部运动的跨层级依赖。
AI.result: 主体不重叠5折评估下，换脸数据集AUC达92.80%，运动迁移达96.78%，优于rPPG单模态基线及最佳特征级融合方法；固定双特征提取器迁移至Celeb-DF-v2达91.20%准确率、86.08% AUC。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在生理真值基准上验证了跨层级生理-行为融合的有效性，并展现目标域自适应下的迁移适用性。

title: Doc2FRC: Length-Consistent Document-Level Machine Translation via Fixed-Range Chunking
comment: To appear in Proceedings of the Eleventh Conference on Machine Translation (WMT2026)
summary: Advanced large language models (LLMs) with long context windows can substantially reduce input truncation in document-level machine translation (DocMT). However, direct Doc2Doc translation remains prone to n-gram repetition and progressive quality degradation. A common remedy is to segment the document into finer-grained chunks. Nonetheless, conventional rule-based chunking approaches fail to handle the length distribution mismatch between training and inference. To address this, we introduce Fixed-Range Chunking (FRC), utilizing dynamic programming to partition documents into chunks within a predefined length interval. By consistently applying FRC during training and inference, the input documents of any length are mapped to the same length distribution, substantially reducing train-test length mismatch. Centered on FRC, we propose a lightweight dual-boundary matching algorithm for chunk alignment, alongside four distinct training strategies. Experimental results show that FRC-based fine-tuning substantially improves 7B LLMs over direct Doc2Doc fine-tuning and outperforms existing DocMT methods on IWSLT2017. We further construct GlobVDoc, a 10-language test set independent of mainstream DocMT training sources, and show that FRC improves out-of-distribution document translation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出固定范围分块（FRC），通过动态规划将文档划分为预设长度区间内的块，统一训练与推理的输入长度分布，缓解文档级机器翻译中的长度失配、n-gram重复与质量退化问题。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM虽能减少文档级机器翻译的输入截断，但直接Doc2Doc翻译仍易出现n-gram重复与质量渐进下降。细粒度分块是常见补救手段，但传统规则分块无法处理训练与推理之间的长度分布失配。
AI.method: 提出Fixed-Range Chunking (FRC)：利用动态规划将文档切分为落在预定义长度区间内的块，并在训练与推理阶段一致应用，使任意长度文档映射到同一长度分布；围绕FRC设计轻量级双边界匹配算法用于块对齐，并提出四种训练策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于FRC的微调在7B LLM上显著优于直接Doc2Doc微调，并在IWSLT2017上超越现有DocMT方法；额外构建10语种测试集GlobVDoc（独立于主流DocMT训练来源），显示FRC能提升分布外文档翻译表现。
AI.conclusion: FRC通过动态规划分块与训练-推理一致的长度分布映射，有效缓解DocMT的长度失配与退化问题，提升同分布与分布外文档翻译质量。

title: Automated Distinction of Intimal and Medial Intracranial Arterial Calcification from CT Head
comment: Accepted at the Stroke and neurovascular diseases Workshop on Imaging and Treatment CHallenges @ MICCAI 2026
summary: Intracranial arterial calcifications (IACs) are a common finding on clinical non-contrast enhanced head CT scans and are associated with neurovascular disease. Calcifications can occur in the intimal or medial layer of the arterial wall, subtypes that differ in aetiology and may have distinct clinical relevance. These subtypes can be visually distinguished by radiologists based on the shape of the calcifications. We investigate three automated approaches for subtype classification of IAC from head CT-derived segmentation masks: (1) an automated adaptation of the established radiological visual score, (2) a sphericity-based method, and (3) a method based on shape embeddings extracted by a medical shape foundation model. All approaches use the same lightweight classification pipeline on top of the features they compute and are evaluated using 5-fold cross-validation. The three methods achieved comparable performance, with the embedding-based approach yielding the best overall results with a weighted F1 (mean $\pm$ SD) of up to 71.5 $\pm$ 3.7 for a single artery and 59.8 $\pm$ 1.7 for the joint artery classification. Performance was largely preserved when using automated instead of manual IAC segmentation masks, and we found the difference in weighted F1 not significant. Our results show that fully automated IAC subtype quantification from head CT is feasible and remains robust to the use of manual and automated IAC segmentation masks. Code at https://github.com/bjin96/iac-subtyping.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了三种自动识别颅内动脉钙化（IAC）亚型的方法：放射学视觉评分自动化、基于球形度的方法以及医学形状基础模型提取的形状嵌入方法，其中嵌入方法表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 颅内动脉钙化是头部CT常见发现，与神经血管疾病相关，可分内膜和中膜亚型，二者病因和临床意义不同，但现有诊断依赖放射科医生目视区分，缺乏自动化亚型量化手段。
AI.method: 基于头部CT分割掩膜，采用统一的轻量级分类流程，分别使用（1）自动化放射学视觉评分、（2）基于球形度的特征、（3）医学形状基础模型提取的形状嵌入三种特征，并以5折交叉验证评估。
AI.result: 三种方法性能相当，基于嵌入的方法最佳，单动脉加权F1最高达71.5±3.7，联合动脉分类为59.8±1.7；使用自动分割掩膜与手动分割性能差异不显著。
AI.conclusion: 全自动IAC亚型量化在头部CT上可行，且对使用手动或自动分割掩膜均具有稳健性。

title: Detecting and Explaining Fake News Short Videos with Multimodal Content and Real-World Evidence
comment: Accepted to the Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Short-video platforms have become a primary news source for the public, which has also enabled the widespread dissemination of fake news videos. We study the task of fake news video detection and explanation (FNVDE). Existing methods face two critical limitations. First, commonly used frame selection strategies may omit veracity-relevant cues or provide insufficient temporal context for understanding news videos. Second, prior methods neglect either multimodal understanding or evidence retrieval. To address these limitations, we propose NVKE-CEI, a unified system that integrates a news video keyframes extraction method (NVKE) and an FNVDE framework leveraging both content and evidence information (CEI). NVKE selects keyframes based on chronological changes in combined visual and OCR-text similarity. CEI employs two specialized LLM-based fact checkers (content-based and evidence-based) whose outputs are fused by a lightweight judge model. Extensive experiments show that NVKE-CEI outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while generating high-quality content-grounded explanations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究假新闻视频检测与解释（FNVDE）任务，提出NVKE-CEI统一系统，通过结合视觉与OCR文本相似度的时序变化提取新闻视频关键帧（NVKE），并融合内容与证据信息（CEI）的双LLM事实核查器输出进行判定，实验证明其优于现有基线并生成高质量解释。
AI.motivation: 短视频平台已成为公众主要新闻来源，同时也导致假新闻视频广泛传播。现有FNVDE方法存在两大局限：一是常用帧选择策略可能遗漏与真实性相关的线索，或提供的时序上下文不足；二是既有方法忽视了多模态理解或证据检索中的某一方。
AI.method: 提出NVKE-CEI统一系统，包含两部分：NVKE（新闻视频关键帧提取），基于视觉与OCR文本联合相似度的时序变化选择关键帧；CEI（FNVDE框架），利用内容与证据信息，采用两个专门的基于LLM的事实核查器（内容型与证据型），其输出由一个轻量级判定模型融合。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，NVKE-CEI优于最先进的基线方法，同时能生成高质量的、基于内容的解释。
AI.conclusion: NVKE-CEI通过改进关键帧提取与融合内容及证据的双重核查机制，有效提升了假新闻视频检测性能与解释质量。

title: NOVA-GS: Noise-Aware View-Consistent Gaussian Splatting for Low-Light Novel View Synthesis
comment: Accepted to the 3D4S Workshop at CVPR 2026; selected for the Best Paper Award
summary: Reconstructing 3D scenes under real-world low-light conditions remains challenging due to severe sensor noise, low signal-to-noise ratios, and degraded photometric consistency, which destabilize geometry estimation and novel view synthesis. Existing approaches often rely on well-lit reference data for reliable Structure-from-Motion (SfM) initialization under degraded inputs or apply per-view enhancement methods that introduce cross-view inconsistencies. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{NOVA-GS}, a unified noise-aware framework for low-light 3D Gaussian Splatting that subsumes enhancement, denoising, and geometry optimization within a single process. Our method leverages VGGT-based feed-forward estimation to obtain robust camera poses and geometry directly from degraded inputs, eliminating the need for SfM. Building on this initialization, NOVA-GS integrates three coupled components: a structure-aware enhancement module for exposure correction, a self-supervised denoising module with blind-spot masking for pseudo-supervision, and a consistency-driven Gaussian Splatting optimization enforcing cross-view geometric coherence. We further introduce a noise-guided spherical harmonic regularization to suppress view-dependent artifacts in noisy regions. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world low-light datasets demonstrate improved geometric fidelity, color consistency, and robustness without requiring paired supervision or well-lit references. https://shaurya2524.github.io/nova-gs/

AI.tldr: NOVA-GS：面向低光照3D高斯泼溅的统一噪声感知框架，融合增强、去噪与几何优化，无需SfM与配对监督。
AI.motivation: 真实低光照条件下的3D重建面临传感器噪声严重、信噪比低、光度一致性退化等问题，导致几何估计与新视角合成不稳定。现有方法或依赖良好光照参考数据来做SfM初始化，或采用逐视图增强而引入跨视图不一致。
AI.method: 提出NOVA-GS统一框架，将增强、去噪与几何优化纳入单一流程。基于VGGT前馈估计直接从退化输入获取鲁棒相机位姿与几何，免除SfM依赖。框架包含三个耦合模块：结构感知增强模块用于曝光校正；自监督去噪模块配合盲点掩码进行伪监督；一致性驱动的3DGS优化以强制跨视图几何一致。此外引入噪声引导的球谐正则化以抑制噪声区域的视图相关伪影。
AI.result: 在多个真实低光照数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在几何保真度、颜色一致性与鲁棒性方面均有提升，且无需配对监督或良好光照参考。
AI.conclusion: NOVA-GS通过统一噪声感知流程有效缓解低光照下3D重建的初始化与一致性问题，为无参考、无配对监督的低光照3DGS重建提供了可行方案。

title: Residual Vector-based Reconstruction as Long-Context Recall Regardless of Context Window Size
summary: Large language models (LLMs) process long contexts, including long documents and lengthy conversations, but face token-level memory usage that increases proportionally to input length. Although model optimization and lossy prompt compression are widely used, these methods still fail to solve the long-context recall problem beyond pretrained and size-constrained context windows. This paper proposes a long-context recall method that maintains near-constant GPU memory usage as context length increases, without additional training. The main idea is to reconstruct facts using parameter activations in the LLM's feed-forward layers, which store residual vectors representing facts from the source document. Utilizing residual vectors allows the LLM to deterministically reconstruct query relevant facts without referencing the original document, preserving high fidelity and reducing memory usage without fine-tuning weights. Experimental results show that the proposed method enables answering single-fact questions in two-million-token story contexts where previous methods fail.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需额外训练的长上下文召回方法，利用LLM前馈层参数激活中的残差向量重构事实，使GPU显存占用随上下文增长保持近恒定，可在两百万token的故事上下文中回答单事实问题。
AI.motivation: LLM处理长文档和长对话时长上下文场景时，token级显存占用随输入长度线性增长；模型优化与有损提示压缩虽广泛使用，但仍无法解决超出预训练及尺寸受限上下文窗口的长上下文召回问题。
AI.method: 无额外训练的长上下文召回方法：基于LLM前馈层参数激活重构事实，这些激活中存储了代表源文档事实的残差向量；利用残差向量在不再引用原始文档的情况下确定性地重构与查询相关的事实，无需微调权重即可保持高保真并降低显存占用。
AI.result: 实现了随上下文长度增加GPU显存占用近恒定；在以往方法失败的两百万token故事上下文中，能够回答单事实问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过前馈层残差向量重构事实的召回范式，可在不训练、不引用原文的条件下突破长上下文召回瓶颈，为超长上下文场景提供高效高保真方案。

title: Semantically Aligned Gradient-Driven Context-Preserving Image Editing
summary: Instruction-guided image editing has a training-time blind spot. Generative editors are never required to semantically verify whether their outputs actually satisfy the instruction. Supervision stops at reconstruction and input textual-level conditioning. This produces incomplete edits, spatial spillover, and poor localization. We present IABEdit, a model-agnostic framework that embeds differentiable semantic verification into training. A frozen vision-language model extracts spatially-aware descriptors from the ground-truth edit. A trainable aligner then reproduces them from the generated output. The residual between the two becomes a gradient that teaches the generator both what to edit and where, with no inference-time VLM cost. IABEdit is compatible with diverse backbones, including U-Net (Stable Diffusion) and MMDiT (FLUX), without altering their inference pipelines. On MagicBrush, it improves structural fidelity by +3.49 DINO-I over the best diffusion baseline and +1.26 over the best overall baseline, while remaining competitive on instruction alignment. It also achieves state-of-the-art instruction adherence performance on RealEdit and EMU Edit benchmarks based on embedding-based metrics. Most consequentially, on the D-LORD surveillance benchmark, it surpasses the proprietary Gemini agent by +5.13 DINO-P under heavy occlusion, where preserving identity is hardest. This shows that gradient-aligned VLM distillation holds up under real-world-like surveillance and occlusion conditions. Human and GPT-4o evaluations confirm perceptually precise, well-localized edits.

AI.tldr: 提出IABEdit，一种模型无关的训练框架，通过将冻结视觉语言模型的空间语义验证以可微方式嵌入训练，使生成编辑器学会"改什么、改哪里"，无需推理期VLM开销。
AI.motivation: 指令引导图像编辑存在训练期盲点：生成编辑器从不被要求语义验证输出是否真正满足指令，监督仅止于重建与输入文本级条件，导致编辑不完整、空间溢出和定位不佳。
AI.method: 用冻结VLM从真实编辑图像提取空间感知描述子，训练一个对齐器从生成输出复现这些描述子，二者残差作为梯度，指导生成器同时学习编辑内容与位置。框架模型无关，兼容U-Net（Stable Diffusion）与MMDiT（FLUX），不改变推理流程。
AI.result: MagicBrush上结构保真度较最佳扩散基线提升+3.49 DINO-I，较最佳总体基线+1.26，指令对齐保持竞争力；在RealEdit与EMU Edit上取得基于嵌入指标的SOTA指令遵循性能；在D-LORD监控基准重遮挡下较专有Gemini agent高+5.13 DINO-P。人类与GPT-4o评估确认编辑感知精确、定位良好。
AI.conclusion: 梯度对齐的VLM蒸馏在类真实监控与遮挡条件下依然有效，验证了将可微语义验证纳入训练这一范式的可行性与泛化性。

title: ExpertHTR: Unified Handwritten Text Recognition with Multi-Task Learning and Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Handwritten text recognition resources are often small and distributed across collections that differ in language, script, document structure, and annotation format, making joint page-level training difficult. We propose ExpertHTR, a unified vision-language framework that addresses this problem through complementary supervision and conditional model capacity. Structural annotations from heterogeneous datasets are first organized through a common Page-Region-Line representation and used to construct four related training tasks for complete transcription, physical-line coverage, text localization, and localized recognition, without requiring additional manual labels. Building on a jointly trained dense model, ExpertHTR introduces a sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture with an always-active shared branch and conditionally routed full-MLP experts. Sparsegen allows the number of active routed experts to vary with the hidden representation, while routing regularization reduces persistent concentration on a small subset of experts. Experiments on seven heterogeneous handwriting benchmarks show that complementary supervision consistently improves training with page transcription alone, while joint multi-source training provides further gains on most datasets. The proposed sparse expert model further improves the dense baseline on six of the seven sources. The final unified model also substantially outperforms the evaluated general-purpose OCR and vision-language systems on most benchmarks and achieves state-of-the-art performance on the IAM paragraph-level benchmark, while specialized HTR systems remain stronger on several challenging collections.

AI.tldr: 提出 ExpertHTR 统一视觉-语言框架，通过互补监督与条件化模型容量实现异构手写文本识别的联合页面级训练。
AI.motivation: 手写文本识别资源规模小且分散于语言、文字系统、文档结构和标注格式各异的集合中，跨集合联合页面级训练困难。
AI.method: 以统一的 Page-Region-Line 表示组织异构结构标注，构建完整转写、物理行覆盖、文本定位与局部识别四项互补任务，无需额外人工标注；在联合训练稠密模型基础上引入稀疏混合专家架构，包含常激活共享分支与条件路由的全 MLP 专家，并通过 Sparsegen 使激活路由专家数随隐表示变化，配合路由正则化抑制专家集中。
AI.result: 在七个异构手写基准上，互补监督相较仅页面转写训练持续提升；多源联合训练在多数数据集上进一步增益；稀疏专家模型在七个来源中的六个上优于稠密基线；最终统一模型在多数基准上大幅超越通用 OCR 与视觉-语言系统，并在 IAM 段落级基准达到最优，但若干困难集合上专用手写识别系统仍更强。
AI.conclusion: 互补监督与条件化专家容量可有效支撑异构手写文本的联合训练，统一模型具备较强通用性，但在部分挑战性数据集上仍不及专用系统。

title: Anatomy-Change-Aware Bidirectional Selective State-Space Memory for Clinically Deployed Thoracic Radiotherapy Auto-Contouring
summary: We developed DAMM-Net++, a 2.5D architecture for thoracic OAR and target volume segmentation that addresses three persistent challenges in radiotherapy auto-contouring: inter-slice surface incoherence, systematic failure on small low-contrast targets, and the absence of per-case reliability signals. The central component is an anatomy-change-aware bidirectional selective state-space memory that models through-plane anatomical change and selectively propagates context along the axial slice sequence. A boundary-aware decoder sharpens near-surface predictions, and an uncertainty head provides calibrated per-voxel confidence for clinical triage. We evaluated 2,146 patients across four centers, an independent external cohort of 112 patients, and a multicenter reader study involving 17 radiation oncologists on 305 cases. The model achieves a mean Dice of 0.955 and HD95 of 3.78 mm, with the largest gains on low-contrast organs-at-risk (OARs) and target volumes where through-plane context is most critical. The uncertainty head is well-calibrated and supports case-level triage. In the reader study, AI assistance reduced contouring time by 75-80% across experience levels and raised junior-reader IoU from 0.861 to 0.925, matching the unedited model. External validation showed a modest internal-to-external drop (< 5%) with calibrated uncertainty transferring without recalibration. The complete deployment pipeline from DICOM ingestion to TPS-compatible RTSTRUCT export has been integrated into the clinical workflow at a partner hospital, where it is used to assist with contouring. These results suggest that anatomically motivated inter-slice memory, paired with uncertainty-guided review, offers a clinically viable path for thoracic auto-contouring.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DAMM-Net++，一种面向胸部危及器官(OAR)与靶区分割的2.5D架构，通过解剖变化感知的双向选择性状态空间记忆、边界感知解码器与不确定度头，解决层间表面不一致、小低对比靶区失效及缺乏逐病例可靠性信号三大问题，并在多中心与读者研究中验证其临床可行性。
AI.motivation: 放疗自动勾画面临三个持续挑战：层间表面不连贯、对小尺寸低对比度靶区的系统性失效，以及缺少逐病例可靠性信号。现有方法未能有效建模贯层解剖变化并给出可信的不确定度评估。
AI.method: 提出2.5D架构DAMM-Net++，核心为解剖变化感知的双向选择性状态空间记忆，建模贯层解剖变化并沿轴位切片序列选择性传播上下文；辅以边界感知解码器锐化近表面预测，并用不确定度头输出逐体素标定置信度以支持临床分诊。评估涵盖四个中心2146例患者、112例外部队列，以及17名放疗医师对305例的多中心读者研究。部署流程从DICOM输入到TPS兼容的RTSTRUCT导出。
AI.result: 平均Dice为0.955，HD95为3.78 mm，在贯层上下文最关键的低对比OAR与靶区上增益最大；不确定度头标定良好并支持病例级分诊。读者研究中，AI辅助使各经验层级勾画时间减少75–80%，并将初级读者IoU从0.861提升至0.925，达到未编辑模型水平。外部验证内部到外部下降轻微(<5%)，标定不确定度无需重标定即可迁移。完整部署管线已集成于合作医院临床流程并用于辅助勾画。
AI.conclusion: 解剖学驱动的层间记忆结合不确定度引导的人工复核，为胸部自动勾画提供了一条临床可行路径，兼具高精度、良好泛化性与实际部署价值。

title: Multimodal Floorplan Encoding: Learning Dense Modality-Invariant Representations
comment: Presented at the ECCV 2026 TwinWorld Workshop
summary: Floorplans arise in many forms, from vector CAD drawings to raster renderings and sensor-derived density maps. This heterogeneity makes it difficult to build learning systems that transfer across modalities and support geometry-centric tasks such as alignment and retrieval. We introduce the Multimodal Floorplan Encoder (MMFE), which maps diverse 2D indoor representations into a shared dense latent grid. MMFE combines a frozen DINOv3 backbone with a trainable Dense Prediction Transformer (DPT) head, and is trained with a per-cell Information Noise-Contrastive Estimation (InfoNCE) objective that aligns spatially corresponding regions across modalities while using all other cells as negatives. To improve robustness to geometric distortions, we incorporate controlled similarity transformations and enforce geometric consistency through feature-grid warping. On Structured3D, a held-out out-of-domain dataset, MMFE improves cross-modal dense matching, enables robust similarity alignment with RANSAC, and yields strong retrieval when paired with learned aggregation.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态平面图编码器（MMFE），将多种2D室内平面图表示映射到共享的稠密隐网格，实现跨模态密集匹配、相似变换对齐与检索。
AI.motivation: 平面图形式多样（矢量CAD图、栅格渲染图、传感器密度图等），这种异构性使得构建可跨模态迁移并支持几何中心任务（如对齐与检索）的学习系统十分困难。
AI.method: MMFE结合冻结的DINOv3主干与可训练的稠密预测Transformer（DPT）头；采用逐单元InfoNCE目标对齐跨模态空间对应区域，并以其他所有单元为负样本；引入受控相似变换及特征网格变形以保证几何一致性，提升对几何畸变的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在留出的域外数据集Structured3D上，MMFE提升了跨模态稠密匹配效果，实现了基于RANSAC的鲁棒相似对齐，并在与学习式聚合结合时取得强检索性能。
AI.conclusion: MMFE为异构平面图表示提供了统一的稠密隐空间编码方案，有效支撑跨模态几何对齐与检索任务，并在域外数据集上验证了泛化能力。

title: GRACE: Adaptive Concept Erasure with Geometry-Guided Retention in Diffusion Models
comment: 14 pages,12 figures
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models inevitably internalize sensitive or non-compliant concepts from large-scale pretraining data, necessitating post-hoc concept erasure. However, existing erasure methods often lack explicit constraints on parameter updates, leading to over-intervention and unintended semantic drift. In addition, many methods rely on manually crafted counterfactual supervision, such as surrogate prompts, which incurs substantial data construction costs that limit scalability to new concepts. To address these limitations, we propose GRACE, a structured concept erasure framework designed to enable localized and selective intervention. Specifically, we introduce a semantically weighted sensitive subspace estimation to precisely lock intervention directions, and employ lightweight subspace-constrained adapters to prevent global semantic disturbance. To eliminate the dependency on manual prompt engineering, we design an automatically decoupled safe-anchor mechanism. To mitigate semantic drift induced by excessive intervention, we introduce an energy-driven dynamic gating mechanism that adaptively controls the timing and strength of intervention at inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a superior balance between erasure effectiveness and generation fidelity. Compared with the average performance of five state-of-the-art (SOTA) concept erasure methods, our method improves the fine-grained NSFW reduction rate by $17.86\%$, while reducing the macro-averaged target CLIP Score and preservation-oriented Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) by $4.75\%$ and $50.58\%$, respectively, indicating stronger concept suppression with substantially improved preservation of the original model's generative utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRACE，一种结构化概念擦除框架，通过语义加权敏感子空间、子空间约束适配器、自动解耦安全锚机制与能量驱动动态门控，实现局部选择性干预，在擦除效果与生成保真度间取得更优平衡。
AI.motivation: 文生图扩散模型会内化敏感或不合规概念，需事后概念擦除；但现有方法缺乏对参数更新的显式约束，导致过度干预与语义漂移；且多依赖人工构造的替代提示等反事实监督，数据构建成本高、难以扩展到新概念。
AI.method: GRACE包含四个核心设计：1）语义加权敏感子空间估计，精确锁定干预方向；2）轻量子空间约束适配器，防止全局语义扰动；3）自动解耦安全锚机制，消除对人工提示工程的依赖；4）能量驱动动态门控机制，在推理时自适应控制干预时机与强度，缓解过度干预引起的语义漂移。
AI.result: 相比五种SOTA概念擦除方法的平均性能，本方法将细粒度NSFW降低率提升17.86%，同时将宏平均目标CLIP Score与面向保持的FID分别降低4.75%和50.58%，表明概念抑制更强且原模型生成效用保持显著改善。
AI.conclusion: GRACE通过结构化、局部化的选择性干预，有效解决了参数更新缺乏约束与人工监督成本高的问题，实现了擦除有效性与生成保真度之间的优越平衡，具备良好的可扩展性。

title: Physics-Guided Synthetic High-Frequency Ultrasound Generation for Skin Layer Segmentation
comment: 12 pages, accepted at MICCAI DH4H Workshop 2026
summary: High-frequency ultrasound (HFUS) enables noninvasive visualization of superficial skin structures, but automated skin-layer analysis is limited by the scarcity of densely annotated data. Existing real HFUS datasets commonly provide annotations for superficial targets such as the epidermis and subepidermal low-echogenic band (SLEB), while dense labels for deeper structures such as dermis, subcutaneous tissue, fascia, and muscle are rarely available. We propose a physics-guided synthetic HFUS generation framework for skin layer segmentation. The framework constructs multilayer acoustic skin phantoms, assigns layer dependent acoustic properties, and uses k-Wave simulation to generate paired synthetic HFUS images, dense layer masks, and simulation metadata. To evaluate whether the generated data provide transferable supervision, we use it for downstream segmentation pretraining and fine-tune the models on real Mendeley HFUS data. Synthetic pretraining followed by real fine-tuning achieved real-domain performance comparable to real-only training and improved mean Dice/IoU in three of four evaluated trainable architectures. These results suggest that physics-guided synthetic HFUS images contain transferable anatomical and textural cues for real-domain skin layer segmentation, although further reduction of the synthetic-real appearance gap is needed to enable greater gains. The code and data are available at: https://github.com/Finn-02/synthetic-hfus-skin-layer-segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出物理引导的合成高频超声（HFUS）生成框架，用于皮肤分层分割：构建多层声学皮肤体模、赋予层相关声学属性，并用k-Wave仿真生成配对合成图像、密集层掩膜与仿真元数据。将其用于下游分割预训练，再在真实Mendeley HFUS数据上微调，可达到与纯真实训练相当的域内性能，四个可训练架构中三个的Dice/IoU提升。
AI.motivation: HFUS可无创显示浅表皮肤结构，但皮肤分层自动分析受限于密集标注数据稀缺。现有真实HFUS数据集通常只标注表皮、表皮下低回声带（SLEB）等浅表目标，而真皮、皮下组织、筋膜、肌肉等深层结构的密集标签很少可得。
AI.method: 构建多层声学皮肤体模，为各层分配层相关声学属性；使用k-Wave仿真生成成对的合成HFUS图像、密集分层掩膜及仿真元数据；将该数据用于下游分割预训练，并在真实Mendeley HFUS数据上微调模型，与纯真实数据训练进行对比评估。
AI.result: 合成预训练+真实微调在真实域性能上与纯真实训练相当，并在四个可训练架构中的三个上提升了平均Dice/IoU。
AI.conclusion: 物理引导的合成HFUS图像包含可迁移的解剖与纹理线索，可用于真实域皮肤分层分割；但仍需进一步缩小合成-真实外观差距以获得更大增益。代码与数据已开源。

title: AquaCubeAI-Powered Monitoring Turbidity on-board Φsat-2
comment: 16 pages, the paper is under review on IEEE JSTARS
summary: Timely monitoring of coastal water quality is critical for environmental protection, yet conventional satellite workflows rely on downlink and ground processing, introducing latency that can limit responsiveness to rapidly evolving turbidity events. To address this limitation, we propose AquaCubeAI, a lightweight machine-learning approach for onboard estimation of coastal water turbidity from Φsat-2 multispectral imagery. By shifting inference from the ground segment to the satellite, AquaCubeAI aims to enable lower-latency, more responsive, and more operationally useful turbidity monitoring under the strict compute and bandwidth constraints of spaceborne platforms.
