The model is trained on simulated Φsat-2 acquisitions spatially aligned with Copernicus Marine Service (CMEMS) High-Resolution Ocean Color (HR-OC) turbidity products over selected localized coastal sites spanning four European marine macro-regions. To provide a realistic evaluation of generalization in the presence of spatial correlation, we adopt a spatial block splitting protocol that mitigates data leakage between training and evaluation subsets. The main contributions of this work are: (i) a scalable dataset generation pipeline pairing simulated Φsat-2 multispectral patches with CMEMS HR-OC turbidity labels across selected localized European coastal sites; (ii) a compact Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP)-based turbidity regressor trained under a leakage-aware geospatial split and tailored to embedded constraints; and (iii) a reformulation for dense spatial prediction via parameter sharing, enabling turbidity mapping and simple threshold-based anomaly masks for onboard decision logic. Embedded deployment on an Intel Myriad Vision Processing Unit (VPU) further confirms the feasibility of low-power hardware and supports low-latency inference from multispectral inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出AquaCubeAI，一种可在星上运行的轻量机器学习方法，利用Φsat-2多光谱影像直接估计近岸水体浊度，以降低时延并提升监测响应能力。
AI.motivation: 传统卫星水质监测依赖下行传输与地面处理，存在明显时延，难以快速响应浊度突变事件；同时星载平台受算力与带宽严格约束，需要将推理前移至卫星端。
AI.method: 构建可扩展数据集生成流程，将模拟的Φsat-2多光谱影像块与CMEMS HR-OC高分辨率浊度产品在选定的欧洲近岸站点上空间对齐；采用空间分块划分协议以避免训练与评估子集间的数据泄漏；训练紧凑的MLP浊度回归器，并通过参数共享重构实现稠密空间预测与阈值异常掩膜。
AI.result: 在Intel Myriad视觉处理单元（VPU）上完成嵌入式部署验证，证明该方法可在低功耗硬件上实现多光谱输入的低时延推理，并支持面向星上决策逻辑的浊度制图与简单阈值异常检测。
AI.conclusion: AquaCubeAI表明在星载算力与带宽约束下，将浊度反演推理迁移至卫星端具有可行性，可提升近岸水质监测的时效性与业务可用性。

title: What Drives Recovery in Agentic Text-to-Cypher? LAST-CQ: An LLM Agent Self-Refinement Framework
comment: Accepted at REALM: The 2nd Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models at Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026), 15 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
summary: Agentic pipelines for structured-query generation are rapidly expanding, but it is unclear which part of the loop produces the gain. We use LAST-CQ -- a five-agent, training-free, execution-grounded Text-to-Cypher framework -- as an instrumented testbed, running three counterfactuals over 2,471 live-database queries and six backbones spanning three vendor scale tiers. Removing correction is worth between 3.1% aggregate execution-BLEU against the single-pass system and 12.3% against a no-refinement counterfactual (up to 80.7% for the weakest backbone). Replacing schema-grounded, LLM-synthesised feedback with raw database error strings costs almost nothing (20.9% vs. 19.9% naive exact match; <0.2% end-to-end; equivalent within $\pm 0.075$ set-F1 by two one-sided tests). Spending the same call budget on parallel sampling degrades quality by 10-11%. What works is detecting failure and routing it to a retry, not the feedback sophistication or number of samples. LAST-CQ itself recovers 91.7% of queries that fail under single-pass generation, while a query that succeeds first time still costs exactly one LLM call. We also show that n-gram overlap on serialised results is not a bound in either direction: it over-scores against set equivalence on 65.9% of results while under-scoring against judged semantics. Finally, we calibrate our LLM judge against blind human labels and find it optimistic by 9 points.

AI.tldr: 该论文以五智能体、免训练、执行反馈驱动的 Text-to-Cypher 框架 LAST-CQ 为受控测试平台，通过三组反事实实验（2,471 条真实数据库查询、6 个骨干模型、3 个厂商规模层级）拆解代理式流水线的增益来源，结论是增益主要来自"失败检测与重试路由"，而非反馈的精细程度或采样数量。
AI.motivation: 代理式结构化查询生成流水线迅速普及，但其循环中究竟是哪个环节带来性能提升尚不明确，缺乏对增益来源的归因分析。
AI.method: 以 LAST-CQ 为可插桩测试平台，在 2,471 条实时数据库查询、6 个骨干模型（覆盖 3 个厂商规模层级）上运行三组反事实实验：移除纠错环节、以原始数据库错误字符串替代 schema 接地且由 LLM 合成的反馈、以及将同等调用预算用于并行采样。同时用串行化结果上的 n-gram 重叠与集合等价、语义评判做对比，并以盲标注人工标签校准 LLM 评判器。
AI.result: 移除纠错相对单遍系统损失 3.1% 聚合执行 BLEU，相对无精炼反事实损失 12.3%（最弱骨干高达 80.7%）；以原始数据库错误字符串替代 schema 接地反馈几乎无代价（20.9% vs. 19.9% 朴素精确匹配，端到端差异 <0.2%，双侧单边检验下 set-F1 差异在 ±0.075 内等价）；同等调用预算用于并行采样反而使质量下降 10-11%。LAST-CQ 可恢复 91.7% 单遍失败的查询，且一次成功的查询仍只消耗一次 LLM 调用。n-gram 重叠并非任一方向的界：对 65.9% 的结果相对集合等价高估，相对人工语义评判则低估。LLM 评判器相较盲标注人工标签乐观约 9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 代理式流水线的核心价值在于失败检测与重试路由，而非反馈的复杂程度或样本数量；粗糙的原始错误反馈已足够，纠错机制是不可或缺的一环。同时，基于串行化结果 n-gram 重叠的自动指标不能作为集合等价或语义正确性的有效界，且 LLM 评判器存在系统性乐观偏差，需以人工标签校准。

title: ProtoCAM: Interpretable Few-Shot Mask-Guided Prototypical Learning for Breast Lesion Classification in Ultrasound Imaging
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures
summary: Breast ultrasound imaging plays an important role in the early detection and diagnosis of breast cancer, particularly for patients with dense breast tissue. However, developing reliable deep learning models for ultrasound analysis is challenging due to limited annotated medical data and the need for interpretable predictions. To address these challenges, this paper proposes ProtoCAM, an explainable few-shot learning framework for breast lesion classification that integrates mask-guided feature encoding, prototypical metric learning, and gradient-based visual explanations. The proposed approach leverages lesion masks to guide feature extraction and constructs class prototypes within an embedding space to enable robust classification under limited training samples. The framework was evaluated on the BUSI dataset using a stratified group k-fold cross-validation protocol to prevent patient-level data leakage. Experimental results demonstrate ProtoCAM's high performance in low-data scenarios. In a 3-way 5-shot setting, the proposed method achieves a macro F1-score of 0.910, representing a substantial improvement over standard supervised CNN models. Among the evaluated backbone networks, ResNet18 achieved the best performance, reaching a macro F1-score of 91.65% under a 15-shot configuration, providing interpretable insights into the classification decisions. These results highlight the potential of explainable few-shot learning frameworks for reliable computer-aided breast cancer diagnosis in data-scarce medical imaging environments.

AI.tldr: 提出ProtoCAM——一个融合掩膜引导特征编码、原型度量学习与梯度可视化解释的可解释小样本学习框架，用于乳腺超声病灶分类，在BUSI数据集上于低数据场景取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 乳腺超声对致密型乳腺的早期检测与诊断很重要，但医学标注数据有限，且深度学习模型缺乏可解释性，导致可靠的超声分析模型难以构建。
AI.method: ProtoCAM整合三项技术：利用病灶掩膜引导特征提取；在嵌入空间中构建类别原型以进行原型度量学习，实现少样本下的稳健分类；采用基于梯度的可视化解释。在BUSI数据集上使用分层分组k折交叉验证协议，避免患者级数据泄漏。
AI.result: 在3-way 5-shot设置下宏F1达0.910，显著优于标准监督CNN；各骨干网络中ResNet18表现最佳，在15-shot配置下宏F1为91.65%，并提供可解释的分类决策依据。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可解释小样本学习框架在数据稀缺的医学影像环境下，对可靠的计算机辅助乳腺癌诊断具有应用潜力。

title: Same Encoder, Different Winner: A Paired-View Framework for Cell Painting Encoder Evaluation
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures
summary: Vision encoders for Cell Painting are typically ranked by a single evaluation, commonly replicate mean average precision (mAP). We introduce CP-BG-Bench, a paired-view evaluation framework that holds the central cell fixed across four matched views (raw crop C, segmented S, and density-augmented variants CD and SD), ablating or augmenting surrounding pixels as a controlled intervention. Instantiating the framework on three datasets (JUMP-CP, RxRx1, RxRx3-core) and three encoders (DINOv3 ViT-B/16, OpenPhenom, SubCell) under four community-standard protocols (replicate mAP, scIB batch integration, CellProfiler feature prediction, cross-batch perturbation recall), we find that the four protocols rank the same encoders systematically differently, with disagreements decomposing along three axes: cell versus background, morphology versus context, and within-study versus across-batch. The largest effect: on RxRx3-core, SubCell with segmented inputs retains 94% of crop replicate mAP but only 32% of crop R@10, so the within-study signal preserved under segmentation is largely non-transferable; density augmentation recovers 84% of the within-study C-to-S gap but only 8% of the cross-batch gap. Segmented views predict CellProfiler features as well as or better than crops on two of three datasets, inverting the replicate-mAP ranking, and the C-to-S gap varies by an order of magnitude across datasets while remaining similar across encoders, indicating that background-driven gain is set by experimental design rather than by the encoder. Single-metric ranking of Cell Painting encoders is therefore sensitive to the protocol used, and protocol disagreements are interpretable as projections onto the three axes the paired-view design exposes. We will release the paired-view datasets, reconstruction pipelines, 36 trained checkpoints, aggregated embeddings, and the full evaluation suite.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CP-BG-Bench配对视图评测框架，在保持中心细胞一致的前提下比较原始裁剪、分割及密度增强视图，发现四种社区标准协议对同一批Cell Painting编码器给出系统性不同的排序，分歧可沿"细胞vs背景、形态vs语境、研究内vs跨批次"三轴分解。
AI.motivation: Cell Painting视觉编码器通常仅用单一指标（如replicate mAP）排名，但该指标无法区分模型究竟依赖细胞形态还是背景/语境信息，可能导致评测结论片面甚至误导模型选择。作者希望建立一种可控干预的评测方式，揭示不同协议之间的分歧来源。
AI.method: 提出CP-BG-Bench配对视图评测框架：固定中心细胞，构造四种匹配视图（原始裁剪C、分割S、密度增强变体CD与SD），以对周围像素进行消融或增强作为受控干预。在三个数据集（JUMP-CP、RxRx1、RxRx3-core）和三个编码器（DINOv3 ViT-B/16、OpenPhenom、SubCell）上，采用四种社区标准协议（replicate mAP、scIB批次整合、CellProfiler特征预测、跨批次扰动召回）进行评测，并将协议分歧分解为三轴。
AI.result: 四种协议对同一批编码器的排序系统性不同，分歧沿三轴分解。最大效应出现在RxRx3-core上：SubCell使用分割输入保留了94%的裁剪replicate mAP，但仅保留32%的裁剪R@10，说明分割下保留的研究内信号大多不可迁移；密度增强可恢复84%的研究内C-to-S差距，但仅恢复8%的跨批次差距。分割视图在三个数据集中的两个上预测CellProfiler特征不劣于甚至优于裁剪，逆转了replicate-mAP排序；C-to-S差距在数据集间相差一个数量级，而在编码器间保持相近，表明背景驱动的增益由实验设计而非编码器决定。
AI.conclusion: 单指标排名Cell Painting编码器对所用协议高度敏感，而协议间的分歧可解释为配对视图设计所揭示三轴上的投影。作者将发布配对视图数据集、重建流程、36个训练检查点、聚合嵌入及完整评测套件。

title: MPT: Missing Prototype Tracking via Barycentric Reconstruction in Vehicular Federated Learning
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures
summary: Cross-vehicle federated learning enables vehicles to collaboratively improve perception models while keeping locally collected driving data private. However, vehicle participation is transient, and a vehicle may depart before training converges while permanently taking its local data. When this departing vehicle holds most samples of a target class, the class becomes rare in the remaining FL network, and its recognition can silently degrade as the shared backbone continues to evolve. Recovering the class is difficult since the few remaining samples provide a noisy prototype estimate, while FL privacy constraints prevent centralized access to raw data or per-sample features. This paper presents MPT, a cross-vehicle FL framework that maintains rare-class recognition by reconstructing its prototype at every round from privacy-preserving class-level statistics. MPT combines a barycentric decomposition that tracks drift shared with remaining-class prototypes, a covariance-based residual prediction that estimates out-of-span drift, and an adaptive calibration that weighs the remaining rare-class samples according to their reliability. We evaluate MPT on three vehicle classification tasks and four backbones against representative calibration and drift-compensation baselines. MPT outperforms all baselines in rare class F1, reaching 0.516 on the nuImages dataset with only 1\% of rare-class samples remaining, without raw data, per-sample features, or retraining.

AI.tldr: MPT：一种跨车辆联邦学习框架，在每轮训练中用隐私保护的类级统计量重建稀有类原型，以缓解车辆退出导致稀有类识别退化的问题，在nuImages上稀有类F1达0.516。
AI.motivation: 跨车辆联邦学习虽能保护本地驾驶数据隐私，但车辆参与具有瞬态性：持有某目标类多数样本的车辆可能在训练收敛前永久退出并带走本地数据，使该类在剩余FL网络中变为稀有类，其识别能力随共享主干持续演化而悄然退化。恢复该类很困难：剩余少量样本只能给出带噪的原型估计，且FL隐私约束禁止集中访问原始数据或逐样本特征。
AI.method: MPT在每一轮中基于隐私保护的类级统计量重建稀有类原型，包含三个组件：（1）重心分解，用于追踪与剩余类原型共享的漂移；（2）基于协方差的残差预测，用于估计跨度外（out-of-span）漂移；（3）自适应校准，按可靠性对剩余稀有类样本进行加权。
AI.result: 在3个车辆分类任务和4种主干网络上，与代表性校准和漂移补偿基线对比，MPT在稀有类F1上均优于所有基线；在nuImages数据集上仅保留1%稀有类样本时，F1达到0.516，且无需原始数据、逐样本特征或再训练。
AI.conclusion: MPT通过仅利用隐私保护的类级统计量重建稀有类原型，可有效维持跨车辆联邦学习中的稀有类识别性能，且不违反FL隐私约束。

title: LG-PF: Lightweight Confidence-Guided Polarization Image Fusion
summary: Polarization image fusion combines the stable luminance and structural information of the total- intensity image S0 with the material-sensitive details of the degree of linear polarization (DoLP) image. However, the reliability of DoLP varies spatially, and indiscriminate polarization transfer may amplify unstable responses or disturb the structural appearance anchored by S0. We therefore propose LG-PF, a lightweight confidence-guided framework that formulates polarization fusion as a selective residual transfer process. A Polarization Confidence Prior estimates spatially reliable polarization responses, a Mask-guided Multi-scale Fusion module regulates their transfer across three feature scales, and a Lightweight Context-aware Bounded Correction Head stabilizes local photometric and structural transitions. Confidence guidance is also incorporated into the optimization objectives to preserve reliable polarization details while suppressing unsupported responses. We also construct MSP, a multi-scene polarization fusion dataset containing 1000 pixel-aligned image pairs from 17 indoor and outdoor scene categories. LG-PF achieves the best results across all six evaluated metrics on MSP, while subset-based evaluations on PIF and GAND show promising transferability without fine-tuning. With only 0.2936 M parameters and an inference time of 21.712 ms per image, LG-PF achieves competitive fusion quality with low computational cost. The source code will be available at https://github.com/1hzf/LG-PF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轻量级置信度引导的偏振图像融合框架LG-PF，将融合建模为选择性残差迁移过程，并构建了多场景偏振融合数据集MSP。
AI.motivation: 偏振图像融合旨在结合S0图像的稳定亮度与结构信息，以及DoLP图像对材质敏感的细节；但DoLP可靠性存在空间差异，无差别迁移会放大不稳定响应或干扰S0所锚定的结构外观。现有方法缺乏对偏振响应可靠性的显式建模。
AI.method: LG-PF将偏振融合表述为选择性残差迁移过程：1）偏振置信先验（Polarization Confidence Prior）估计空间上可靠的偏振响应；2）掩膜引导多尺度融合模块（Mask-guided Multi-scale Fusion）在三个特征尺度上调控其迁移；3）轻量上下文感知有界校正头（Lightweight Context-aware Bounded Correction Head）稳定局部光度与结构过渡。置信度引导还被纳入优化目标，以保留可靠偏振细节并抑制无支撑响应。此外构建MSP数据集，含17类室内外场景的1000对像素对齐图像。
AI.result: LG-PF在MSP数据集全部六项评价指标上均取得最佳结果；在PIF和GAND上的子集评估显示出无需微调的良好迁移性。模型仅0.2936 M参数，单图推理时间21.712 ms，以低计算成本实现有竞争力的融合质量。
AI.conclusion: LG-PF通过置信度引导的选择性残差迁移，有效解决了DoLP空间可靠性差异问题，在保证融合质量的同时实现了轻量化与良好泛化性，源代码将开源于https://github.com/1hzf/LG-PF。

title: Cognition on Graph: Navigating Massive Knowledge Space via Cognitive Cycles and Bidirectional Graph-Text Synergy
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has empowered Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle knowledge-intensive tasks. However, navigating global, heterogeneous knowledge bases (large-scale knowledge graphs and text corpora) for complex reasoning remains a challenge. Existing methods typically employ reactive, graph-driven exploration strategies, which blindly follow graph topology without adapting to the question context or evolving exploration progress, and lack deep bidirectional synergy between graph and text. To address these limitations, we propose CoG (Cognition on Graph), a cognitive-inspired, training-free framework for adaptive knowledge exploration. Drawing inspiration from human problem-solving, CoG performs a continuous plan-explore-reflect cycle, where it proactively formulates investigation plans, performs dual-source retrieval, and dynamically reflects on progress to adjust strategies. Crucially, it establishes deep bidirectional synergy between structured graph and unstructured text, where entities extracted from text dynamically guide graph exploration to bridge knowledge gaps. Extensive experiments on seven multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that CoG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods while achieving superior exploration efficiency. Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/zhougengxian/CoG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoG（Cognition on Graph），一种受认知启发的、免训练的自适应知识探索框架，通过"规划-探索-反思"循环和图文双向协同，在七个多跳QA基准上超越现有方法并提升探索效率。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法在全局异构知识库（大规模知识图谱与文本语料）上进行复杂推理时存在不足：其采用反应式、图驱动的探索策略，仅盲目遵循图拓扑结构，无法适应问题上下文或演化的探索进展，且图与文本之间缺乏深度双向协同。
AI.method: 提出CoG框架，受人类问题求解启发，执行连续的"规划-探索-反思"循环：主动制定调查计划、进行双源检索、动态反思进展以调整策略；并在结构化图与非结构化文本之间建立深度双向协同，由文本中抽取的实体动态引导图探索以弥合知识缺口。该框架无需训练。
AI.result: 在七个多跳QA基准上的大量实验表明，CoG显著优于当前最先进方法，同时实现了更优的探索效率。
AI.conclusion: CoG通过认知启发的自适应探索与图文双向协同，有效解决了异构知识库上的复杂推理难题，验证了其性能与效率优势，代码与数据集已开源。

title: LGFN: Lightweight Gated RGB-Polarization Fusion with Modality-Availability Conditioning for Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: Camouflaged object detection (COD) is an important engineering task in intelligent optical perception, but it remains challenging when targets closely resemble their surroundings. Polarization imaging provides complementary physical cues, whereas existing methods typically assume fixed multimodal input configurations and entangle intra-polarization coordination with interaction between red-green-blue (RGB) and polarization representations. We propose LGFN, a lightweight gated RGB-polarization fusion framework supporting separately optimized RGB-only and polarization-assisted configurations. A deterministic Modality Router selects the appropriate configuration according to polarization availability. In the multimodal configuration, an availability-conditioned Modality Gate calibrates the available polarization branches; the Gated Polarization Hub coordinates learned degree of linear polarization (DoLP) and angle of polarization (AoP) representations with explicit polarization cues; and RGB-Polarization Cross Fusion introduces the coordinated representation into the RGB hierarchy through controlled residual interaction. The multimodal configuration requires neither sample-dependent statistics nor handcrafted quality descriptors during inference. On the complete 230-image PCOD_1200 test set, the RGB-only configuration achieves a mean absolute error of 0.0090, a Dice score of 0.8806, and an intersection over union of 0.8144, obtaining the best results on all six metrics among the evaluated RGB-based methods. Under a common local reevaluation protocol, the multimodal configuration outperforms PolarNet and IPNet on all six metrics. Relative to IPNet, it reduces the parameter count, floating-point operations, and latency by 53.1%, 73.6%, and 63.0%, respectively. The source code will be available at https://github.com/1hzf/LGFN.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级门控RGB-偏振融合框架LGFN，支持RGB-only与偏振辅助两种配置，通过确定性模态路由器自适应选择，在PCOD_1200上取得最优性能并显著降低参数量与计算量。
AI.motivation: 伪装目标检测中目标与背景高度相似，检测困难；偏振成像可提供互补物理线索，但现有方法假定固定的多模态输入配置，并将偏振内部协调与RGB-偏振表征交互纠缠在一起，缺乏灵活性与轻量化设计。
AI.method: LGFN包含确定性Modality Router按偏振可用性选择配置；多模态配置下，可用性条件Modality Gate校准可用偏振分支，Gated Polarization Hub协调学习的DoLP与AoP表征及显式偏振线索，RGB-Polarization Cross Fusion通过受控残差交互将协调表征引入RGB层级。推理时无需样本相关统计或手工质量描述子。
AI.result: 在完整230幅图像的PCOD_1200测试集上，RGB-only配置取得MAE 0.0090、Dice 0.8806、IoU 0.8144，在评估的RGB方法中六项指标均最优；在通用局部重评估协议下，多模态配置六项指标全面超越PolarNet与IPNet，相比IPNet参数量、FLOPs与延迟分别降低53.1%、73.6%、63.0%。
AI.conclusion: LGFN以轻量门控融合实现RGB与偏振的灵活协同，兼顾单模态与多模态配置，在精度与效率上均优于现有方法，代码将开源。

title: Online Video Agent Harness for Long Video Understanding
comment: 35pages, 12 tables, 10 figures
summary: Long video understanding often behaves like a visual needle-in-a-haystack problem: query-relevant evidence is sparsely distributed across long temporal spans, while packing dense frames into a single VLM context incurs \textit{context rot} and high cost. Existing video agents often rely on query-agnostic offline preprocessing or ad hoc tool sets, which can miss query-specific details and waste computation. In this work, we present VideoXAgent, a purely online video-agent harness for long video understanding that starts from the given video file and user query, plans and decomposes the task, invokes specialized expert tools on demand, and aggregates multimodal evidence to produce a final answer while resolving conflicts among observations. To support this on-demand invocation, we design a suite of heterogeneous expert tools guided by a data-driven taxonomy of atomic capabilities, spanning scripts, VLMs, and domain models (e.g., detection, OCR, ASR, face recognition). The harness further enforces objective evidence prompting and budget-aware control to curb hallucination and non-termination. Across Video-MME-Long, LongVideoBench-Long, LVBench, and MINERVA, VideoXAgent is competitive with frontier LMMs and video agents under a smaller context footprint---about 50k tokens of agent context per sample, even on hour-long videos. In particular, on complex video-reasoning benchmarks such as MINERVA, it matches this level while using only about 15\% of the context of a 1,024-frame dense-packing baseline. Notably, the harness remains effective with a visually weak or even text-only orchestrator, suggesting that strong long-video understanding can emerge from progressive agentic evidence seeking rather than from packing the full video into a single context. Project page: https://go-agent-x.github.io/video_agent_harness/

AI.tldr: 提出 VideoXAgent——纯在线长视频理解智能体框架：从视频与查询出发自主规划任务、按需调用异构专家工具（脚本/VLM/领域模型），聚合多模态证据并解决冲突，用约 50k token 的轻量上下文在多个长视频基准上达到前沿水平。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解类似"视觉大海捞针"：查询相关证据稀疏分布于长时间跨度，而将密集帧塞入单一 VLM 上下文会引发 context rot（上下文退化）且成本高昂。现有视频智能体多依赖查询无关的离线预处理或临时拼凑的工具集，容易遗漏查询特定细节并浪费算力。
AI.method: 1) 纯在线 harness：以视频文件与用户查询为输入，进行任务规划与分解；2) 基于数据驱动的原子能力分类法，设计跨脚本、VLM 与领域模型（检测、OCR、ASR、人脸识别等）的异构专家工具套件，按需调用；3) 聚合多模态证据生成答案，并解决观测间冲突；4) 采用客观证据提示与预算感知控制，抑制幻觉与非终止。
AI.result: 在 Video-MME-Long、LongVideoBench-Long、LVBench、MINERVA 上，以更小上下文占用（每样本约 50k token，即使小时级视频）与前沿 LMM 及视频智能体持平。在 MINERVA 等复杂视频推理基准上，达到同等水平仅用 1,024 帧密集打包基线约 15% 的上下文。且即使编排器视觉能力弱甚至纯文本，框架仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 强长视频理解可源自渐进式的智能体证据寻取，而非把整段视频塞进单一上下文；该工作为长视频理解提供了高效、可扩展的在线智能体范式。

title: SCDM: Spatial-Contextual Disentanglement Mamba via Differential Inference for Efficient Image Classification
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures
summary: State Space Models (SSMs), particularly VMamba, have emerged as efficient alternatives for modeling long-range dependencies in medical image analysis. However, distinguishing subtle pathological features from visually similar anatomical backgrounds remains a significant challenge. Existing SSM architectures often learn entangled representations, lacking explicit mechanisms to separate disease-specific signals from normal anatomy. To address this limitation, we propose Spatial-Contextual Differential Mamba (SCDM), an asymmetric dual-branch architecture designed for selective representational disentanglement. SCDM introduces a Positive Branch for extracting discriminative features and a Negative Branch that actively models and suppresses normal anatomical context. This separation is achieved through a similarity-driven repulsion gate and a differential inference rule, which promote competitive feature learning without requiring additional branch labels or increasing model capacity. Evaluated on the RSNA Pneumonia dataset, SCDM achieves competitive classification performance (AUC of 0.858) while requiring significantly fewer parameters (29.4M) and FLOPs (1.44G) compared to standard VMamba and vision transformer baselines. Furthermore, activation analyses demonstrate that our differential mechanism yields highly precise localization, effectively isolating lesions by inhibiting irrelevant anatomical distractors.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出空间上下文差分Mamba（SCDM），通过非对称双分支架构实现选择性表征解耦，在肺炎分类任务中以更少参数与计算量取得竞争性性能，并实现精准病灶定位。
AI.motivation: 现有基于状态空间模型（SSM）的医学图像分析方法（如VMamba）虽能高效建模长程依赖，但其学习到的表征往往是纠缠的，缺乏显式机制将疾病特异信号与正常解剖结构分离，导致难以从视觉相似的组织背景中区分细微病理特征。
AI.method: 提出SCDM非对称双分支架构：正分支（Positive Branch）提取判别性特征，负分支（Negative Branch）主动建模并抑制正常解剖上下文；通过相似度驱动的排斥门（similarity-driven repulsion gate）与差分推理规则（differential inference rule）实现竞争性特征学习，无需额外分支标签，也不增加模型容量。
AI.result: 在RSNA Pneumonia数据集上，SCDM取得竞争性分类性能（AUC 0.858），同时参数量（29.4M）与FLOPs（1.44G）显著低于标准VMamba与视觉Transformer基线；激活分析表明其差分机制实现了高度精准的定位，能够通过抑制无关解剖干扰物有效分离病灶区域。
AI.conclusion: SCDM通过差分式表征解耦有效缓解了SSM医学图像分析中病理信号与正常解剖纠缠的问题，在保持低计算开销的同时兼顾分类性能与可解释的病灶定位能力。

title: CoralscapesV2: Panoptic and Fine-Grained Visual Scene Understanding in Coral Reefs
summary: In order to design conservation and restoration strategies to counter the global decline of coral reefs, ecological monitoring of reefs needs to be scaled up dramatically. Computer vision methods are increasingly used to tackle the vast amount of data: as the paradigm of data collection in reefs shifts from highly standardized and constrained survey images to unconstrained imagery on scalable platforms, it is necessary to design machine learning methods that help to get a fine-grained understanding of reefs from general-purpose reef imagery. This paper provides CoralscapesV2, an extension of the Coralscapes dataset for general-purpose visual scene understanding in reefs. CoralscapesV2 increases the dataset size, scope, label completeness and quality for semantic segmentation, and extends the number of classes from 39 to 95 fine-grained visual categories. Furthermore, CoralscapesV2 provides 65k exhaustive fish instance mask annotations, meticulously annotated to completeness by using the video, revealing that annotation of fish based on only static images is insufficient. CoralscapesV2 is the first dataset for panoptic segmentation in coral reefs, capturing a wide range of scenarios in the wild, posing a challenging benchmark for contemporary semantic segmentation and instance segmentation models. CoralscapesV2 is an important step towards general-purpose panoptic segmentation in coral reefs, which has substantial implications for scaling up coral reef monitoring, as it can be employed in a wide range of applications from benthic cover mapping from robot or handheld videos to designing methods for automated quantification and understanding of fish behavior and fish-reef interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoralscapesV2，一个面向珊瑚礁通用视觉场景理解的数据集，将类别从39类扩展至95类细粒度类别，新增65k鱼实例掩码标注，并首次支持珊瑚礁全景分割任务。
AI.motivation: 全球珊瑚礁退化需要大规模生态监测，而数据采集范式已从高度标准化的调查图像转向可扩展平台上的无约束图像，因此需要设计能在通用礁石图像上实现细粒度理解的机器学习方法，现有数据集在规模、类别粒度和标注完整性上不足以支撑这一需求。
AI.method: 构建CoralscapesV2，作为Coralscapes数据集的扩展：扩大数据集规模、覆盖范围与标签完整性及质量，面向语义分割任务；将类别数从39提升至95个细粒度视觉类别；并利用视频进行详尽标注，提供65k鱼实例掩码标注。
AI.result: CoralscapesV2成为珊瑚礁领域首个全景分割数据集，涵盖大量野外场景，构成对当代语义分割与实例分割模型的挑战性基准；同时揭示了仅基于静态图像标注鱼类是不够的这一发现。
AI.conclusion: CoralscapesV2是迈向珊瑚礁通用全景分割的重要一步，对扩大珊瑚礁监测具有实质性意义，可应用于从机器人或手持视频的底栖覆盖制图，到自动化量化与理解鱼类行为及鱼-礁相互作用等多种场景。

title: A Dual Cross-Attention Framework for Colposcopic CIN Grading and Swede Score Prediction Using a New Multi-Center Dataset
comment: 8 pages
summary: Cervical cancer is a major global health challenge, with disease burden falling disproportionately on low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) due to a shortage of trained specialists and the subjective nature of colposcopy-based screening. To address this challenge, we propose a novel deep learning framework for the automated grading of Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia (CIN) and the prediction of clinical Swede scores. We also introduce the BUET Multi-Center Colposcopy Dataset, a novel, multi-center cohort designed and annotated for Swede score prediction and CIN grading. Our proposed dual-stream cross-attention architecture mimics the visual reasoning of an expert colposcopist by explicitly fusing paired multimodal cervigrams to evaluate comparative tissue responses. Furthermore, we introduce a custom composite loss function to address severe class imbalances and scoring inconsistencies across the five Swede score components. The proposed framework achieved 71.85% accuracy and an 86.23% AUC-ROC for three-class CIN grading, outperforming existing methods. For Swede score component prediction, the architecture achieved AUC-ROC values ranging from 75.7% to 88.4%, with the composite loss function yielding consistent F1-score improvements. Finally, the total predicted Swede Score, which ranges between 0 and 10, shows a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 1.489. The results show that the proposed method can pave the way towards developing AI-assisted colposcopy screening tools to support risk-based triage in resource-limited healthcare settings. The dataset and source code are publicly available(url: https://github.com/mHealthBuet/BUET-colposcopy)

AI.tldr: 提出双流交叉注意力深度学习框架，实现CIN分级与Swede评分预测，并发布多中心阴道镜数据集。
AI.motivation: 宫颈癌疾病负担在低中收入国家尤为突出，源于专业医师短缺及阴道镜筛查的主观性，亟需自动化辅助手段。
AI.method: 构建模拟专家视觉推理的双流交叉注意力架构，显式融合成对多模态宫颈图像以评估组织对比反应；设计自定义复合损失函数应对类别不平衡与评分不一致；同时构建BUET多中心阴道镜数据集。
AI.result: 三分类CIN分级达71.85%准确率、86.23% AUC-ROC，优于现有方法；Swede各组分AUC-ROC为75.7%–88.4%，复合损失带来一致F1提升；总分（0–10）MAE为1.489。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为资源有限场景下基于风险的AI辅助阴道镜分诊工具奠定基础，数据集与代码已公开。

title: Balancing Emotional Alignment and Semantic Consistency in Image Generation via Reinforcement Learning with Valence-Arousal Anchoring
comment: 13 pages, 10 figures, and 4 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/ramon-alana/eit-with-anchor-and-grpo
summary: Continuous emotion control in text-to-image generation requires a model to improve affective alignment without changing the objects, layout, or scene described by the prompt. Existing supervised emotion-injection methods often optimize feature-space proxies and may therefore exhibit emotion-semantic drift, in which stronger emotional conditioning is accompanied by unintended content changes. We address this problem with a flow-matching image-generation framework that combines continuous valence-arousal (VA) conditioning, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and a neutral semantic anchor. The deterministic probability-flow ODE is converted into a marginal-preserving SDE, yielding non-degenerate transition densities for trajectory sampling and policy-ratio estimation. A frozen CLIP-based VA regressor supplies a terminal reward measuring the distance between the predicted and target VA coordinates, while an image generated from the same prompt under zero VA conditioning provides a feature-space reference for semantic preservation. A reduced denoising schedule is used for online RL sampling, whereas the original schedule is retained at inference. Experiments on 3,300 prompt-emotion combinations show substantially lower valence and arousal errors than the VA-conditioned baseline and an improved CLIPScore relative to EmotiCrafter, with a measurable trade-off in reference-free image quality. The results support anchor-regularized Flow-GRPO as a practical approach to balancing emotional alignment and semantic consistency in continuous-affect image synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出anchor-regularized Flow-GRPO框架，通过连续VA条件、GRPO与中性语义锚点，在提升情感对齐的同时抑制文生图的情感-语义漂移。
AI.motivation: 现有监督式情感注入方法多优化特征空间代理，导致"情感-语义漂移"：情感条件增强时内容发生非预期改变。连续情感控制中需在不改变提示描述的物体、布局与场景前提下提升情感对齐。
AI.method: 基于flow-matching生成框架，结合连续valence-arousal（VA）条件、Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）与中性语义锚点。将确定性probability-flow ODE转为保边缘分布的SDE，以获得非退化转移密度用于轨迹采样与策略比率估计；冻结的CLIP-based VA回归器提供终端奖励；零VA条件下同提示生成的图像作为语义保持的特征参考；在线RL采样使用缩减去噪调度，推理时保留原始调度。
AI.result: 在3,300个提示-情感组合上，valence与arousal误差显著低于VA条件基线，CLIPScore优于EmotiCrafter，但无参考图像质量存在可测量的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明anchor-regularized Flow-GRPO是平衡连续情感图像合成中情感对齐与语义一致性的可行方法。

title: Self-supervised Pre-training Helps Retinal Disease Progression Modelling Most When Data Is Scarce
summary: Modelling how a disease progresses over time requires longitudinal imaging cohorts, which are scarce and small, whereas cross-sectional data -- one image per participant -- is abundant. Self-supervised pre-training on such data offers a way to bridge this gap, but it is unclear which strategy best supports progression modelling, or how that answer depends on the amount of labelled longitudinal data. We study this for age-related macular degeneration (AMD), pre-training encoders on the large cross-sectional NAKO cohort and predicting time to late AMD on the longitudinal AREDS dataset. We compare in-house self-supervised encoders against a general-purpose (DINOv2) and a domain-specific (RETFound) foundation model, across contrastive, masked-autoencoding, and self-distillation objectives, under frozen and fine-tuned protocols, and across labelled training sets from 100 to 32,250 examples. Which model performs best depends on how the encoder is used. When the encoder is frozen and labels are few -- the regime typical of longitudinal cohorts -- pre-trained representations reach clinically reasonable discrimination from a few hundred labelled samples, while models trained from scratch do not; this advantage fades under fine-tuning. Transfer is governed by the self-supervision objective rather than corpus scale or domain match, so that an encoder pre-trained on a modest cross-sectional cohort matches or exceeds a far larger in-domain foundation model. Together, these results offer a practical recipe for building progression models where longitudinal data is scarce: a frozen self-supervised encoder with a lightweight survival head.

AI.tldr: 该研究以AMD为对象，系统比较了跨截面自监督预训练编码器（自研对比学习、掩码自编码、自蒸馏 vs. DINOv2、RETFound基础模型）在纵向进展建模中的表现，发现冻结编码器+少量标签（纵向队列典型场景）时预训练表征优势显著，且迁移能力主要由自监督目标而非语料规模或领域匹配度决定。
AI.motivation: 疾病进展建模依赖纵向影像队列，但此类数据稀缺且样本量小；而横截面数据（每人一张图像）丰富。自监督预训练有望弥合这一差距，但尚不清楚哪种策略最适合进展建模，以及该结论如何依赖于有标签纵向数据的数量。
AI.method: 在大型横截面NAKO队列上预训练编码器，在纵向AREDS数据集上预测进展至晚期AMD的时间。对比自研自监督编码器与通用基础模型（DINOv2）和领域专用基础模型（RETFound），涵盖对比学习、掩码自编码和自蒸馏三种目标，在冻结与微调两种协议下，并在100至32,250个有标签训练样本的范围内进行系统评测。
AI.result: 最优模型取决于编码器的使用方式：冻结编码器且标签较少时（纵向队列的典型情形），预训练表征仅用数百个有标签样本即可达到临床可接受的判别性能，而从头训练的模型无法做到；该优势在微调后消失。迁移能力由自监督目标而非语料规模或领域匹配度主导，因此在中等规模横截面队列上预训练的编码器可媲美甚至超越规模大得多的同领域基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 为纵向数据稀缺的进展建模提供了实用方案：采用冻结的自监督编码器搭配轻量级生存分析头。

title: HemaHier: Chain-Conditioned Ordinal Hierarchies for Lineage-Aware Bone-Marrow Cytology
comment: Accepted at the MICCAI 2026 Workshop on Computational Pathology and Multimodal Data (COMPAYL)
summary: Bone-marrow cytology is inherently structured: each cell belongs to a hematopoietic lineage, and many cell types lie on ordered maturation trajectories. Standard flat classifiers ignore this structure, treating a mild same-lineage confusion the same as a severe cross-lineage mistake and predicting only discrete labels. We propose HemaHier, an ordinal-hierarchical prediction head for a frozen or lightly adapted cytology foundation model. Its central component is a chain-conditioned maturity score that reads a single maturity value under a per-chain query, supervised only on biologically valid healthy chains, while dysplastic and off-chain cell types remain classes but are excluded from maturity supervision. Fine and lineage predictions are coupled through a shared posterior that guarantees hierarchical consistency, and a staged objective first stabilizes recognition, then adds lineage and maturity supervision. On three bone-marrow datasets under a shared ontology, HemaHier achieves competitive recognition while reducing biologically severe errors and adding a within-lineage maturity ordering that flat classifiers lack. Code is available at https://github.com/xmindflow/HemaHier.

AI.tldr: 提出 HemaHier，一种面向骨髓细胞学的序数-层级预测头，为冻结或轻量适配的细胞学基础模型同时输出细类、谱系与成熟度，并保证层级一致性。
AI.motivation: 骨髓细胞学数据本身具有层级与序数结构：细胞归属造血谱系，且多数类型位于有序的成熟轨迹上。标准扁平分类器忽略该结构，把同谱系轻微混淆与跨谱系严重错误等同对待，且只输出离散标签，缺乏谱系内成熟度排序。
AI.method: 核心为链条件成熟度评分：在每个链（谱系）查询下读取单一成熟度值，仅在生物学有效的健康链上施加监督，而发育异常与链外细胞类型仍作为类别、但被排除在成熟度监督之外。细类与谱系预测通过共享后验耦合，保证层级一致性；采用分阶段目标：先稳定识别，再加入谱系与成熟度监督。
AI.result: 在统一本体下的三个骨髓数据集上，HemaHier 取得有竞争力的识别性能，同时减少生物学上严重的错误，并提供了扁平分类器所不具备的谱系内成熟度排序。
AI.conclusion: 将骨髓细胞学的层级与序数结构显式建模为预测头，可在保持识别能力的同时降低严重错误、输出成熟度序数信息，且可与冻结或轻量适配的基础模型结合。

title: Pre-Trained Low-Rank Tensor Decomposition for Multi-Dimensional Image Recovery
summary: Recently, tensor decompositions are prevalent for multi-dimensional image representation, which learn the instance-specific structure of each image from scratch. However, tensor decompositions neglect the common structure across different images, leading to limited semantic modeling capability, high computational cost, and a large number of learnable parameters. To address this challenge, we suggest the first pre-trained low-rank tensor decomposition (PLTD) framework, which organically integrates the pre-trained large vision model into the classical tensor decomposition framework. Beyond the shallow and untrained deep tensor decomposition, the suggested PLTD achieves an unprecedented balance among higher recovery fidelity, fewer learnable parameters, and smaller carbon footprint. Specifically, PLTD factorizes the target tensor into a latent tensor and a learnable transform that maps the latent tensor back to the original data domain. The latent tensor consists of two indispensable and complementary terms, i.e., a fixed pre-trained latent tensor and a learnable low-rank latent tensor. The fixed pre-trained latent tensor is distilled from a pre-trained large vision model (i.e., DINOv3) to capture the common structure of the target tensor, while the learnable low-rank latent tensor characterizes the instance-specific structure of the target tensor. To examine the potential of PLTD, we develop the corresponding multi-dimensional image recovery model and theoretically justify the advantages of this framework. Additionally, we discuss the connections between PLTD and classical tensor decomposition frameworks. Extensive experiments on multi-dimensional image recovery demonstrate that PLTD consistently achieves superior performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个预训练低秩张量分解（PLTD）框架，将预训练大视觉模型DINOv3融入经典张量分解，通过固定预训练潜张量与可学习低秩潜张量互补建模共性与实例结构，在多维图像恢复中实现更优性能、更少参数与更低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有张量分解方法从零学习每幅图像的实例特定结构，忽略了不同图像间的共性结构，导致语义建模能力受限、计算开销大、可学习参数多。作者希望借助预训练大视觉模型弥补这一不足。
AI.method: 提出PLTD框架：将目标张量分解为潜张量与可学习变换（映射回原始数据域）。潜张量由两部分互补组成——从预训练大视觉模型DINOv3蒸馏得到的固定预训练潜张量（刻画共性结构），以及可学习的低秩潜张量（刻画实例特定结构）。并据此构建多维图像恢复模型，给出理论优势分析，并讨论PLTD与经典张量分解的联系。
AI.result: 在多维图像恢复任务上，PLTD相比当前最先进方法一致取得更优性能；同时实现了更高恢复保真度、更少可学习参数和更小碳足迹之间的平衡。
AI.conclusion: PLTD首次将预训练大视觉模型与经典张量分解有机结合，克服了传统张量分解忽视跨图像共性结构、参数多、开销大的问题，理论与实验均验证了其有效性。

title: MGAvatar: Mesh-Bound Gaussians for Head Avatar Geometry and Appearance Modeling
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to the Journal Track of Pacific Graphics 2026. Our project page is available at is available at https://bnbucv.github.io/MGAvatar/
summary: Accurate head modeling requires a stable yet expressive geometric representation. Existing Gaussian-based head avatars commonly rely on parametric templates (e.g., FLAME) for Gaussian initialization and deformation, but these templates lack personalized priors and struggle to represent structures such as hair and clothing. To address this issue, we propose MGAvatar, a Gaussian-mesh hybrid representation that jointly models geometry and appearance through two Gaussian-mesh binding modes. Specifically, we introduce vertex-bound Gaussians and constrain their learnable parameters, enabling progressive mesh deformation to represent complex head geometry, while a pose-dependent offset module accounts for non-rigid deformations. Once geometry is stabilized, MGAvatar switches to face-bound Gaussians for appearance modeling. To improve appearance consistency across novel poses and viewpoints, we introduce a view-conditioned neural color field that alleviates artifacts caused by independently optimized Gaussian colors. In addition, we design a Gaussian offset network to predict Gaussian offset maps in the observation space, providing greater flexibility for face-bound Gaussians to capture dynamic facial textures. Extensive experiments on multi-view and monocular videos show that MGAvatar outperforms existing methods in rendering quality, producing high-fidelity head avatars with rich texture details.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MGAvatar，一种高斯-网格混合的头像表示方法，通过顶点绑定与面绑定两种高斯-网格绑定模式联合建模几何与外观，实现高保真头部头像重建。
AI.motivation: 现有基于高斯泼溅的头部头像多依赖参数化模板（如 FLAME）进行高斯初始化与变形，但这类模板缺乏个性化先验，难以表示头发、衣物等非模板结构，限制了建模精度与表现力。
AI.method: 提出高斯-网格混合表示，包含两种绑定模式：1）顶点绑定高斯，约束可学习参数并配合渐进式网格变形表示复杂头部几何，同时引入姿态相关偏移模块处理非刚性形变；2）几何稳定后切换为面绑定高斯进行外观建模。此外设计视角条件神经颜色场以提升新视角/新姿态下外观一致性，并构建高斯偏移网络在观测空间预测偏移图，增强面绑定高斯对动态面部纹理的捕捉能力。
AI.result: 在多视角与单目视频上开展大量实验，MGAvatar 在渲染质量上优于现有方法，能够生成纹理细节丰富的高保真头部头像。
AI.conclusion: 通过高斯-网格混合表示与分阶段绑定策略，MGAvatar 有效克服了参数化模板的个性化不足问题，兼顾几何稳定性与外观表现力，为高保真头部头像建模提供了有效方案。

title: 3D CT-to-PET Translation via Latent Brownian Bridge Diffusion
summary: Computed tomography (CT) and positron emission tomography (PET) provide complementary anatomical and functional information for cancer diagnosis and treatment planning. However, the widespread use of PET is limited by high radiation exposure, elevated costs, and restricted availability. To address these limitations, deep learning-based CT-to-PET translation has emerged as a promising approach for synthesizing PET-like information directly from CT images, although accurately modeling the large cross-modal gap remains challenging. In this work, we propose a 3D CT-to-PET translation framework based on latent Brownian Bridge Diffusion (BBDM). The method consists of two stages. First, a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) is trained on paired CT-PET patches, integrating contrastive learning to improve latent alignment between anatomical and metabolic representations. Second, a BBDM is trained in the latent space to translate CT latent representations into their corresponding PET counterparts. The translated PET latents are then decoded and stitched to reconstruct the final 3D PET volume. We evaluate the proposed approach on two publicly available datasets. Quantitative results based on image fidelity and lesion-level PET-specific metrics demonstrate improved performance compared with competing methods. In particular, the proposed approach improves PET signal fidelity, better preserves clinically relevant uptake patterns, and shows improved performance in preserving small-lesion metabolic activation, paving the way for virtual imaging applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于潜在布朗桥扩散（BBDM）的三维CT-to-PET转换框架，通过两阶段训练提升合成PET的图像保真度与病灶级代谢保留能力。
AI.motivation: PET在肿瘤诊断与治疗计划中可提供功能性信息，与CT的解剖信息互补，但其广泛应用受高辐射暴露、高成本与设备可及性限制。深度学习驱动的CT-to-PET转换可低成本合成类PET信息，但跨模态差异巨大，精确建模困难。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1）在成对CT-PET图像块上训练VAE，并引入对比学习以增强解剖与代谢潜在表示间的对齐；2）在潜在空间中训练BBDM，将CT潜在表示翻译为对应PET潜在表示；随后解码并拼接重建最终三维PET体数据。
AI.result: 在两个公开数据集上评估，基于图像保真度与病灶级PET专用指标的定量结果优于对比方法；PET信号保真度提升，更有效保留临床相关摄取值分布，并在小病灶代谢活性保留方面表现更佳。
AI.conclusion: 该潜在BBDM框架有效缓解CT与PET间的跨模态差距，可为虚拟成像应用提供可行路径。

title: A Multi-Vehicle Dataset with Camera, LiDAR, and Radar Sensors and Scanned 3D Models for Custom Auto-Annotation using RTK-GNSS
comment: Paper accompanying the dataset "7V-Scanario"
summary: Datasets are a crucial element in the development of perception algorithms. They relate sensor measurement data to annotated reference information and allow for the deduction of sensor and object characteristics. In autonomous driving, the reference data commonly consist of semantic image segmentation, point-wise associations, or bounding box annotations. The dataset proposed in this work, however, aims to dig deeper into the evaluation of measurement principles and provides scanned 3D models of all vehicles together with a pose and continuous kinematics reference obtained by RTK-GNSS. Combined, the state of the complete dynamic surrounding of the sensor vehicle is known for any point in time. Subsequent reference formats can be easily computed in user-defined granularity. This dataset involves single-object and multi-object recordings with seven target vehicles. In particular, measurement effects such as occlusion, as well as reflections, can be evaluated, as the normals of the shape of the target vehicles are known. We describe the dataset, discuss the technical background of its development, and briefly present exemplary evaluations.

AI.tldr: 该数据集提供七辆目标车辆的扫描3D模型及RTK-GNSS姿态与连续运动学参考，可完整重建传感器车辆动态环境的任意时刻状态，支持遮挡与反射等测量效应的评估。
AI.motivation: 现有感知数据集多以语义图像分割、点关联或边界框标注为参考，难以深入评估测量原理本身。本文旨在提供更细粒度的参考信息，以支撑传感器与目标特性的推导及测量效应分析。
AI.method: 采集七辆目标车辆的高精度扫描3D模型，结合RTK-GNSS获取其姿态与连续运动学参考；包含单目标与多目标记录；由于目标车辆表面法线已知，可评估遮挡、反射等测量效应；用户可按自定义粒度计算后续参考格式。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖传感器车辆周围完整动态环境的数据集，并通过示例性评估展示了其在测量原理分析中的可用性。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集通过提供底层测量级的参考信息，弥补了传统感知数据集在测量原理评估方面的不足，为遮挡、反射等效应研究提供了新工具。

title: DuplexDrama: A Synthesized Dialogue Dataset with Scenarios, Full-Duplex Behaviors, Expressive Speech, and Sound Events
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables, 19 references. Demo: https://dunjie5465.github.io/duplexdrama-demo/
summary: We present DuplexDrama, the first synthesized spoken dialogue dataset that simultaneously covers four dimensions: (i) complete persona and scenario settings; (ii) three full-duplex behaviors (interruption, backchannel, incomplete); (iii) expressive speech with persona-aligned emotion labels; and (iv) script-aware sound events. DuplexDrama is built via a 4-stage pipeline; quality validation on both scripts and synthesized audio confirms its quality. We have produced more than 2,000 hours audio data with a 64-voice timbre pool spanning 13 personas and 5 age buckets; 3.8% of all turns carry at least one full-duplex behavior. This data has been validated through internal full-duplex model training. We will release a curated subset of 6,400 bilingual dialogues (800 h, Chinese ~500 h + English ~300 h) to advance full-duplex spoken dialogue model research. Data samples are available at our demo page and LLM-judge evaluation prompts will be released with the dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DuplexDrama，首个同时覆盖四个维度的合成口语对话数据集：完整的人设与场景设定、三种全双工行为（打断、反馈、非完整话语）、带有人设对齐情感标签的表现力语音，以及脚本感知的音效。该数据集通过4阶段流水线构建，共含2000+小时音频、64种音色、13类人设、5个年龄层，3.8%的对话轮含至少一种全双工行为。
AI.motivation: 现有全双工口语对话模型研究缺乏同时具备人设/场景设定、全双工行为、表现力语音与音效标注的多维数据集，限制了模型对真实对话动态的建模能力。
AI.method: 采用4阶段流水线构建数据集，并对脚本与合成音频进行质量验证；通过内部全双工模型训练进一步验证数据可用性。
AI.result: 产出2000+小时音频，覆盖64种音色、13类人设与5个年龄层；3.8%的对话轮包含至少一种全双工行为；将发布6400组双语对话子集（约800小时，中文约500小时、英文约300小时）。
AI.conclusion: DuplexDrama 为全双工口语对话模型研究提供了多维、高质量、大规模的数据支撑，并将公开精选子集及LLM评判评估提示词。

title: VideoTok4D: A 4D-Aware Video Tokenizer for Compact World Representation
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures
summary: Video tokenizers have emerged as a cornerstone of modern video modeling, underpinning progress in compression, reconstruction and generation by mapping high-dimensional visual signals into compact latent spaces. However, despite this progress, current tokenization paradigms largely remain within the 2D visual domain, treating videos as image sequences rather than observations of an underlying dynamic 3D world. Consequently, the learned tokens inherit this observation-centric bias, limiting their capacity to compactly represent real-world 4D scenes. To mitigate this issue, we propose VideoTok4D, a novel 4D-aware video tokenizer for compact world representation. Specifically, our approach comprises three key designs: 1) a spatiotemporal disentanglement strategy that factorizes videos into static and dynamic tokens for holistic world modeling; 2) a track-aware dynamic attention mechanism that aggregates trajectory-aligned cues to promote cross-view motion consistency; and 3) Co4DGen, a diffusion prior learned over the resulting VideoTok4D token space for efficient 4D scene generation. Extensive experiments have demonstrated that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance while requiring up to 4 orders of magnitude less storage than dense 4D representations. Moreover, the compact token space substantially shortens diffusion sequences, enabling efficient generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VideoTok4D，一种面向4D场景的紧凑视频tokenizer，通过时空解耦、轨迹感知动态注意力及扩散先验Co4DGen，实现高效4D表示与生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频tokenizer主要停留在2D视觉域，将视频视为图像序列，继承了以观测为中心的先验偏差，难以紧凑地表示真实世界4D场景。
AI.method: 方法包含三项关键设计：1）时空解耦策略，将视频分解为静态与动态token以实现整体世界建模；2）轨迹感知动态注意力机制，聚合轨迹对齐线索以增强跨视角运动一致性；3）Co4DGen，在VideoTok4D token空间上学习扩散先验，用于高效4D场景生成。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法达到state-of-the-art性能，同时所需存储比密集4D表示最多低4个数量级；紧凑token空间显著缩短扩散序列，实现高效生成。
AI.conclusion: VideoTok4D通过4D感知的token化范式，为紧凑世界表示与高效4D生成提供了有效方案。

title: MedSNIP: Building and Benchmarking Snippet-Level Granularity for Medical Fact Verification
comment: 24 pages, 21 figures, 14 tables, Published In Proceedings of The 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
summary: A medical claim's correctness often depends not on the claim alone, but on the clinical structure around it. A claim may require a lab reference range, a causal or conditional link, or patient-specific details to be judged correctly, and atom-level decomposition can fragment these dependencies, leaving the verifier with clinically incomplete claims. We reformulate medical fact-checking around snippet-level verification, where clause-grouped units preserve local clinical structure. We introduce MedSNIP-Bench, a human-annotated benchmark for snippet-level medical fact verification, and MedSNIP, an automatic snippet-generation pipeline. MedSNIP-Bench covers 276 consumer-health and clinical-vignette responses, segmented into 2,524 snippets with dual in-general and in-patient-context labels and six structural pattern codes. MedSNIP is evaluated against human snippet boundaries on MedSNIP-Bench and then used to generate snippet-level units for external corpora. Across MedSNIP-Bench, HealthFC, and MedHallu, snippet-level verification preserves or improves false-class F1, with gains concentrated where answers are long enough to fragment and where the verifier is strong enough to exploit the recovered structure. The largest merge-pattern gain is on causal-conditional clinical chains. It also reduces verifier calls by 24-73%, though the saving survives end-to-end only when decomposition is cheap, which an open-weight decomposer makes possible at no loss of chunking fidelity.

AI.tldr: 该论文将医学事实核查重构为片段级（snippet-level）验证，提出人工标注基准 MedSNIP-Bench 与自动片段生成流程 MedSNIP，以保留局部临床结构，减少原子化分解带来的临床不完整问题。
AI.motivation: 医学主张的正确性往往不取决于主张本身，而依赖其周围的临床结构（如实验室参考范围、因果或条件链接、患者特异性细节）。原子级分解会割裂这些依赖关系，使验证器面对临床信息不完整的claim，因此需要片段级验证以保留局部临床结构。
AI.method: 提出 MedSNIP-Bench：人工标注的片段级医学事实验证基准，包含 276 个消费者健康与临床情境回答，切分为 2,524 个片段，配有通用与患者情境双重标签及六类结构模式编码。提出 MedSNIP 自动片段生成流程，先在 MedSNIP-Bench 上与人工片段边界对比评估，再用于为外部语料生成片段级单元。在 MedSNIP-Bench、HealthFC、MedHallu 上评估。
AI.result: 片段级验证在假类 F1 上保持或提升，增益集中于答案较长易被割裂、且验证器足够强能利用恢复结构的场景；最大合并模式增益出现在因果-条件临床链上。验证器调用减少 24%–73%，但只有在分解成本低廉时端到端节省才成立，开权重分解器可在不损失分块保真度的情况下实现。
AI.conclusion: 片段级验证通过保留局部临床结构，在多个数据集上不劣于甚至优于原子级验证的假类 F1，并显著降低验证器调用次数；其收益依赖于答案长度、验证器能力与分解成本，开权重分解器可兼顾成本与分块保真度。

title: Learning Sign Language Recognition under Label Noise: A Study of Noise-Robust Losses for Isolated and Continuous Settings
comment: 15 pages, 1 figures
summary: In sign language recognition, the isolated (ISLR) classification loss treats a single label as ground truth, as does the frame-level auxiliary classifier over pseudo-labels we add to continuous (CSLR) methods, which lack one. Stylistic variation blurs ISLR annotation and the lack of temporal boundaries in CSLR forces pseudo-labels; both are noisy. We therefore apply symmetric and generalized cross entropy (SCE, GCE), robust alternatives to cross entropy (CE) from image classification, not to connectionist temporal classification but to the preceding single-label classifier. On ASL Citizen with injected symmetric noise on three backbones (three seeds for ST-GCN), robust losses cost at most 2.5 pt when labels are clean and beat CE by 2.9-10.0 pt in all six conditions at noise rate 0.2, one of which only after q was re-selected on dev. GCE gains more, but its optimal q does not transfer across backbones, whereas one SCE setting works in all nine conditions; both vary 2-11 times more than CE across runs, so a favorable point estimate does not establish stability. For CSLR (PHOENIX-2014) we report no gain; our frame-level targets carry a systematic assignment bias, making that study a diagnosis of a single configuration. At lambda_aux = 25 the pseudo-label CE auxiliary raises word error rate above the no-auxiliary baseline on VAC, CorrNet and SlowFastSign, and GCE/SCE improve on CE by 1.7-3.2 pt (three of six conditions return below that baseline). However, the three losses differ by more than an order of magnitude in effective gradient at a common lambda_aux: matching the initial gradient shrinks the gap to 0.4-0.9 pt, and lowering the CE weight alone already beats that baseline, so neither the degradation nor the improvement can be separated from the effect of the weight. We use only symmetric noise; multi-seed evaluation covers only ST-GCN and VAC isolated.

AI.tldr: 本文将图像分类中的鲁棒损失（对称交叉熵SCE、广义交叉熵GCE）用于手语识别中单标签分类器（ISLR分类损失与CSLR的帧级伪标签辅助分类器），而非CTC；在ASL Citizen注入对称噪声进行实验，并在PHOENIX-2014上诊断CSLR的伪标签偏差，强调损失间有效梯度差异使增益与权重效应难以分离。
AI.motivation: ISLR的孤立分类损失将单一标签视为真值，CSLR中帧级辅助分类器的伪标签亦视为真值，但ISLR标注受风格变异影响、CSLR缺乏时间边界导致伪标签，两者均为噪声标签。作者希望借鉴图像分类中的鲁棒损失（SCE、GCE）来缓解噪声，而非改动CTC。
AI.method: 在ASL Citizen数据集上，对三个骨干网络（ST-GCN用三个随机种子）注入对称噪声，用SCE与GCE替换单标签分类器的交叉熵；在CSLR（PHOENIX-2014）上采用带lambda_aux加权的帧级伪标签CE辅助损失，并比较GCE/SCE；同时分析不同损失在共同lambda_aux下的有效梯度差异，并做梯度匹配实验。
AI.result: ISLR：干净标签下鲁棒损失最多损失2.5个点；噪声率0.2的所有六种条件下，鲁棒损失比CE好2.9–10.0个点（其中一种需在dev上重选q）。GCE增益更大但其最优q不跨骨干迁移，而某一SCE配置在全部九种条件下均有效；两者跨运行的波动比CE大2–11倍。CSLR无增益，帧级目标存在系统性分配偏差，属于单一配置诊断。lambda_aux=25时伪标签CE辅助使VAC、CorrNet、SlowFastSign的词错误率高于无辅助基线，GCE/SCE比CE好1.7–3.2个点（六种条件中三种回到基线以下）；但三种损失在共同lambda_aux下有效梯度相差一个数量级以上，梯度匹配后差距缩至0.4–0.9个点，单独降低CE权重即可超过基线。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒损失在ISLR的噪声场景下可稳定优于CE，但CSLR场景未见增益；由于损失间有效梯度差异巨大，退化与改进都无法与权重效应区分，因此所报告的改善不能归因于损失本身。研究仅使用对称噪声，多随机种子评估仅覆盖ST-GCN与VAC的孤立设置，结论的通用性有限。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Uncertainty-Guided Boundary Refinement for Reliable Biomedical Image Segmentation
summary: Accurate biomedical image segmentation requires not only high global overlap but also reliable delineation of clinically meaningful boundaries. In blood-smear microscopy, cytoplasm and nucleus contours provide the structural basis for downstream morphology analysis; however, deep segmentation models may remain uncertain or overconfident near ambiguous boundary regions even when achieving strong Dice scores. This work proposes a Reliability-Aware Boundary Refinement Network (RABR-Net), a two-stage framework for trustworthy image segmentation. A strong UNet++ EfficientNet-B4 base segmenter first produces initial class probabilities and logits. Predictive entropy, test-time augmentation variance, margin uncertainty, probability gradients, and soft boundary cues are then combined into a boundary-aware reliability representation. This representation guides a gated residual refiner that selectively corrects uncertain boundary pixels while preserving confident regions of the base prediction. The framework is evaluated using overlap accuracy, class-wise Dice, Boundary Dice, HD95/ASSD, calibration, risk--coverage analysis, robustness under image perturbations, qualitative correction maps, and paired statistical testing. On the held-out test set, the proposed method improves Dice from 0.9602 to 0.9614, Boundary Dice from 0.3448 to 0.3611, and HD95 from 3.0354 to 2.8274 compared with the cached base prediction. Statistical analysis confirms significant improvements in Dice, Boundary Dice, and HD95. Qualitative results show that the learned gate concentrates around uncertain cytoplasm and nucleus boundaries, and correction maps confirm localized boundary refinement. Although calibration does not automatically improve after refinement, the proposed framework provides an interpretable and reliability-focused strategy for boundary-sensitive biomedical image segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出RABR-Net两阶段框架：UNet++/EfficientNet-B4基分割器输出概率与logits，将预测熵、TTA方差、margin不确定性、概率梯度与软边界线索融合为边界感知可靠性表示，引导门控残差精修器选择性修正不确定边界像素；在血液涂片数据集上Dice 0.9602→0.9614、Boundary Dice 0.3448→0.3611、HD95 3.0354→2.8274，均具统计显著性。
AI.motivation: 生物医学图像分割不仅需要高全局重叠度，还需可靠的临床意义边界刻画。血液涂片显微图像中胞质与胞核轮廓是下游形态学分析的结构基础，但深度模型即便Dice很高，在模糊边界区域仍可能出现不确定或过度自信的预测，缺乏可靠性与可解释性。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1）以UNet++结合EfficientNet-B4作为强基分割器，输出初始类别概率与logits；2）融合预测熵、测试时增强（TTA）方差、margin不确定性、概率梯度及软边界线索，构建边界感知可靠性表示，用以驱动门控残差精修器，选择性修正不确定边界像素并保留基预测中的高置信区域。评估涵盖重叠精度、类间Dice、Boundary Dice、HD95/ASSD、校准、风险-覆盖率分析、图像扰动鲁棒性、定性修正图及配对统计检验。
AI.result: 在保留测试集上，相较缓存基预测，Dice由0.9602提升至0.9614，Boundary Dice由0.3448提升至0.3611，HD95由3.0354降至2.8274；统计检验证实Dice、Boundary Dice与HD95改善显著。定性结果显示学习到的门控集中于不确定的胞质与胞核边界，修正图验证了局部化边界精修效果。校准性能在精修后未自动改善。
AI.conclusion: RABR-Net为边界敏感的生物医学图像分割提供了一种可解释、以可靠性为核心的策略，能在保持高重叠精度的同时显著改善边界质量；但校准提升仍需单独处理，如何将不确定性与校准一体化优化是后续方向。

title: UniPart: Towards Zero-shot Language-Grounded 3D Part Segmentation for Embodied Interaction
summary: Fine-grained robotic manipulation depends on understanding parts, not only whole objects. Existing 3D foundation models tend to be either generalized but object-aware, or part-aware but limited to closed-set taxonomies, which weakens zero-shot transfer. We study text-conditioned 3D part segmentation, where a free-form phrase selects a functional part on point cloud. We introduce UniPart, a feed-forward cross-modal 3D Transformer that conditions CLIP text embedding. To scale supervision, we build LangPart-1M with 160K+ Objaverse assets and 8M text to part pairs using multi-view consistent part generation. We further manually label a high-quality subset, LangPart-4K, for fine-tuning and evaluation. UniPart achieves strong zero-shot results on open-vocabulary part benchmarks and transfers to language-conditioned part grasping in real world.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniPart：文本条件的三维部件分割前馈跨模态 Transformer，并构建大规模数据集 LangPart-1M/4K，实现开放词汇零样本分割与真实世界抓取迁移。
AI.motivation: 精细化机器人操作依赖对部件（而非仅整体对象）的理解，而现有三维基础模型存在两难：或泛化性强但只关注整体对象，或关注部件却局限于封闭类别体系，导致零样本迁移能力弱。
AI.method: 研究文本条件下的三维部件分割任务：给定自由形式的短语，在点云上定位功能性部件。提出 UniPart，一种前馈式跨模态三维 Transformer，以 CLIP 文本嵌入为条件。为扩大监督规模，构建 LangPart-1M 数据集，包含 16 万余个 Objaverse 资产、通过多视图一致的部件生成得到的 800 万条"文本—部件"配对；并人工标注高质量子集 LangPart-4K，用于微调与评测。
AI.result: UniPart 在开放词汇部件基准上取得较强的零样本结果，并能迁移到真实世界中基于语言条件的部件抓取任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨模态条件建模与大规模部件级数据生成，UniPart 缓解了三维基础模型在泛化性与部件级理解之间的权衡，验证了文本条件部件分割向真实机器人操作迁移的可行性。

title: Parallel Training Using a CNN-DNN Architecture for Accelerated Development of Diagnostic Models
summary: Artificial intelligence has shown promise in assisting radiologists in imaging-based diagnosis across a wide range of diseases. Efficient training of large deep learning models is essential to cope with extremely large data sets or dynamically growing disease data, like in a pandemic like situation. In this retrospective study, we collected 300 CT scans from COVID-19 and non-COVID-19 pneumonia patients from three different centers in Germany. We investigated a hybrid CNN-DNN network model based on image decomposition and localization that naturally supports parallel and efficient training of deep learning models. In total, 156 models with three different architectures were trained to capture features at different levels resulting in 12 patient-level COVID-19 diagnosis models. Diagnostic performance as well as time saving were measured. The highest accuracy was obtained from DenseNet121 and 3D CNN models with a parallel CNN-DNN approach, resulting in $88.78\%$ training, $76.67\%$ validation and $76.03\%$ test accuracy for the DenseNet121 with $4\times4\times1$ subdomains and $87.72\%$ training, $76.82\%$ validation and $74.86\%$ test accuracy, respectively, for the 3D CNN with $4\times4\times1$ subdomains. The strongest reduction in parallel training time by a factor of $31$ was observed for the 3D CNN model and $4\times4\times2$ subdomains. Our parallel training approach improves efficiency as well as performance enabling rapid model development, among others crucial for pandemic preparedness.

AI.tldr: 提出基于图像分解与定位的混合CNN-DNN模型，支持并行高效训练，用于COVID-19 CT影像诊断，在提升效率的同时保持较高诊断性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模深度学习模型训练需要应对超大或动态增长的数据集（如疫情期间快速变化的病例数据），传统串行训练效率低，难以满足快速模型开发与疫情应对需求。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，采集德国三个中心的300例COVID-19与非COVID-19肺炎患者CT扫描；构建基于图像分解与定位的混合CNN-DNN网络，天然支持并行高效训练；共训练156个模型（三种架构），聚合成12个患者级COVID-19诊断模型；评估诊断性能与训练时间节省。
AI.result: DenseNet121与3D CNN在并行CNN-DNN方法下取得最高精度：DenseNet121（4×4×1子域）训练88.78%、验证76.67%、测试76.03%；3D CNN（4×4×1子域）训练87.72%、验证76.82%、测试74.86%。并行训练时间最大缩减31倍，出现在3D CNN模型与4×4×2子域配置。
AI.conclusion: 该并行训练方法在提升效率的同时改善性能，可实现快速模型开发，对疫情准备等场景具有重要意义。

title: Parameter-Efficient Retrievers for Polish and European Languages
summary: Dense retrieval systems increasingly rely on multi-billion-parameter language models, whose memory and computational requirements make large-scale indexing, frequent corpus updates, and low-latency serving costly. We present a three-stage training pipeline for developing compact and efficient retrievers that remain competitive with substantially larger models. The pipeline combines cross-lingual alignment, relational knowledge distillation, and contrastive fine-tuning. It requires no original ground-truth relevance labels, relying exclusively on supervision generated by strong embedding models and rerankers utilised as teachers. Using this pipeline, we develop PolDense and EuroDense, both supporting contexts of up to 8,192 tokens. PolDense is a family of six Polish retrievers ranging from 17M to 1B parameters. EuroDense is a 435M-parameter retriever supporting nine European languages. We conduct an extensive evaluation covering 41 Polish and 150 multilingual retrieval tasks. The results demonstrate strong quality-efficiency trade-offs. PolDense-1B outperforms the evaluated retrievers with up to 9B parameters, while the PolDense family forms the Pareto frontier across model sizes. Among the evaluated models below 1B parameters, EuroDense ranks first in both task-averaged and language-averaged performance and leads in seven of nine languages. We release all models publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出三段式训练流程（跨语言对齐、关系知识蒸馏、对比微调），无需原生标注，基于强嵌入模型与重排序器生成的监督信号，训练出紧凑高效的检索器 PolDense（6个波兰语模型，17M–1B）与 EuroDense（435M，9种欧洲语言），在效率-质量权衡上优于更大模型。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索系统日益依赖数十亿参数的语言模型，导致内存与算力开销大，大规模索引、语料频繁更新与低延迟服务成本高昂。因此需要开发既紧凑高效、又能与大型模型保持竞争力的检索器。
AI.method: 三阶段训练流水线：1）跨语言对齐；2）关系知识蒸馏；3）对比微调。该流程不依赖原始人工相关性标注，仅使用强嵌入模型与重排序器作为教师生成的监督信号。据此构建 PolDense（支持最长8,192 token上下文的六种波兰语检索器，参数量17M至1B）与 EuroDense（435M参数，支持九种欧洲语言）。
AI.result: 在41项波兰语与150项多语言检索任务上评测。PolDense-1B 优于所评测的至多9B参数的检索器，PolDense 系列在各模型规模上构成 Pareto 前沿；在1B以下模型中，EuroDense 在任务平均与语言平均性能上均排名第一，并在九种语言中的七种领先。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线可无原生标注地训练紧凑检索器，实现较强的质量-效率权衡，小模型可匹敌或超越显著更大的模型；所有模型已公开释出。

title: LLM-Enhanced Dual-Branch Learning for Large-Scale Multi-Label Text Classification
summary: Large-scale multi-label text classification assigns a small subset of relevant labels to each document from a vocabulary containing thousands or tens of thousands of candidate labels. Although pretrained language models have improved semantic text representations, most representation-based approaches center their prediction pipelines on a primary encoder or combine auxiliary features within a single ranker. The complementarity between heterogeneous language models therefore remains insufficiently explored. We propose DualMLC, a dual-branch framework that processes the same document through an autoregressive decoder-only language model and a bidirectional encoder. Each branch maintains its own representation pathway and independently estimates relevance scores over the shared label space. DualMLC combines the two score vectors through late logit fusion, allowing shared evidence to reinforce relevant labels and branch-specific evidence to compensate for limitations in the other branch's representation. DualMLC achieves state-of-the-art results on three widely used large-scale multi-label text classification benchmarks. Ablation results further confirm that integrating the heterogeneous predictors produces stronger rankings than either branch alone. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/huiyegit/DualMLC.

AI.tldr: 提出 DualMLC 双分支框架，将同一文档分别输入自回归解码器语言模型与双向编码器，各自独立在共享标签空间上估计相关性分数，再通过后期 logit 融合整合两支分数，在三个大规模多标签文本分类基准上取得最优结果，消融实验证明异构预测器融合优于单支。
AI.motivation: 大规模多标签文本分类需从数千至数万候选标签中为每篇文档分配少量相关标签。尽管预训练语言模型提升了语义表示，现有基于表示的方法大多以单一主编码器为核心预测管线，或将辅助特征并入单一排序器，导致异构语言模型之间的互补性未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: DualMLC 采用双分支架构：同一文档同时经由（1）自回归式仅解码器语言模型与（2）双向编码器处理；每个分支拥有独立的表示通路，并在共享标签空间上各自独立估计相关性分数；最后通过后期 logit 融合（late logit fusion）合并两个分数向量，使共享证据强化相关标签、分支特有证据弥补另一分支表示的不足。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的大规模多标签文本分类基准上达到 state-of-the-art。消融实验进一步证实，融合异构预测器所得到的排序效果强于任一单分支。源代码已公开于 https://github.com/huiyegit/DualMLC。
AI.conclusion: 异构语言模型（自回归解码器与双向编码器）的后期分数融合可有效利用二者的互补性，为大规模多标签文本分类提供更强的标签排序能力，且结构简洁、可直接推广。

title: PA-CDM: Position-Aware Character Detection Matching for Evaluating Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures
summary: Handwritten mathematical expression recognition (HMER) is conventionally scored by exact-match rates and string-similarity metrics that are blind to where an error occurs: two predictions with identical token-error counts receive identical scores whether they misplace a subscript or swap the operands of a fraction. Render-based character detection matching (CDM) aligns glyphs robustly but remains position-blind---on controlled fraction-operand swaps it scores 0.8595 where position-aware scoring yields 0.6253. Tree-edit metrics exhibit a complementary blind spot: rewrites outside the parser's normalization coverage are penalized as structural errors (0.8552 where render-based metrics score 1.0). We propose PA-CDM, a position-aware metric that couples character detection matching with position-forest encoding and divergence-level weighting; StructPerturb v2.0, a frozen benchmark of 1,340 controlled perturbation pairs across 15 type--intensity cells; and a cross-metric consistency protocol combining a sensitivity matrix, a human study, and LLM-judge calibration. In a six-annotator study, PA-CDM attains the highest correlation with human judgments among seven automatic metrics (Spearman rho=0.9535, n=990). A frontier LLM judge correlates slightly higher (rho=0.9613) but is costly, nondeterministic, and API-dependent; PA-CDM approaches it at zero marginal cost with deterministic, diagnosable behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出位置感知指标PA-CDM及配套基准StructPerturb v2.0，用于手写数学表达式识别的细粒度错误定位评估。
AI.motivation: 现有HMER评估指标存在盲区：精确匹配率与字符串相似度不区分错误位置；基于渲染的字符检测匹配（CDM）虽能稳健对齐字形但对位置不敏感；树编辑指标则会把解析器归一化未覆盖的改写误判为结构错误。需要位置感知、可诊断的评分方式。
AI.method: PA-CDM将字符检测匹配与位置森林编码、分歧级别加权相结合；构建StructPerturb v2.0冻结基准，含15个类型-强度单元、1,340组受控扰动对；提出跨指标一致性协议，包含敏感性矩阵、人类研究和LLM评判校准。
AI.result: 六标注者研究中，PA-CDM在七个自动指标里与人类判断相关性最高（Spearman rho=0.9535，n=990）；前沿LLM评判略高（rho=0.9613）但成本高、非确定性且依赖API。受控分数分数操作数交换场景下，位置无关CDM给0.8595而位置感知评分给0.6253；树编辑指标在归一化覆盖外改写场景给0.8552，而渲染类指标给1.0。
AI.conclusion: PA-CDM以零边际成本、确定性和可诊断的行为接近LLM评判的相关性水平，为HMER提供了位置感知且一致的评估方案。

title: Input Resolution Matters: Real-Time Object Detection Latency
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 2026 34th IEEE International Symposium on Modelling, Analysis and Simulation of Computer and Telecommunication Systems (MASCOTS)
summary: We model total latency as the convolution of preprocessing, inference, and postprocessing distributions under a simplifying independence approximation, with selected stage parameters expressed as functions of source-image resolution. Under this assumption, the probability density of the total latency is the convolution of the stage-wise densities, and its cumulative distribution function (CDF) provides the distribution of end-to-end detection time. Each stage is modeled by a parametric distribution (e.g., Exponential, Erlang, Normal, Gamma), with parameters expressed as functions of the source-image resolution. Experiments with YOLOv11n on NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX using COCO2017 images across multiple resolutions assess the proposed models against fixed-parameter baselines using Kolmogorov Smirnov, Anderson Darling, and Cramér von Mises statistics. The results indicate that resolution-aware parameterization can improve distributional approximation in the measured setting, particularly for the more flexible Normal and Gamma models, while the quality of fit remains distribution dependent. Our contribution is a theoretically grounded and lightweight formulation for studying resolution-dependent latency distributions in a measured object detection pipeline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将端到端检测总延迟建模为预处理、推理、后处理三阶段分布卷积，并将各阶段参数表示为源图像分辨率的函数，通过实验验证分辨率感知参数化可改善延迟分布拟合。
AI.motivation: 研究动机：目标检测流水线的端到端延迟受源图像分辨率影响显著，但现有延迟建模多采用固定参数分布，缺乏对分辨率依赖性的理论刻画。作者希望建立一个理论扎实且轻量的框架，用以研究分辨率相关的延迟分布。
AI.method: 方法：在简化的独立性近似下，将总延迟建模为预处理、推理、后处理三个分布阶段的卷积；在独立性假设下总延迟的概率密度为各阶段密度的卷积，其累积分布函数（CDF）给出端到端检测时间分布。各阶段分别用参数化分布（如指数、Erlang、正态、Gamma）建模，且参数表示为源图像分辨率的函数。
AI.result: 结果：在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 上使用 YOLOv11n、COCO2017 图像跨多个分辨率进行实验，采用 Kolmogorov-Smirnov、Anderson-Darling 和 Cramér-von Mises 统计量，将所提模型与固定参数基线对比。结果表明，分辨率感知参数化在所测设定下可改善分布近似，尤其是更灵活的正态与 Gamma 模型，但拟合质量仍依赖于所选择的分布。
AI.conclusion: 结论：本文为研究实测目标检测流水线中分辨率相关的延迟分布提供了一个有理论依据且轻量的建模框架，分辨率感知参数化能提升分布拟合，但效果因分布族而异。

title: DementiaCare-Bench: A Modality-Validated Video Benchmark
summary: Dementia affects an estimated 57 million people worldwide, and for most families the hardest part of care is not memory loss but the behavioral and psychological symptoms of dementia (BPSD): agitation, wandering, resistance to care, sundowning. Understanding these symptoms requires more than recognizing the behavior itself; it also requires knowing what happened beforehand. The same behavior may call for a different response depending on its trigger. Video-language models (VLMs) could potentially support caregivers, yet no existing benchmark evaluates this capability. To fill this gap, we present DementiaCare-Bench: 56 professionally produced caregiver training videos segmented into 94 clips across nine BPSD categories, with 2023 questions generated by a multi-agent pipeline that grounds every clinical claim in a verbatim transcript span. Each question is then probed under four visual conditions and labelled by the least it requires, so its visual demand is measured rather than assumed. Measurement contradicts intent: we wrote 77.7% of the questions to require ordered frames, and 34.8% do. Across 12 current VLMs the pattern is uniform. The best reach 85% overall, but that average is carried by questions a language model can answer from clinical knowledge alone; accuracy falls by 17 points on average on questions that require the ordered clip, and a leading open model scores at chance on judging whether a caregiver's response was appropriate. A lightweight LoRA fine-tune, DemCare-VLM, moves video dependence from -3.3 to +4.5 points, so what the benchmark exposes can be repaired and not only measured.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 DementiaCare-Bench，首个面向痴呆症行为心理症状（BPSD）照护的 caregiver 训练视频-语言基准，包含 56 段专业视频、94 个片段、9 类 BPSD 与 2023 道经多智能体管线生成并回溯到原文转录的题目，每道题在四种视觉条件下探测并按最小视觉需求标注。评测显示 12 个现有 VLM 的表现被"仅凭语言知识可答"的题目撑高，真正依赖有序视频片段时准确率平均下降 17 分；作者进一步用轻量 LoRA 微调得到 DemCare-VLM，将视频依赖性从 -3.3 分提升到 +4.5 分，证明基准暴露的问题可被修复。
AI.motivation: 痴呆症影响全球约 5700 万人，照护中最大的困难并非记忆丧失，而是激越、游走、抗拒照护、日落综合征等行为与心理症状（BPSD）。理解这些症状不能只看行为本身，还需知道其前置触发因素，因为同一行为在不同诱因下需要不同应对。视频-语言模型（VLM）有望辅助照护者，但目前缺乏评估这类能力的基准，本文正是为填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建 DementiaCare-Bench：56 段专业制作的照护者培训视频，切分为 94 个片段，覆盖 9 个 BPSD 类别；通过多智能体管线生成 2023 道问题，并将每条临床论断逐字锚定到转录文本片段。每道题在四种视觉条件下探测，并以"所需最少视觉信息"标注，从而实测而非假定其视觉需求。随后在 12 个当前 VLM 上进行评测，并用轻量 LoRA 微调训练 DemCare-VLM 进行验证性修复。
AI.result: 测量结果与设计意图相矛盾：作者原打算让 77.7% 的题目需要有序帧，实际仅有 34.8% 确实如此。12 个 VLM 表现模式高度一致：最佳模型总体达 85%，但该均值主要由仅凭临床语言知识即可回答的题目贡献；在真正需要有序视频片段的题目上，准确率平均下降 17 分，某领先开源模型在判断照护者回应是否恰当上仅达随机水平。经 LoRA 微调的 DemCare-VLM 将视频依赖性从 -3.3 分提升至 +4.5 分。
AI.conclusion: 现有 VLM 在 BPSD 照护场景中看似高分，实则严重依赖语言先验而非视频时序理解，在需要有序片段的题目上性能明显退化。DementiaCare-Bench 不仅揭示这一缺陷，还表明通过轻量 LoRA 微调可有效提升视频依赖性，说明基准所暴露的问题是"可修复的"而不只是"可测量的"。

title: FIRM: Flow-based Imaging via Regularized Minimization
summary: Flow matching methods for imaging inverse problems typically incorporate measurements through network conditioning or guidance during sampling. Neither approach explicitly applies the forward operator within the learned conditional velocity field. We develop a principled measurement-conditional velocity parameterization that does. For a linear interpolation path, we express the optimal velocity through the posterior mean $E[x_1|x_t, y]$ and show that this mean is the unique minimizer of a variational objective with an explicit data-consistency term. The velocity defined by this minimizer provably transports the source distribution to the measurement-conditioned posterior. This result leads to a forward operator-aware velocity field that is trained end-to-end and requires no separate guidance during sampling. Across five imaging tasks, our method achieves leading reconstruction quality with up to $50\times$ fewer network evaluations than competitive flow-based methods. Varying the number of sampling steps also controls the distortion-perception trade-off without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将前向算子显式嵌入速度场的学习式测度条件速度参数化方法，用于成像逆问题的流匹配，在五个任务上以最多少50倍网络评估实现领先重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有用于成像逆问题的流匹配方法通常通过条件网络或采样中的引导引入测度，二者均未在学习到的条件速度场中显式应用前向算子，缺乏原理性支撑且需额外引导。
AI.method: 针对线性插值路径，将最优速度表达为后验均值 E[x1|x_t,y]，并证明该均值为带显式数据一致性项变分目标的唯一极小值点；由此得到的速度可证明将源分布输运至测度条件后验，从而构建前向算子感知的速度场并端到端训练，采样阶段无需单独引导。
AI.result: 在五个成像任务上取得领先的重建质量，相比竞争性基于流的方法网络评估次数最多减少50倍；改变采样步数可在不重训练情况下调控失真—感知权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过将前向算子内嵌于条件速度场并以后验均值为最优速度，实现了原理清晰、无需引导且高效的流匹配逆问题求解，并具备灵活的质量调控能力。

title: Fewer Words, Not Fewer Tokens: Measuring the Sanskrit Tokenization Penalty per Proposition
comment: 20 pages, of which 8 are the body; 4 figures, 18 tables. Code, data pipeline and the full results snapshot: https://github.com/DS436/sanskrit-token
summary: Sanskrit fuses case, number, person and tense into word endings and chains clauses into compounds, so it is information-dense per word. Whether that density survives subword tokenization is a separate question, to be asked per unit of meaning rather than per word. On identical FLORES-200 devtest content, Sanskrit costs 1.774-2.187 times the English tokens under deployed tokenizers with vocabularies of 200,019 ids or more, but only 1.325-1.353 times the Hindi tokens. Against a deployed English tokenizer, Sanskrit-trained BPE arms then look cheaper per proposition than English on contemporary prose (0.887). Against a matched English control, the same algorithm and vocabulary trained on the English side of the same corpus, that flip disappears: at 32,000 and 64,000 pieces all 8 matched pairs, each size-matched arm against both a pair-matched and a byte-matched control, sit above 1.0 on prose with 95% intervals excluding it. The gap closes as the vocabulary grows: at 128,000 pieces the BPE pair reads 0.983 in domain while staying above parity out of domain (1.025) and on FLORES (1.116). The ratio factorises into a character-length ratio and a tokens-per-character ratio, the second near 1 throughout: what survives matched tokenization is character-level length, which Sanskrit prose lacks over English in SLP1 (1.028) and Sanskrit verse has (0.596). The robust statement is about deployed practice: on contemporary prose and on FLORES, with the Sanskrit side in SLP1 against the deployed o200k English pivot, Sanskrit costs 1.831-2.899 English tokens per proposition under the tokenizers people actually ship. Code, the results snapshot and every table here are public.

AI.tldr: Ablation and tokenizer-matched follow-ups are needed before token premiums can be attributed to morphosyntax rather than to data, vocabulary and encoding choices; as it stands, subword tokenization does not preserve Sanskrit's per-word density over English.
AI.motivation: Sanskrit fuses case, number, person and tense into word endings and chains clauses into compounds, making it information-dense per word. Whether that density survives subword tokenization is a separate question that should be asked per unit of meaning rather than per word, so the paper tests whether tokenizer-induced savings offset Sanskrit's morphological complexity against English.
AI.method: The analysis compares identical FLORES-200 devtest content across deployed tokenizers (vocabularies of 200,019 ids or more) and controlled BPE arms trained on Sanskrit versus matched English controls on the same corpus, comparing 8 matched pairs at 32,000 and 64,000 pieces, each size-matched arm against pair-matched and byte-matched controls, with extension to 128,000 pieces. Ratios are decomposed factorially into a character-length ratio and a tokens-per-character ratio across contemporary prose, FLORES and Sanskrit verse in SLP1.
AI.result: On identical FLORES-200 devtest content, Sanskrit costs 1.774-2.187 times the English tokens under deployed tokenizers but only 1.325-1.353 times the Hindi tokens. Against a deployed English tokenizer, Sanskrit-trained BPE arms appear cheaper per proposition than English on contemporary prose (0.887), but this flip disappears against a matched English control: at 32,000 and 64,000 pieces all 8 matched pairs sit above 1.0 on prose with 95% intervals excluding it. The gap closes as vocabulary grows: at 128,000 pieces the BPE pair reads 0.983 in domain while staying above parity out of domain (1.025) and on FLORES (1.116). The ratio factorises into a character-length ratio and a tokens-per-character ratio near 1 throughout, so what survives matched tokenization is character-level length, which Sanskrit prose lacks over English in SLP1 (1.028) while verse has it (0.596). The robust statement concerns deployed practice: on contemporary prose and FLORES with the Sanskrit side in SLP1 against the deployed o200k English pivot, Sanskrit costs 1.831-2.899 English tokens per proposition.
AI.conclusion: The apparent token-efficiency advantage of Sanskrit BPE arms is an artifact of the deployed English tokenizer baseline rather than a property of the language: under matched controls, all pairs sit above parity on prose, and the gap narrows with vocabulary size. What actually survives matched tokenization is character-level length, not per-word information density.

title: Generative Retrieval for Unsupervised Text-Based Person Search
comment: 17 pages, 10 figures. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
summary: Text-based person search (TBPS) aims to retrieve images of a target person from a large image gallery based on a given natural language description. Most existing methods rely on supervised learning with manually annotated image-text pairs. In this paper, we explore unsupervised TBPS, with only unlabeled images. We propose GTR+, a two-stage generation-then-retrieval framework. In the generation stage, we introduce a tiered description generation framework designed to produce fine-grained and stylistically diverse textual descriptions through a three-tier sequential process. The base tier leverages an automated question-and-answer mechanism to generate basic visual attribute descriptions; the intermediate tier enhances fine-grained detail using an inter-sample contrastive mechanism; the advanced tier further enriches textual diversity via a stylized expansion mechanism. In the retrieval stage, to mitigate the impact of noisy pseudo texts, we develop an adaptive confidence-weighted retrieval learning framework. We model image-text pairs as clean or noisy using a Gaussian Mixture Model, calibrated by real-time image-text similarity and static text generation probability from the prior stage, yielding adaptive sample weights during training. Beyond that, we also contribute LargeFine-Person, a large-scale TBPS dataset with high-quality, fine-grained, and diverse textual annotations, enabling a practical and generalizable TBPS pre-training benchmark under unsupervised setting. Experiments on multiple TBPS benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of both GTR+ and LargeFine-Person. Code is available at: https://github.com/Flame-Chasers/GTR.

AI.tldr: 提出无监督文本行人检索框架GTR+，采用"先生成后检索"两阶段方法，并贡献大规模细粒度数据集LargeFine-Person，在多个基准上验证有效性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本行人检索（TBPS）方法多依赖人工标注的图像-文本对进行监督学习，标注成本高、扩展性差。本文探索仅使用无标注图像的无监督TBPS设定，以降低对人工标注的依赖。
AI.method: GTR+为两阶段"生成-检索"框架。生成阶段：分层描述生成框架，含三层次序流程——基础层用自动问答机制生成基本视觉属性描述；中间层用样本间对比机制增强细粒度细节；高级层用风格化扩展机制提升文本多样性。检索阶段：自适应置信度加权检索学习框架，用高斯混合模型将图像-文本对建模为干净或噪声，并由实时图文相似度与前一阶段静态文本生成概率校准，从而在训练中产生自适应样本权重。此外构建LargeFine-Person大规模TBPS数据集。
AI.result: 在多个TBPS基准上的实验表明GTR+与LargeFine-Person均具有有效性，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了无监督TBPS的可行性，通过分层文本生成与噪声鲁棒的置信度加权检索学习缓解伪文本噪声问题，同时以LargeFine-Person数据集为无监督预训练提供实用且可泛化的基准。代码已开源。

title: Investigating Temporal Motion Features for Pose-to-Text Indian Sign Language Translation
comment: 5 pages, 1 table and 2 figures
summary: We investigate the effect of pretrained T5 model scale and explicit motion features on pose-to-text Indian Sign Language Translation (SLT) for the WSLP 2026 Shared Task. Pose sequences are projected into the embedding space of T5 through a lightweight pose encoder, with the complete model fine-tuned to generate English text. The shared task data used for this work consists of a test set with 5,334 examples and a validation set with 5,257 examples.
