We compare T5-small, T5-base, and T5-large, and additionally introduce a motion-augmented variant, T5-small + Motion, that adds explicit frame-to-frame pose differences to the input representation. T5-small achieves the best BLEU and ROUGE scores among the spatial-only models, while T5-large obtains the highest chrF score. Augmenting T5-small with motion features yields the largest single improvement observed in our study, substantially improving BLEU over the spatial-only baseline and making it the strongest model overall on this metric. Our submitted system ranked 5th on the official WSLP 2026 SLT testing leaderboard. The source code and trained models are publicly available on GitHub and HuggingFace.

AI.tldr: 本文研究预训练T5模型规模与显式运动特征对印度手语姿态到文本翻译的影响，发现T5-small在BLEU/ROUGE上最优，加入运动特征后提升最大，系统在WSLP 2026测试榜排名第5。
AI.motivation: 探索预训练T5模型规模及显式运动特征对姿态到文本的印度手语翻译性能的影响，以提升SLT任务的翻译质量。
AI.method: 通过轻量级姿态编码器将姿态序列投影到T5嵌入空间，并对完整模型进行微调以生成英文文本；对比T5-small、T5-base、T5-large，并提出加入帧间姿态差分的T5-small + Motion运动增强变体。使用含5,334条测试样本和5,257条验证样本的共享任务数据。
AI.result: 在仅空间特征模型中，T5-small取得最佳BLEU与ROUGE，T5-large取得最高chrF；T5-small + Motion带来研究中最大的单项提升，显著优于仅空间基线并在BLEU上成为整体最强模型。提交系统在官方WSLP 2026 SLT测试榜排名第5。
AI.conclusion: 显式运动特征对姿态到文本的印度手语翻译具有显著增益，且小规模T5模型在该任务上具备较强竞争力；代码与模型已公开。

title: SV-Cine: Diagnosis-Conditioned Segmentation of Single Ventricle Physiology via Generative Data Augmentation
comment: arXiv admin comment: This version has been removed by arXiv administrators as the submitter did not have the rights to agree to the license at the time of submission
summary: Single Ventricle Physiology (SVP) is a rare subtype of congenital heart disease characterized by the presence of a single functional cardiac ventricle with atypical anatomic configurations that challenge conventional image segmentation approaches. The scarcity of clinical data and the morphological diversity across SVP subtypes make the development of robust segmentation methods particularly difficult. To address these limitations, we propose a cardiac MRI segmentation framework focused on ventricular chambers and myocardium segmentation tailored for SVP. First, we introduce a data augmentation pipeline that generates synthetic 3D cardiac meshes using SDF4CHD and corresponding synthetic cardiac MRI through generative modeling. Second, we introduce SV-Cine, a diagnosis-conditioned adaptation of the foundation model CineMA that incorporates patient-level diagnostic information through Feature-wise Linear Modulation layers, enabling diagnosis-aware feature adaptation during segmentation. We evaluated the framework on an internal cohort with varying SVP subtypes. SV-Cine achieved median Dice scores of 0.89 (IQR: 0.80--0.91) for the left ventricle and 0.72 (IQR: 0.54--0.84) for the right ventricle, outperforming the strongest baseline, nnU-Net, by 0.39 Dice points on right ventricle segmentation. It also yields a median ejection fraction error of 5.55 percentage points (IQR: 3.41--7.69) for the dominant ventricle. Compared with the internal cohort, LV and myocardium segmentation performance was lower for the external cohort; whereas RV Dice scores were comparable for both cohorts. Our findings suggest that a pretrained foundation model can be adapted for highly specialized downstream tasks through usage of diagnosis priors while leveraging anatomic knowledge learned from large-scale MRI datasets during pretraining.

AI.tldr: 提出针对单心室生理（SVP）心脏MRI分割框架：结合SDF4CHD合成数据增强与诊断条件化基础模型SV-Cine，显著提升右心室分割性能。
AI.motivation: SVP是罕见的先天性心脏病亚型，单一功能心室且解剖结构非典型，加之临床数据稀缺、亚型间形态差异大，导致传统图像分割方法难以奏效，因此需要开发针对SVP的鲁棒分割方案。
AI.method: 框架包含两部分：一是基于SDF4CHD生成合成3D心脏网格，并通过生成式建模得到对应合成心脏MRI的数据增强流程；二是SV-Cine，即在基础模型CineMA上引入诊断条件化适配，通过Feature-wise Linear Modulation（FiLM）层融合患者级诊断信息，实现诊断感知的特征自适应分割。
AI.result: 内部队列上，左心室中位Dice为0.89（IQR 0.80–0.91），右心室为0.72（IQR 0.54–0.84），右心室较最强基线nnU-Net提升0.39 Dice点；主心室射血分数中位误差5.55个百分点（IQR 3.41–7.69）。相比内部队列，外部队列的左心室与心肌分割性能下降，而右心室Dice在两个队列间相当。
AI.conclusion: 预训练基础模型可借助诊断先验适配到高度专业化的下游任务，同时利用大规模MRI预训练中学到的解剖知识，为SVP等罕见病分割提供可行路径。

title: Judging by the Cover: Cleaning LLM Truthfulness Benchmarks to Avoid Surface-Level Feature Leakage
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/foadnamjoo/audit-prune and https://huggingface.co/datasets/foadnamjoo/audit-prune
summary: Binary-choice truth benchmarks ask models to choose between a correct and an incorrect answer, but if the two answers differ systematically in surface-level features, models can exceed chance without performing the intended reasoning. We show that this failure mode is detectable and can be exploited by downstream classifiers. In TruthfulQA, a simple six-feature logistic classifier achieves substantial accuracy in separating correct from incorrect answers. We further show that similar surface-level artifacts are present in additional benchmarks. To counteract this, we developed a general mechanism to clean them by removing the most leakage-reinforcing pairs. We release a version of TruthfulQA with surface-feature leakage reduced close to chance and provide a mechanism, Audit-Prune, so that the datasets can be cleaned before release.

AI.tldr: 二元选择真实性基准中，正确与错误答案常存在表层特征差异，模型可借此"绕过"预期推理而高于随机水平；本文提出检测方法并开发Audit-Prune机制清洗数据集。
AI.motivation: 二元选择真实性基准要求模型在正确与错误答案间做选择，但若两类答案在表层特征上系统性不同，模型无需进行预期推理即可超过随机水平，导致基准评测失效，这一问题此前未被系统检测与治理。
AI.method: 将表层特征泄漏视为可被下游分类器利用的信号：在TruthfulQA上使用仅含六个特征（six-feature）的逻辑回归分类器，判别正确答案与错误答案；并检验其他基准中的类似表层伪迹。针对该问题提出通用清洗机制Audit-Prune，通过剔除最强泄漏强化（leakage-reinforcing）的答案对来降低泄漏。
AI.result: 六特征逻辑分类器在TruthfulQA上分离正确答案与错误答案取得了显著准确率；其他基准中也存在类似的表层伪迹；经Audit-Prune清洗后，TruthfulQA版本的表层特征泄漏已降低至接近随机水平（close to chance）。
AI.conclusion: 表层特征泄漏是可检测且可被利用的基准缺陷；通过Audit-Prune机制可在数据集发布前进行清洗，作者发布了泄漏接近随机水平的TruthfulQA版本，并提供了可复用的清洗机制。

title: Tasks over Application Manuals: Revealing Gaps in Long-Horizon Procedural Reasoning for Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on a wide range of natural language tasks, and recent benchmarks suggest that they are increasingly adept at multi-hop reasoning. However, these benchmarks are typically short-horizon, requiring only a small number of retrieval or inference steps, and provide limited evidence of reliability on real-world tasks that involve following manuals spanning hundreds of pages with complex, interdependent guidelines. In this paper, we introduce Tasks over Application Manuals (TAM), a benchmark for evaluating long-horizon procedural reasoning. We construct TAM by curating real-world tasks from two domains: ICD-10-CM clinical coding (mapping medical conditions to diagnostic codes) and U.S. federal sentencing (computing crime sentencing guideline outcomes, specifically offense levels), with human-validated labels. Each task requires following an authoritative manual with tens of thousands of rules and executing a sequence of interdependent steps across different sections to produce an exact answer. We evaluate general-purpose prompting approaches, including retrieval-augmented generation, ReAct-style prompting, and an agent-harness baseline on GPT-5, and find that the best exact-match performance remains extremely low: 1% on ICD-10-CM coding and 15.5% on sentencing tasks. These results show that current benchmarks may overestimate LLM reasoning ability and miss a key challenge: reliably following long, rule-based procedures. The complete TAM data and code are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出长时域程序性推理基准TAM，基于ICD-10-CM编码与美国联邦量刑两大真实任务，要求模型遵循含数万条规则的权威手册执行多步依赖操作；GPT-5在最佳配置下精确匹配率仅1%与15.5%，表明现有基准高估了LLM推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理基准多为短时域任务，仅需少量检索或推理步骤，难以反映真实世界中需遵循数百页、规则相互依赖的手册完成任务时的可靠性，因此可能高估模型推理能力，并遗漏"可靠遵循长篇规则化流程"这一关键挑战。
AI.method: 构建Tasks over Application Manuals (TAM)基准：从ICD-10-CM临床编码（病历映射至诊断码）与美国联邦量刑（计算犯罪量刑指南结果，具体为犯罪等级）两个领域筛选真实任务，并进行人工校验标注。每个任务需依据包含数万条规则的权威手册，跨不同章节执行一系列相互依赖的步骤以得出精确答案。评测方法涵盖通用提示、检索增强生成（RAG）、ReAct式提示以及agent-harness基线，模型为GPT-5。
AI.result: 最佳精确匹配（exact-match）表现极低：ICD-10-CM编码任务仅1%，量刑任务为15.5%。
AI.conclusion: 当前基准可能高估LLM的推理能力，并忽视了"可靠遵循长规则化流程"这一核心挑战；TAM数据与代码已完全公开。

title: TileNet: Tile-Based CNN-SVM Architecture for Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Systems Inspection of Flat Roofs
comment: Journal of Safety Science and Resilience
summary: Flat roofs are among the most influential components of the building envelope, governing both structural performance and thermal efficiency, and thereby contributing directly to household energy consumption, carbon emissions, and long-term environmental sustainability. Timely detection of roof defects is essential for reducing heating and cooling losses, preventing moisture-driven degradation such as mold growth, and supporting national climate-change mitigation goals. This paper presents a real-time, Unmanned Aerial System (UAS)-based deep learning framework that autonomously detects defects using live imagery captured during dual-altitude aerial passes. The multi-resolution flight strategy is designed to aid the identification of both small, fine-scale defects and larger structural issues, enabling more comprehensive assessments. To meet the strict computational and power constraints of embedded UAS hardware, the proposed framework integrates a tile-based architecture with a lightweight Convolution Neural Network-Support Vector Machine (CNN-SVM) classifier designed for low-latency onboard inference. The final model-comprising five convolutional layers and four dense layers, the last a linear SVM head, achieved a mean test accuracy of $94.4\%$ ($95\%$ confidence interval $\pm0.4\%$ over three seeds) on a photo-level split ($43,383$ training, $3,869$ validation, and $2,540$ test tiled and augmented images), outperforming GoogLeNet ($89.2\%$) and AlexNet ($79.8\%$). Experimental evaluations using real UAS imagery collected by onsite visits with DJI Matrice 350 RTK drone demonstrate that the system supports rapid, repeatable, and safe roof inspections while reducing human risk, lowering operational costs, and enabling more sustainable building maintenance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于无人机（UAS）的实时深度学习框架，采用双高度多分辨率飞行与轻量级CNN-SVM分类器，实现平屋顶缺陷的机载实时检测，测试准确率达94.4%，优于GoogLeNet和AlexNet。
AI.motivation: 平屋顶是建筑围护结构中最关键的部分之一，直接影响结构性能与热效率，进而关系到家庭能耗、碳排放和长期环境可持续性。及时检测屋顶缺陷有助于减少冷暖能耗损失、防止湿气导致的霉变等劣化，并支持国家气候减缓目标。然而，嵌入式无人机硬件的算力与功耗受限，现有方法难以兼顾多尺度缺陷识别与低延迟实时推理。
AI.method: 提出基于UAS的实时深度学习框架，通过双高度飞行采集实时图像并自主检测缺陷。采用多分辨率飞行策略以兼顾细小缺陷与大型结构问题。为满足嵌入式硬件约束，框架结合分块（tile-based）架构与轻量级CNN-SVM分类器，实现低延迟机载推理。最终模型含5个卷积层和4个全连接层，最后一层为线性SVM头。
AI.result: 在照片级划分数据集（43,383张训练、3,869张验证、2,540张测试的分块与增强图像）上，模型平均测试准确率为94.4%（三个随机种子下95%置信区间±0.4%），优于GoogLeNet（89.2%）和AlexNet（79.8%）。使用DJI Matrice 350 RTK无人机实地采集的真实UAS图像进行实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 该系统支持快速、可重复且安全的屋顶检测，可降低人员风险与运营成本，并促进更可持续的建筑维护，验证了多分辨率UAS实时缺陷检测框架的可行性与有效性。

title: To Memories and Beyond: From Remembering to Knowing You across Long-Term Multimodal Personal Archives
summary: As AI systems evolve into personalized digital companions, a central capability is reasoning over a user's long-term personal history: not merely storing past events, but tracking longitudinal experiences and evolving preferences. Progress here is bottlenecked by evaluation, existing long-term memory benchmarks are largely synthetic and text-only, they overlook the visual records that anchor everyday human memory, lack the authentic and causally connected longitudinal data that real personalization demands, and consequently remain confined to shallow factual recall. We introduce ReaLMem (Real-world Long-term Multimodal Memory), the first benchmark built from authentic multi-year personal visual archives, paired with first-person subjective annotations. ReaLMem evaluates models across three cognitive tiers of increasing difficulty: factual recall, persona inference, and predictive personalization. We further propose ChronoProfiler, a temporal-weighting profiling module that computes temporal stability scores for user attributes and applies them as a salience prior, resolving conflicts among temporally inconsistent preferences and helping models compound multiple co-active preferences in complex personalized decisions. Extensive evaluation of frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and memory systems on ReaLMem reveals predictive personalization as a consistent ceiling, exposes clear performance gaps and bottlenecks between MLLMs and memory systems, and shows that high-quality, temporally informed representations substantially improve personalization. Together, ReaLMem and ChronoProfiler provide an authentic testbed and a simple, effective mechanism for long-term personalization, laying a foundation for future research on lifelong AI companions.

AI.tldr: 提出ReaLMem（首个基于真实多年份个人视觉档案的多模态长期记忆基准）与ChronoProfiler时序加权画像模块，用于评测和改进AI长期个性化能力。
AI.motivation: AI系统正演变为个性化数字伴侣，核心能力是对用户长期个人历史的推理，即追踪纵向经验与偏好演化。但该方向受限于评测：现有长期记忆基准多为合成、纯文本，忽视锚定日常人类记忆的视觉记录，缺乏真实且因果关联的纵向数据，因而仅停留在浅层事实回忆。
AI.method: 构建ReaLMem基准：基于真实多年份个人视觉档案，配以第一人称主观标注；按三个认知层级递进评测——事实回忆、人格推断、预测性个性化。并提出ChronoProfiler时序加权画像模块：计算用户属性的时间稳定性得分，作为显著性先验，用以化解时间上不一致偏好间的冲突，并帮助模型在复杂个性化决策中复合多个共激活偏好。
AI.result: 在前沿多模态大模型（MLLMs）与记忆系统上的广泛评测显示：预测性个性化是持续存在的性能瓶颈（ceiling）；MLLMs与记忆系统间存在明显性能差距与瓶颈；高质量、具时间感知的表征显著提升个性化效果。
AI.conclusion: ReaLMem与ChronoProfiler为长期个性化提供了真实测试平台与简单有效的机制，为未来终身AI伴侣研究奠定基础。

title: Label-Guided Knowledge Distillation for 3D-CNNs in Action Recognition
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures
summary: As a key model compression technique, knowledge distillation aims to transfer knowledge from a high-capacity teacher model to a lightweight student model for enhancing the latter's performance. In this work, we reviewed the feature knowledge distillation for 3D-CNNs and observed that most feature distillation methods in video analysis are simple adaptations of those used in image analysis, often neglecting the differences of video features in the temporal dimension. To address this issue, we proposed Label-Guided Knowledge Distillation (LGKD) to guide the distillation of student model features using ground truth labels. Our method entails two components: sample-wise distillation and class-wise distillation, enabling the student model to learn feature representation of the teacher model at two levels. Sample-wise distillation utilizes label information and the teacher's probability distribution to guide the learning of features that significantly impact temporal accuracy while mitigating noise. Meanwhile, class-wise feature distillation employs a prototype network to further capture the relational knowledge among samples within the same category, enhancing the student's ability to learn higher-dimensional semantic information and improving model generalization. To demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our method, we conducted comprehensive experiments on two benchmark action recognition datasets, UCF101 and HMDB51, achieving competitive results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出标签引导知识蒸馏（LGKD），通过样本级与类别级蒸馏，解决3D-CNN视频特征蒸馏中忽视时间维度差异的问题，在UCF101和HMDB51上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频分析中的特征蒸馏方法多是对图像分析方法的简单迁移，忽视了视频特征在时间维度上的差异，未能充分利用视频的时序信息。
AI.method: 提出LGKD，利用真值标签引导学生模型特征蒸馏，包含两部分：（1）样本级蒸馏，结合标签信息与教师概率分布，引导学习对时间精度影响显著的特征并抑制噪声；（2）类别级特征蒸馏，采用原型网络捕捉同类样本间的关系知识，增强高维语义学习与泛化能力。
AI.result: 在UCF101与HMDB51两个基准动作识别数据集上开展全面实验，取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: LGKD通过标签引导的样本级与类别级蒸馏，有效提升3D-CNN学生模型的时序特征表示与泛化性能，验证了方法的有效性与优越性。

title: Unified CT and MRI Pancreas Segmentation for Label-Efficient Cross-Modality Subregion Transfer
summary: Robust medical image segmentation across imaging modalities is challenging because of large differences in appearance and intensity distributions. Models trained on a single modality often show substantial performance drops when applied to unseen domains. In this work, we develop a unified 3D pancreas segmentation framework that applies domain-adversarial learning to 4,604 heterogeneous CT and MRI scans to learn anatomical representations. A shared nnU-Net encoder-decoder is trained for whole-pancreas segmentation, with a latent domain discriminator encouraging CT-MRI feature alignment. The learned encoder is subsequently transferred to pancreatic head-body-tail segmentation using limited MRI-only subregion annotations. An average Dice score of 87.31% on the in-distribution test set and Dice scores ranging from 84.20% to 88.09% across external OOD datasets were achieved in whole pancreas segmentation. Dice scores of 80.53% on MRI and 83.05% on CT were achieved for downstream subregion segmentation, without using CT subregion annotations. These results demonstrate that a unified anatomical representation can support both cross-modality pancreas segmentation and label-efficient downstream transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出统一3D胰腺分割框架，用域对抗学习在4,604例CT/MRI上学习解剖表征，实现跨模态全胰分割与标签高效的下游子区域迁移。
AI.motivation: 医学图像跨模态分割困难，因不同成像方式在外观与强度分布上差异大，单模态训练模型在未见域上性能显著下降。
AI.method: 采用共享的nnU-Net编码器-解码器进行全胰分割，引入隐空间域判别器进行域对抗学习以对齐CT-MRI特征；随后将学到的编码器迁移至胰头-体-尾子区域分割，仅使用有限MRI子区域标注。
AI.result: 全胰分割在同分布测试集上平均Dice为87.31%，外部OOD数据集Dice为84.20%–88.09%；下游子区域分割MRI Dice为80.53%、CT为83.05%，且未使用CT子区域标注。
AI.conclusion: 统一的解剖表征可同时支持跨模态胰腺分割与标签高效的下游任务迁移。

title: Kraken: LLM-based Speech-to-Speech Translation via Low-bitrate VQ and Dual-path Source Conditioning
summary: Speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) has advanced significantly with speech LLMs, offering the potential for joint optimization and preserving non-linguistic information. However, these models struggle with predicting high-bitrate speech tokens in LLMs, and face the challenge of relying on S2ST training data with ideally aligned speaker identity and prosody. We propose using low-bitrate tokens based on single-layer vector quantization, trained to reconstruct self-supervised learning (SSL) features. We also employ a separate token-to-waveform decoder named Autowave-X, which is also conditioned on the source speech to improve non-linguistic transfer, thereby relaxing the training data constraints. With the integration of these techniques, we propose an S2ST model named Kraken, which augments a pre-trained LLM with speech feature inputs and the low-bitrate token outputs, followed by Autowave-X vocoder. We built the model upon Qwen3-8B and trained it using 150k hours of multilingual and multitask speech data. We demonstrated that our model exhibited better translation quality than SeamlessM4T-Large v2 and Qwen2.5-Omni, along with improved speaker and prosody transfer capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Kraken语音到语音翻译模型，采用单层向量量化低比特率token（重建SSL特征）与独立token-to-waveform解码器Autowave-X（以源语音为条件），基于Qwen3-8B并用15万小时多语多任务语音数据训练，在翻译质量及说话人、韵律迁移上优于SeamlessM4T-Large v2与Qwen2.5-Omni。
AI.motivation: 现有语音LLM的S2ST面临两大问题：一是LLM难以预测高比特率语音token；二是依赖说话人身份与韵律理想对齐的S2ST训练数据，数据约束强。
AI.method: 1）采用基于单层向量量化的低比特率token，并以重建自监督学习（SSL）特征为目标进行训练；2）引入独立的token-to-waveform解码器Autowave-X，同时以源语音为条件以增强非语言信息迁移，从而放宽训练数据约束；3）将预训练LLM（Qwen3-8B）扩展为接受语音特征输入并输出低比特率token，后接Autowave-X声码器，构成Kraken模型；4）使用15万小时多语言、多任务语音数据训练。
AI.result: Kraken在翻译质量上优于SeamlessM4T-Large v2和Qwen2.5-Omni，同时具备更好的说话人与韵律迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过低比特率SSL特征量化token与条件化于源语音的独立声码器，可有效缓解LLM预测高比特率token的困难及训练数据对齐约束，实现翻译质量与非语言信息保留的联合提升。

title: Expert-Space Exploration in MoE Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become central to post-training of large language models. Recent advances in RL for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have primarily focused on improving optimization stability and training efficiency, while treating the expert selection as a fixed component. Since routing determines the sparse computation paths that induce output distributions, expert selection offers an additional source of rollout diversity. Through empirical analysis, we find that perturbing expert routing effectively alters model output and increases rollout diversity, which is similar to increasing the decoding temperature. However, direct perturbation can activate unsuitable experts and substantially degrade rollout quality. Motivated by these observations, we introduce Expert-Space Exploration Reinforcement Learning (ESRL), an architecture-aware framework that explicitly explores the expert-routing space of MoE models. ESRL preserves high-confidence experts as anchors, and restricts stochastic routing to a plausible candidate pool, thereby retaining reliable computation paths. The perturbation strength is further adapted according to router entropy to avoid over-perturbation. To mitigate the routing mismatch introduced by perturbation, ESRL records the expert paths used during rollout and replays them during policy optimization. Experiments demonstrate that ESRL achieves the best performance across MoE backbones with top-K, top-1, and shared-expert routing, as well as across mathematics, science, and code tasks without additional sampling or computational cost. Specifically, ESRL on Qwen3-30B-A3B achieves the best among all compared methods, improving average Pass@1 and Pass@8 over GRPO by 3.2 and 4.5 percentage points, respectively. Further analyses of expert utilization and training dynamics provide insights into how exploiting MoE-specific routing structure benefits RL training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ESRL，一种面向MoE架构的强化学习框架，将专家路由视为可探索的空间以提升rollout多样性，在多个骨干与任务上超越GRPO且无额外采样开销。
AI.motivation: 现有针对MoE大模型的RL后训练工作主要关注优化稳定性与训练效率，通常将专家选择（路由）视为固定组件。然而路由决定了诱导输出分布的稀疏计算路径，因此本身可作为rollout多样性的额外来源。经验分析发现，扰动专家路由能有效改变模型输出并提升rollout多样性，效果类似于提高解码温度；但直接扰动会激活不合适的专家，显著降低rollout质量。
AI.method: 提出ESRL（Expert-Space Exploration Reinforcement Learning），一种架构感知框架，显式探索MoE模型的专家路由空间。具体做法：保留高置信度专家作为锚点，将随机路由限制在合理的候选池内，以维持可靠计算路径；根据路由熵自适应调整扰动强度以避免过度扰动；记录rollout中使用的专家路径，并在策略优化时重放，以缓解扰动带来的路由不匹配问题。
AI.result: 在top-K、top-1及共享专家路由的多种MoE骨干上，以及数学、科学、代码任务上取得最佳性能，且无额外采样或计算开销。在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，ESRL优于所有对比方法，平均Pass@1与Pass@8分别较GRPO提升3.2和4.5个百分点。对专家利用率与训练动态的分析揭示了利用MoE特定路由结构对RL训练的益处。
AI.conclusion: ESRL表明，将MoE专家路由作为可探索空间进行架构感知的强化学习，可在不增加采样与计算成本的前提下有效提升RL训练效果，为MoE后训练提供了新思路。

title: MAxBench: A Multinomial Concept Recovery Benchmark
summary: Fine-grained control of language model behaviors (e.g., steering) is among the more actionable outcomes of interpretability research. For binary concepts such as refusal, a single direction in activation space often suffices for steering. However, many concepts are not binary: Animals and Countries contain many subcategories, each with multiple instances. For these concepts, the search space over possible representation geometries is far larger than for binary concepts; it is thus not clear what geometries are most appropriate, nor what methods are most effective at recovering them. In this work, we introduce MAxBench, a geometry-agnostic evaluation framework for multinomial concept representations based on sampling from the recovered concept representation. We use MAxBench to compare 10 localization methods (covering 5 geometry types) across 6 concepts and 4 models. Using this framework, we find that (i) affine subspaces steer more reliably and have greater recall than rank-one or linear subspaces; (ii) much of this advantage is due to better non-zero offsets rather than the choice of bases; (iii) manifold steering is competitive with the best methods when applicable; and (iv) no method consistently outperforms prompting, in alignment with prior findings on binary concepts. These findings underscore the importance of expanding the scope of interpretability research and meta-evaluation to concepts with more varied structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MAxBench，一个面向多分类概念表示的、与几何结构无关的评测框架，通过从恢复的概念表示中采样来比较10种定位方法（5类几何），发现仿射子空间在6个概念、4个模型上操控更可靠、召回更高，但其优势主要来自非零偏移而非基的选择，流形方法与最优方法相当，且无方法稳定超越提示。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性研究多聚焦二值概念（如拒绝），单方向即可实现操控；但许多概念（如动物、国家）是多分类的，包含多个子类及多个实例，其表示几何的搜索空间远大于二值概念，因此何种几何最合适、何种方法最有效尚不明确，缺乏统一评测手段。
AI.method: 提出 MAxBench，一种与几何结构无关的多分类概念表示评测框架，基于从恢复的概念表示中采样进行评估；据此在6个概念、4个模型上比较10种定位方法，覆盖5种几何类型。
AI.result: (i) 仿射子空间的操控可靠性和召回率优于秩一或线性子空间；(ii) 该优势主要源于更好的非零偏移，而非基的选择；(iii) 在适用时，流形操控与最优方法相当；(iv) 没有方法能稳定优于提示（prompting），与二值概念上的既有发现一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果凸显了将可解释性研究与元评测扩展到结构更丰富的概念上的重要性。

title: MP-Bench: Evaluating Voice Agents as a Multiparty Conversation Participant
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Findings
summary: Conversational voice agents have advanced significantly, offering increasingly natural human-machine interactions through both cascaded and end-to-end architectures. However, while recent benchmarks extensively evaluate dyadic interactions and passive audio comprehension, they largely overlook a prevalent real-world scenario: multi-party conversations. Evaluating agents in these settings is fundamentally more challenging than in dyadic interactions due to the exponentially greater conversational complexity. For voice agents to integrate seamlessly into human group dynamics, they must not only generate contextually appropriate responses but also demonstrate a nuanced understanding of open turn-taking. To address this gap, we introduce Multiparty Bench (MP-Bench), the first benchmark specifically designed to objectively evaluate conversational speech systems as active participants within multi-party contexts. MP-Bench assesses agent behavior along two primary dimensions: turn-taking awareness and response appropriateness. Additionally, we incorporate comprehension-based question-answering tasks as a complementary evaluation. By benchmarking 12 voice agents, we find that real-time voice agents stay at or below 22% on multiparty comprehension and remain near chance on multiparty turn-taking, exposing an open challenge for real-time voice agents under multiparty scenario.

AI.tldr: 提出 MP-Bench，首个面向多方对话的语音智能体评测基准，从轮次转换意识、回应适当性与理解问答三维度评测，12 个语音智能体表现均不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要评测二元对话与被动音频理解，忽视多方对话这一常见真实场景；多方场景的对话复杂度呈指数级增长，要求智能体既能生成符合语境的回应，又能理解开放式轮次转换，缺乏相应评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 MP-Bench 基准，将语音智能体作为多方对话中的主动参与者进行客观评测，包含两个主要维度（轮次转换意识、回应适当性），并补充基于理解的问答任务作为辅助评测；对 12 个语音智能体进行基准测试。
AI.result: 实时语音智能体在多方理解任务上得分不超过 22%，在多方轮次转换任务上接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 多方场景对实时语音智能体构成开放挑战，MP-Bench 为该方向提供了首个客观评测基准，揭示当前系统的显著能力缺口。

title: Continue, Adapt, or Yield: In-Turn Adaptation to Overlapping Speech in Full-Duplex Agents
comment: 12 pages, 8 tables
summary: Full-duplex evaluation often emphasizes whether an agent keeps speaking or stops. That binary cannot express a third response humans use routinely: continuing to speak while incorporating what the listener just contributed. The contribution may be a missing word, a correction or a clarification. We introduce Duplex Cue, an evaluation of this \emph{in-turn adaptation} in full-duplex voice agents. Duplex Cue separates listener intent (backchannel, collaboration, or interruption) from speaker behavior: continuing unchanged, adapting within the turn, or yielding. Adaptation includes acknowledgment as well as content revision. In a single-model case study using 300 human-confirmed cues from unscripted English conversations, we compare recorded human responses with PersonaPlex continuations generated while replaying the listener's audio. We retain 208 pairs with the ongoing speaker active at cue onset and a scorable response in each condition. On the 66 collaborative pairs, recorded speakers adapt in 68.2\% of cases, compared with 34.8\% for PersonaPlex. The model otherwise continues unchanged (42.4\%) or yields (22.7\%). These findings show why evaluating natural voice interaction requires measuring how an agent responds to a listener's contribution as well as whether it keeps speaking.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Duplex Cue 评估框架，将全双工语音智能体的"话轮内适应"（继续说话同时纳入听者贡献）作为第三类响应，并用 300 条人类确认的英语对话线索比较人类与 PersonaPlex 模型表现。
AI.motivation: 现有全双工评测多用"继续说 vs 停止"的二元标准，无法表达人类常用的第三种响应：在继续说话的同时吸收听者刚提供的缺失词、纠正或澄清。因此需要新的评测维度来衡量自然语音交互中的话轮内适应能力。
AI.method: 提出 Duplex Cue 评测，将听者意图（backchannel、collaboration、interruption）与说话者行为（不変继续、话轮内适应、让出话轮）分离，适应包括确认与内容修正。单模型案例研究使用 300 条来自非脚本英语对话、经人类确认的线索，比较录制的真人响应与在回放听者音频时生成的 PersonaPlex 续说；保留 208 对（线索起点时原说话者活跃、两种条件均可评分）。
AI.result: 在 66 对协作（collaborative）样本上，真人说话者适应比例为 68.2%，PersonaPlex 为 34.8%；该模型其余情况为不变继续（42.4%）或让出话轮（22.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 评估自然语音交互不仅要测智能体是否继续说，还须测其如何回应听者的贡献，Duplex Cue 为话轮内适应提供了可操作的评测路径。

title: Recurrent Dynamic Range Extension
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to ACM SIGGRAPH Asia 2026
summary: We present an approach to progressively extend the highlights of an image. Instead of reconstructing the full dynamic range of a complex scene directly, we learn a simpler task first: We extend the dynamic range of an input image by a single exposure value. Once this is mastered, we retrieve the full HDR image for the scene by executing our network recurrently, progressively increasing the dynamic range of the input. Our formulation is agnostic to the input dynamic range and targets a bounded output domain. This enables us to use widely available RAW images for the reconstruction task and adapt adversarial losses to construct realistic images. By incorporating Memory Replay for backpropagation, we can train our network recurrently over multiple inference stages and reduce reconstruction errors. As a consequence, our system reconstructs challenging long-tailed HDR scenes robustly and shows powerful recovery of bright light sources and highlights.

AI.tldr: 提出一种渐进式扩展图像高光的方法：先学习单曝光值(EV)动态范围扩展这一简单任务，再通过循环执行网络逐步提升动态范围，最终重建完整HDR图像。
AI.motivation: 直接从复杂场景重建完整动态范围是困难的任务。作者希望将这一难题分解为更易学习的子任务，并利用广泛可得的RAW图像作为训练数据，同时适配对抗损失以生成真实感图像。
AI.method: 将动态范围扩展分解为单曝光值(EV)的增量任务；训练后的网络可循环(recurrent)执行，逐步提升输入动态范围直至全HDR。方法对输入动态范围无关(agnostic)，目标为有界输出域；引入Memory Replay进行反向传播，使网络能在多个推理阶段上循环训练，降低重建误差；并结合对抗损失。
AI.result: 网络可循环训练于多个推理阶段，重建误差降低；系统能稳健地重建具有挑战性的长尾(long-tailed)HDR场景，对明亮光源和高光有强力的恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: 渐进式、循环递进的动态范围扩展策略配合Memory Replay与对抗损失，可有效且稳健地实现HDR重建，尤其擅长恢复高光与亮光源。

title: SAS: Simple Attention Sparsification via End-to-End Optimization of Context Ranking
summary: Post-training attention sparsification reduces the quadratic cumulative attention cost of pretrained Transformers by selecting a small set of context units (tokens or blocks) for each query. Existing trainable methods usually use a lightweight selector to score context units, followed by hard Top-K selection that blocks gradients from the language modeling loss. Consequently, these methods commonly distill layer-wise dense attention distributions. Although this encourages the selector to rank context units by dense attention weights in the original model, the ranking is not directly aligned with their impact on predictions under a fixed attention budget (i.e., the number of attended context units per query), potentially wasting the limited budget on less useful units. To address this misalignment, we propose Simple Attention Sparsification (SAS), a gated sparse attention mechanism that optimizes context ranking end-to-end with the language modeling loss. The key idea is to inject the selector's continuous scores into attention logits during training, allowing the loss to update the selector through standard backpropagation. We identify several choices crucial for this simple design to work well in practice: placing the gate inside the attention softmax in log form, using normalized softmax gates to calibrate historical context against the always-retained current block, and preserving continuous selector scores so the model learns relative priorities rather than only hard selections. To support long-sequence training, we implement a memory-efficient Triton kernel that integrates SAS into FlashAttention-style computation. Across reasoning, long-context understanding, and agentic tasks, SAS consistently outperforms trainable sparse attention baselines across attention budgets, with especially large gains under tight budgets, demonstrating more effective context ranking for downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出SAS（Simple Attention Sparsification），一种门控稀疏注意力机制，通过在训练时将选择器的连续分数注入注意力logits，使选择器能被语言建模损失端到端优化，从而让上下文排序与预测影响对齐；并实现内存高效的Triton内核以支持长序列训练。
AI.motivation: 现有可训练稀疏注意力方法通常用轻量选择器打分后做硬Top-K选择，导致梯度被阻断，只能依赖逐层稠密注意力分布来蒸馏。这种排序虽符合原模型的稠密注意力权重，却并不直接等价于在固定注意力预算下对预测的实际影响，可能把有限预算浪费在用处较小的上下文单元上，造成排序与预测目标之间的错位。
AI.method: SAS将选择器的连续分数注入注意力logits，使损失可通过标准反向传播更新选择器。作者指出三个关键设计：将门控以log形式置于注意力softmax内部；使用归一化softmax门控以校准历史上下文与始终保留的当前块之间的相对关系；保留连续的选择器分数，使模型学习相对优先级而非仅学习硬选择。为支持长序列训练，实现了将SAS集成进FlashAttention式计算的内存高效Triton内核。
AI.result: 在推理、长上下文理解与智能体任务上，SAS在各注意力预算下均一致优于可训练稀疏注意力基线，在紧凑预算下提升尤为显著，表明其上下文排序对下游任务更有效。
AI.conclusion: 端到端优化上下文排序（而非蒸馏稠密注意力分布）能缓解固定预算下的排序错位问题；无需复杂设计，仅需合理的门控形式与连续分数保留，即可在多种任务与预算下取得稳定优势，验证了该简单机制在长序列场景下的实用性与可扩展性。

title: Type Diversity Enables Transformers to Generalise Compositionally
comment: Under review
summary: Compositional generalisation has been divided into lexical and structural generalisation. Previous work has found that structural generalisation is harder than lexical for Transformers. We propose that this difference is not inherent to Transformers, but due to the high diversity of lexical types and low diversity of structural types in the specific datasets of these previous works. By type diversity we mean the number of different constructors of that type, instead of, for example, the specific word combinations that might populate the structure. To test this, we vary the amounts of type diversity of lexical and structural types in previously published datasets. We create linguistically diverse variants of the COGS and SLOG datasets using Grammatical Framework. We find that type diversity correlates with compositional generalisation equally in lexical and structural test cases, supporting our hypothesis. We note a contradiction with the proposition in previous work that compound divergence explains the difficulty in compositional generalisation tasks. We further investigate the effects of other dataset properties on compositional generalisation, such as the diversity of types other than the novel test structure, and surface properties of the logical semantics format.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑"Transformer结构泛化难于词汇泛化"的既有结论，提出该差异源于数据集类型多样性差异而非模型固有属性，并通过构建语言多样化的COGS与SLOG变体验证了这一假设。
AI.motivation: 先前研究将组合泛化分为词汇泛化与结构泛化，并发现Transformer在结构泛化上更困难。作者认为这一差异并非Transformer固有特性，而是由于既有数据集词汇类型多样性高、结构类型多样性低所致，因此需要控制类型多样性重新检验。
AI.method: 采用"类型多样性"（即某类型不同构造子数量，而非具体词组合）作为变量，在已发表数据集上调节词汇与结构类型的多样性；利用Grammatical Framework构建语言多样化的COGS与SLOG变体，并进一步考察其他数据集属性（非新测试结构的类型多样性、逻辑语义格式的表面属性）对组合泛化的影响。
AI.result: 类型多样性在词汇与结构测试用例中与组合泛化的相关性程度相同，支持作者假设；同时发现该结果与先前"复合散度（compound divergence）解释组合泛化难度"的命题存在矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 结构泛化难于词汇泛化并非Transformer内在属性，而由数据集类型多样性差异造成；复合散度并非组合泛化难度的合理解释，类型多样性及其他数据集属性均对组合泛化有影响。

title: SNAP3D: Physically Grounded 3D Parts for Assembly from a Single Image
comment: Project page: https://lucytuan.github.io/SNAP3D/
summary: Part-aware 3D asset generation enables applications such as editing, articulation, simulation, and fabrication, yet existing methods can generate visually complete individual parts without ensuring that they form a valid physical assembly. Consequently, generated neighboring parts may interpenetrate, lack valid connections, or collapse under gravity. We propose a physics-guided framework for improving single-image part-aware 3D generation with physically compatible geometry and stable connections. Our method resolves inter-part penetration, recovers a contact graph between neighboring parts, and introduces parameterized connectors at their contact surfaces. Using feedback from physical simulation, we refine connector placement, orientation, and dimensions to improve assembly stability while preserving the generated geometry. We further introduce a physics-based evaluation protocol that complements conventional geometric metrics by directly testing assembly validity and stability under gravity. Experiments comparing against multiple part-aware 3D generators show substantial improvements in physical realizability and stability while maintaining geometric quality. We additionally validate the resulting parts through 3D printing and real-world assembly.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种物理引导框架，用于单图像部件感知3D生成，通过消除部件间穿透、恢复接触图并引入参数化连接件，结合物理仿真反馈优化，使生成部件构成稳定可组装的物理结构，并给出基于物理的评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有部件感知3D生成方法虽能生成视觉完整的单个部件，但无法保证它们构成有效的物理装配体，导致相邻部件相互穿透、缺乏有效连接或在重力下坍塌。该工作旨在提升单图像部件感知3D生成的物理可实现性与装配稳定性。
AI.method: 提出物理引导框架：1）消除部件间穿透；2）恢复相邻部件间的接触图；3）在接触面引入参数化连接件；4）利用物理仿真反馈精调连接件的放置、朝向与尺寸，在保持生成几何的同时提升装配稳定性。此外引入基于物理的评估协议，直接测试重力下的装配有效性与稳定性。
AI.result: 与多个部件感知3D生成方法对比，在保持几何质量的同时，物理可实现性与稳定性显著提升；并通过3D打印与实物装配验证了生成部件。
AI.conclusion: 将物理约束与仿真反馈引入部件感知3D生成，可有效解决穿透、连接缺失与重力坍塌问题，实现可打印、可实际组装的稳定装配体，并为该任务提供物理层面的评估标准。

title: RFCLLM: Evaluating LLMs' Reasoning Ability of Network Protocol State Machines
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Findings)
summary: Mapping textual specifications into formal representations is essential for ensuring the correctness of protocol designs and implementations. LLM-generated mappings, used for networking security or testing, are assumed to capture a perfect understanding of the specification, which may not hold in practice. The goal of this paper is to assess the extent to which LLMs can interpret the specification correctly. We examine the degree to which an LLM's implicit representation of a finite-state transition system-defined via natural language descriptions-aligns with a manually generated ground-truth model. We designed 4 tasks and 1482 task queries for 16 protocols. We evaluated different judge biases, observed the inherent difficulty gaps between tasks, looked into the effect of 4 context types, and the influence of protocol characteristics. Our work contributes to a step toward verifying whether LLMs can really be trusted in FSM (Finite State Machine) reasoning of protocol specifications.

AI.tldr: 本文评估LLM能否正确理解协议规范的自然语言描述，并将其映射为FSM形式化表示。作者设计4类任务、1482条查询，覆盖16个协议，考察评判偏置、任务难度差异、4种上下文类型及协议特征的影响。
AI.motivation: 将文本规范映射为形式化表示是保证协议设计与实现正确性的关键。现有工作（如用于网络安全或测试的LLM映射）默认LLM完美理解规范，该假设在实践中未必成立，因此需要量化评估LLM解读规范的正确程度。
AI.method: 以自然语言描述定义的有限状态转移系统为对象，比较LLM的隐式表示与人工构建的ground-truth模型的一致性。设计了4类任务、1482条任务查询，覆盖16种协议，并系统分析不同评判偏置、任务间固有难度差距、4种上下文类型的作用以及协议自身特征的影响。
AI.result: 通过上述多维度评测，揭示了LLM在协议规范FSM推理中的理解程度与局限：任务难度存在固有差距，评判偏置与上下文类型、协议特征均对结果产生影响。
AI.conclusion: 本工作是迈向验证LLM在协议规范FSM推理中是否真正可信的一步，说明不能默认LLM对规范有完美理解，需对其形式化映射能力加以审慎评估。

title: ConeGaussian: Anti-Aliased Gaussian Ray-Tracing for Generic Central Cameras
summary: In rendering, a camera is a sampling operator that maps each finite pixel to a bundle of rays. Different camera models change the geometry of this bundle, thus making a unified and faithful rendering formulation challenging. Consequently, Gaussian ray tracing supports generic cameras (with optical center) through their inverse ray mappings, yet typically reduces every pixel to a single center ray. This ignores the camera-dependent pixel footprint, causing aliasing under minification, while unconstrained Gaussians expose unsupported frequencies under magnification. We present ConeGaussian, a camera-model-agnostic anti-aliasing framework for Gaussian ray-based rendering. Instead of defining the pixel filter on a camera-specific image plane, ConeGaussian constructs an anisotropic footprint directly from neighboring rays produced by the camera's native inverse mapping. We derive a closed-form response under a locally linear, depth-local, moment-matched approximation of the finite pixel footprint, while the same geometry defines a per-Gaussian training-frequency floor. Notably, by construction, our filtering principle can be used unmodified across calibrated central camera models and multiple Gaussian ray-rendering backbones. Additionally, unlike in mip-splatting, our scene-space frequency floor and filtering enable trivial composition at render time, allowing us to remove excess blurring. On pinhole and strongly distorted fisheye captures, ConeGaussian consistently improves two distinct ray-based backbones, by up to 4.3 dB at 1/8 resolution, and reduces fisheye LPIPS by 30% where perspective screen-plane footprint formulations are not directly applicable.

AI.tldr: ConeGaussian 提出一种与相机模型无关的抗锯齿框架，直接从相机原生逆映射产生的相邻光线构建各向异性像素足迹，实现 Gaussian 光线渲染的通用抗锯齿。
AI.motivation: 现有 Gaussian 光线追踪虽通过逆光线映射支持含光心的通用相机，但通常将每个像素简化为单条中心光线，忽略了相机相关的像素足迹。这导致缩小（minification）时出现走样，而放大（magnification）时未受约束的高斯暴露出不支持的频率。透视屏幕平面足迹公式又无法直接应用于畸变严重的鱼眼等相机。
AI.method: ConeGaussian 不在相机特定的成像平面上定义像素滤波，而是利用相机原生逆映射产生的相邻光线直接构建各向异性足迹。作者在局部线性、深度局部、矩匹配的有限像素足迹近似下推导出闭式响应，同时该几何定义了每个高斯在训练时的频率下限。该滤波原理无需修改即可用于标定后的中心相机模型和多种 Gaussian 光线渲染骨干。
AI.result: 在针孔和强畸变鱼眼拍摄数据上，ConeGaussian 持续改进两种不同的基于光线的骨干，在 1/8 分辨率下最高提升 4.3 dB；在透视屏幕平面足迹公式无法直接应用的鱼眼场景中，将 LPIPS 降低 30%。
AI.conclusion: ConeGaussian 是一个相机模型无关的抗锯齿框架，能跨中心相机模型与多种 Gaussian 光线渲染骨干通用。与 mip-splatting 不同，其场景空间频率下限与滤波支持渲染时简单合成，从而可去除多余模糊，在针孔与鱼眼捕获上均取得显著一致的质量提升。

title: Translation-Invariant Tile-Based Phase Unwrapping with Residual-Weighted Multipath Averaging
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Preprint
summary: Phase unwrapping is a key step in interferometric and coherent imaging, where the physical quantity of interest is carried by a phase that the instrument delivers only modulo 2*pi. The difficulty in two dimensions is to separate the jumps caused by wrapping from those produced by noise, by true discontinuities, by under-sampling or by decorrelation. Spatial-domain and frequency-domain methods have both been studied extensively, each with advantages the other lacks; hybrid schemes combining the two remain scarce. We propose a semi-global tile-based strategy in which every tile is unwrapped in the frequency domain, through the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) and the least squares (LS) formalism of Ghiglia et al., the tiles being merged spatially. Unwrapping and noise filtering are performed jointly, which regularizes an otherwise ill-posed inverse problem. An error stays confined to the tile in which it arose; the tiling artifacts are removed by averaging over every shift of the grid and over the symmetries of the square; and that average is weighted by the Poisson residual each pass leaves behind, so that a pass whose tile boundaries fell on a discontinuity does not impose its seam on the result. Experiments on synthetic and real data, against four reference algorithms from four distinct families and under six complementary metrics, show that the proposed method matches or improves on the state of the art. One of these metrics, a corrected cyclic re-wrap residual introduced here, needs no ground truth and therefore remains available on real acquisitions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种半全局分块相位解缠策略：块内用DCT与最小二乘解缠，块间空间融合，解缠与去噪联合，并通过全移位与正方形对称性平均及泊松残差加权消除拼接伪影。
AI.motivation: 二维相位解缠的难点在于区分由缠绕引起的跳变与由噪声、真实不连续、欠采样或去相关引起的跳变。空域与频域方法各有优劣，但混合方案稀缺，因此需要结合两者优势的新方法。
AI.method: 将图像划分为瓦片，每块在频域中通过离散余弦变换（DCT）和Ghiglia等人的最小二乘（LS）形式解缠；块间在空间域合并。解缠与噪声滤波联合进行，以正则化这一病态逆问题。误差被限制在产生它的瓦片内；通过对网格的所有平移以及正方形的对称性取平均来消除分块伪影；该平均值由每次遍历留下的泊松残差加权，使瓦片边界落在不连续处的遍历不会将其接缝强加于结果。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据上，与来自四个不同族的四种参考算法对比，采用六种互补指标评估，所提方法达到或优于当前最佳水平。其中一项指标为本文引入的校正循环重缠绕残差，无需地面真值，因此可用于真实采集数据。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的半全局分块混合策略有效结合频域解缠与空间融合，联合去噪，抑制误差传播与拼接伪影，在无真值场景下亦可评估，性能与现有先进方法相当或更优。

title: CVSS-X: A Multilingual Speech-to-Speech Translation Corpus for 28 Languages
comment: Accepted at the SALMA Workshop (2nd Edition) @ EMNLP 2026 (Non-archival)
summary: We introduce CVSS-X, a large-scale synthetic speech-to-speech translation corpus that extends CVSS by reversing the translation direction. While CVSS translates from 21 languages into English, CVSS-X enables translation from English into 28 target languages spanning 12 language families. The corpus comprises approximately 240,000 parallel speech pairs per language, totaling over 16,000 hours, eight times larger than CVSS. We provide two variants: CVSS-X-C with two canonical voices per language, and CVSS-X-T with cross-lingual voice cloning, both fully generated. Evaluation shows comparable translation quality to CVSS with consistent performance across typologically diverse languages. Combined with CVSS, this enables research on bidirectional and multilingual speech-to-speech translation. The code is available at https://github.com/ErmisAI/XVSS-X and the dataset under CC-BY-NC 4.0 license at https://huggingface.co/datasets/lgris/XVSS-X.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CVSS-X，一个将CVSS翻译方向反转的大规模合成语音到语音翻译语料库，支持英语翻译为28种目标语言，规模约24万对/语言、超16000小时，是CVSS的8倍。
AI.motivation: 原CVSS语料库仅支持21种语言翻译为英语（单向），缺乏从英语向多语言方向的大规模语音到语音翻译资源，限制了双向及多语言语音翻译研究。
AI.method: 通过反转CVSS的翻译方向构建CVSS-X语料库，覆盖12个语系、28种目标语言，提供两种变体：CVSS-X-C（每种语言两个标准音色）和CVSS-X-T（跨语言语音克隆），均为全合成生成。
AI.result: 语料库每语言约24万平行语音对，总计超16000小时，规模为CVSS的8倍；评估显示翻译质量与CVSS相当，并在类型学多样的语言间保持稳定性能。
AI.conclusion: CVSS-X与CVSS结合可实现双向及多语言语音到语音翻译研究；代码开源，数据集以CC-BY-NC 4.0许可发布。

title: Causal Analysis and Mitigation of Spurious Onsets in Full-Duplex Speech LLMs
summary: Speech-to-speech LLMs like Moshi, and its derivative PersonaPlex, can listen and speak concurrently through full-duplex generation. However, they can begin speaking inappropriately during prolonged user silence: under digital-zero input, Moshi and PersonaPlex initiate speech in 30% and 27.5% of five-minute continuations, respectively. What causes this spurious speech? We investigate two hypotheses: either repeated sampling selects speech despite persistently low onset probabilities, or self-conditioning on nonspeech outputs causes an abrupt spike in onset probability. We find that, at every observed onset, speech probability spikes by over nine orders of magnitude in one 80-ms frame, supporting the latter hypothesis. Then, to suppress these onsets without blocking genuine responses, we ask a causal counterfactual question: is the model responding to user speech, or would its next-token distribution remain similar if the preceding user input were muted? Accordingly, we suppress onsets whose distributions change little under this intervention. Under realistic microphone noise, our method suppresses spurious onsets, while preserving genuine responses: one-sided 95% lower confidence bounds are 98.68% and 98.82% for Moshi, and 96.90% and 99.25% for PersonaPlex. Our inference-time method runs in real-time without retraining, with 95th-percentile decision time below 61 ms, within the 80-ms frame budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/KentoNishi/icassp27-spurious-onsets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究全双工语音对话LLM（Moshi及其衍生模型PersonaPlex）在长时间用户静音时出现的"虚假起音"现象，发现其成因为自条件化导致的起音概率骤增，并提出一种无需训练的实时推断方法进行抑制。
AI.motivation: Moshi与PersonaPlex等语音到语音LLM支持全双工并发听说，但在用户长时间静音（数字零输入）时会出现不恰当发言：五分钟续写中Moshi和PersonaPlex分别有30%和27.5%的概率发起语音。这种虚假起音会破坏交互体验，因此需要弄清其成因并加以抑制，同时不能阻断真实响应。
AI.method: 作者检验两种假设：(1) 重复采样在持续低起音概率下选出语音；(2) 对非语音输出的自条件化引发起音概率突增。分析发现在每一次观测到的起音处，语音概率在单个80ms帧内跃升超过九个数量级，支持后一假设。据此提出因果反事实判据：若将前序用户输入静音，模型下一词分布变化很小，则说明该起音并非对用户语音的响应，予以抑制。该方法为推断时方法，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在真实麦克风噪声下，该方法能抑制虚假起音并保留真实响应：Moshi的单侧95%置信下界为98.68%和98.82%，PersonaPlex为96.90%和99.25%。推断方法可实时运行，95分位决策时间低于61ms，处于80ms帧预算之内。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 虚假起音源于模型对自身非语音输出的自条件化，而非低概率下的重复采样，其在单帧内表现为概率的极端突增。基于因果反事实的静音干预推断方法可有效区分虚假与真实起音，在实时约束下实现高置信度的抑制效果，为全双工语音LLM的稳健交互提供了无需训练的解决方案。

title: Hindsight Bias in Clinical Temporal Reasoning: How Future Data Exposure Affects Large Language Model Judgment
comment: Machine Learning for Health Symposium (ML4H 2026)
summary: Clinical decisions are prospective, but clinical language models are often evaluated on retrospective records that reveal the final diagnosis, treatment response, and outcome. Such evaluations may reward the use of future information rather than reasoning under the uncertainty present at the decision point. We introduce a paired benchmark for measuring outcome-conditioned shifts consistent with hindsight bias in clinical temporal reasoning. It contains 171 case reports from the PubMed Central Open Access Subset---40 sepsis and 131 GLP-1/diabetes cases---represented as both textual narratives and human-annotated and LLM-generated textual time series (TTS). For each case, questions are tied to a clinically meaningful cutoff and paired with a prospective reference answer and an outcome-consistent \emph{hindsight trap}. Models answer each question using either a TTS truncated at the cutoff or the complete timeline; additional conditions vary the narrative source (original or synthetic) and TTS annotation source (human or LLM). We evaluate accuracy (Acc), hindsight trap rate (HTR), answer instability rate (AIR), and hindsight bias rate (HBR), each of which captures different signals of hindsight bias. Across GPT 5.6 Sol, Gemma 4, GLM 5.2, and Opus 5, full timeline exposure produces consistent hindsight-sensitive shifts, while temporal masking reduces bias without lowering accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个配对基准，用于测量临床时间推理中与后见之明偏倚一致的结果条件性偏移。
AI.motivation: 临床决策本质是前瞻性的，但临床语言模型常在包含最终诊断、治疗反应和结局的回溯性病历上评估，这会奖励对未来信息的利用而非在决策时点的不确定性下推理。
AI.method: 构建含171份病例报告（40例脓毒症、131例GLP-1/糖尿病）的配对基准，来源为PubMed Central开放获取子集，以文本叙述及人工标注和LLM生成的文本时间序列（TTS）表示。每例的问题绑定临床有意义的截断点，配以前瞻性参考答案和结果一致的后见之明陷阱；模型使用截断至该时点的TTS或完整时间线作答，并额外变化叙述来源（原始或合成）与TTS标注来源（人工或LLM）。评估指标包括准确率（Acc）、后见之明陷阱率（HTR）、答案不稳定率（AIR）和后见之明偏倚率（HBR）。
AI.result: 在GPT 5.6 Sol、Gemma 4、GLM 5.2和Opus 5上，完整时间线暴露产生一致的后见之明敏感偏移，而时间遮蔽在降低偏倚的同时未降低准确率。
AI.conclusion: 临床语言模型评估应体现决策时点的不确定性，时间遮蔽可有效减少后见之明偏倚而不牺牲准确率。

title: STAGE: Diagnosing Semantic Transfer at Grounded Execution in Embodied Agents
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, 7 figures
summary: Embodied language grounding requires more than identifying the referent of an instruction: recovered semantics must also control the action an agent exposes. We study this missing link as a semantic-action gap, where instruction semantics are recoverable but weakly expressed in native continuous actions. We introduce SAT-Bench, a fixed-observation counterfactual benchmark that holds the visual scene and agent state fixed while changing only instruction semantics. On LIBERO target-name and pixel-grounded relation swaps, target recovery reaches 100.0% and 95.8%, whereas OpenVLA action sensitivity remains only 6.8% and 7.7%. The gap persists across 1,000 additional compositional and temporal/procedural counterfactuals, with overall action sensitivity of 6.1%. Hidden-state, threshold-free, cross-policy, and rollout diagnostics further support this semantic-action transfer failure. We introduce VISA, a lightweight execution-time interface that converts recovered semantics into ALLOW, DEFER, target-consistency, and verified-selection decisions. VISA reduces invalid-instruction blind execution from 92.7% to 2.8% while preserving 94.0% of normal commands, and verified selection further improves target-consistent action exposure without updating the underlying policy. Overall, embodied language evaluation should measure semantic-action transfer, not semantic parsing alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"语义-动作鸿沟"问题：指令语义可被恢复但未有效体现在连续动作中；为此构建固定观测反事实基准SAT-Bench进行量化诊断，并提出轻量执行期接口VISA将语义转化为决策以缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 具身语言 grounding 不应只关注指令指称物的识别，恢复的语义还必须能控制智能体实际执行的动作。然而现有研究多停留在语义解析层面，忽视了语义到动作的传递环节，导致评估与真实执行需求脱节。
AI.method: 提出SAT-Bench：固定视觉场景与智能体状态、仅改变指令语义的反事实基准，涵盖LIBERO目标名称与像素接地关系替换，并扩展至1000个组合及时间/过程性反事实；采用隐藏状态、无阈值、跨策略与 rollout 诊断分析语义-动作传递。提出VISA：执行期轻量接口，将恢复的语义转换为ALLOW、DEFER、目标一致性与验证选择决策，无需更新底层策略。
AI.result: 在目标名称与像素接地关系替换上，目标恢复率分别达100.0%与95.8%，而OpenVLA动作敏感度仅6.8%与7.7%；1000个额外反事实下整体动作敏感度为6.1%。VISA将无效指令盲执行从92.7%降至2.8%，同时保留94.0%的正常指令，验证选择进一步改善目标一致的动作暴露。
AI.conclusion: 具身语言评估应衡量语义-动作传递，而不仅是语义解析；语义可恢复不等于动作可控制，需在执行期引入语义驱动的决策接口。

title: A Hybrid Hierarchical 1D-CNN-BiLSTM Framework for Extractive Summarization of Biomedical and Clinical Text
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures
summary: Large language models have made abstractive summarization remarkably fluent, but generated summaries can hallucinate facts, posing serious risks in biomedical and clinical domains. We address this by removing generation from the pipeline and framing summarization as extractive sentence selection. Our Hybrid Hierarchical CNN-LSTM Summarizer uses stacked multi-kernel convolutions to compose sentence-level embeddings into richer inter-sentence representations, followed by a bidirectional LSTM to model long-range dependencies across the document. A lightweight scoring head assigns per-sentence importance scores and is trained end-to-end with binary cross-entropy against oracle extractive labels. At inference, a dynamic mean-plus-standard-deviation threshold with a top-3 fallback selects sentences directly from the source and chronologically reorders them into the final summary. Since every output sentence is copied from the input, the model avoids generation-induced factual drift. On PubMed, our architecture outperforms isolated CNN and LSTM baselines, while ablations show that wider convolutional receptive fields improve sentence scoring. On MIMIC-CXR and MIMIC-IV BHC, the model performs well on unstructured narratives but defaults toward positional baselines on highly templated reports. These results suggest that structural constraints can provide a reliable path toward factually grounded summarization systems that are trustworthy by design rather than by correction.

AI.tldr: 提出混合层次化CNN-LSTM抽取式摘要器，通过句子选择避免生成式幻觉，在PubMed上优于基线，但在高度模板化报告上退化为位置基线。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型生成的抽象式摘要虽然流畅，但存在事实幻觉，在生物医学和临床领域风险严重。作者希望通过移除生成环节，将摘要任务重新定义为抽取式句子选择，从设计层面保证事实一致性。
AI.method: 采用堆叠多核卷积将句子级嵌入组合为更丰富的句间表示，再经双向LSTM建模文档长程依赖；轻量打分头为每句分配重要性分数，使用二值交叉熵对oracle抽取标签进行端到端训练。推理时用动态"均值加标准差"阈值并配合top-3回退策略，直接从原文抽取句子并按时间顺序重排。
AI.result: 在PubMed上，该架构优于单独的CNN和LSTM基线；消融实验表明更宽的卷积感受野能改善句子打分。在MIMIC-CXR和MIMIC-IV BHC上，模型对非结构化叙述表现良好，但在高度模板化报告上退化为位置基线。
AI.conclusion: 结构约束可为事实有据的摘要系统提供可靠路径，使系统"设计上可信"而非依赖事后校正。

title: Mixture-of-Experts Language Models Can Be Strong and Efficient Retrievers
summary: Recent work has shown that fine-tuning decoder-only large language models (LLMs) for retrieval yields strong first-stage retrievers, with effectiveness improving as backbones grow in size. However, every query and document must pass through the full model, so encoding cost increases with model size. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs activate only a subset of parameters per token and are widely used to scale generative models, yet remain underexplored as retrievers. We systematically study MoE backbones for retrieval by training MoE and dense LLMs from several families using the same procedure, evaluating them across diverse datasets, and measuring query encoding time under the same serving configuration. We show that MoE retrievers outperform dense retrievers with comparable active parameter counts by up to 3.0 nDCG@10 points on BEIR. One of our strongest MoE retrievers matches an 8B dense retriever with 59% fewer active parameters and 18% lower query encoding time. We further show that the number of experts used for query encoding can be reduced without retraining or re-indexing, retaining more than 99% of retrieval effectiveness while reducing query encoding time by up to 26%. Recent rerankers provide only modest additional gains over strong MoE first stages, which often match or exceed the reranked configurations we evaluate. Together, these results show that MoE LLMs can be strong and efficient first-stage retrievers.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究将MoE LLM作为第一阶段检索器，发现MoE检索器在相同激活参数量下优于稠密检索器，且更高效。
AI.motivation: 现有基于decoder-only LLM微调的检索器效果随模型规模增大而提升，但每对query和document都需通过完整模型，编码成本随规模增加。MoE LLM每token仅激活部分参数，虽广泛用于生成模型扩展，但作为检索器尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 用相同流程训练多个系列的MoE与稠密LLM检索器，在多样化数据集上评估，并在相同服务配置下测量query编码时间；同时研究不重训、不重建索引前提下减少查询编码所用专家数。
AI.result: 在BEIR上，MoE检索器在可比激活参数量下比稠密检索器最高高3.0 nDCG@10；最强MoE检索器以少59%激活参数、低18%查询编码时间匹配8B稠密检索器；减少专家数可保留99%以上效果并将查询编码时间最多降低26%；近期reranker相对强MoE第一阶段仅带来有限增益。
AI.conclusion: MoE LLM可作为强且高效的第一阶段检索器。

title: One Spectrum, Two Resources: Data-Memory Scaling in Autoregressive Prediction
comment: 66 pages, 11 figures, 8 tables
summary: How much learned memory is needed to benefit from more data? We show that the two resources are governed by one predictive-energy spectrum in a positive-entropy autoregressive retrieval source. Each coordinate contributes its query probability times the squared radius of its unknown logit. Writing $μ$ for the resulting energy spectrum, we prove the minimax law $\mathfrak R^*_{\rm value}(n,B)\asymp_R Φ_μ(n^{-1})+Φ_μ(τ_B), Φ_μ(t)=\int\min\{x,t\}\,μ(\mathrm dx),$ for $n$ prediction blocks and a learned state with at most $2^B$ values. Data set the resolution $1/n$; memory sets the level $τ_B$ reached by optimal bit allocation. The complete curve also recovers the positive spectrum. Energy-dimension pairing is essential: two causal sources with identical block-energy and block-dimension marginals have different data and memory exponents. A masked query-key attention head learns the route and values, realizing the law with explicit routing, format, and arithmetic errors. Further results give exponent-adaptive allocation, finite-precision realization, and compute-precision laws under two-sided arithmetic assumptions. Experiments recover the data-memory collapse and coupling exponents, explain the routing and allocation mechanisms, and examine weight-only quantization across six pretrained-model scales.

AI.tldr: 在正熵自回归检索源中，数据与记忆两种资源由同一"预测能量谱"支配：最优风险满足极小极大律 R*_value(n,B) ≍ Φ_μ(n^{-1}) + Φ_μ(τ_B)，数据决定分辨率1/n，记忆决定最优比特分配达到的能级τ_B。
AI.motivation: 核心问题是：要"从更多数据中获益"，需要多少已学习的记忆？即数据规模与记忆容量（比特数）之间的权衡规律缺乏统一理论刻画。
AI.method: 构造正熵自回归检索源模型；用预测能量谱 μ 刻画每个坐标的贡献（查询概率 × 未知logit半径的平方）；对 n 个预测块、至多 2^B 个值的学得状态证明极小极大风险律；引入"能量-维度配对"分析；并用带掩码的 query-key 注意力头实现显式路由、格式与算术误差。
AI.result: 证明 R*_value(n,B) ≍_R Φ_μ(n^{-1}) + Φ_μ(τ_B)，其中 Φ_μ(t)=∫min{x,t}μ(dx)；完整曲线可恢复正谱；给出两个块能量与块维度边缘分布相同但数据/记忆指数不同的因果源，说明能量-维度配对不可或缺；进一步得到指数自适应分配、有限精度实现及双侧算术假设下的计算-精度律；实验复现数据-记忆塌缩与耦合指数，解释路由与分配机制，并在六种预训练模型规模上考察仅权重量化。
AI.conclusion: 数据与记忆并非可相互替代的独立资源，而是由同一预测能量谱统一支配：数据设定分辨率，记忆设定可达能级，二者通过最优比特分配耦合，且必须同时考虑能量与维度。

title: RIGOR: Rig-Informed Geometry for Omnidirectional Reconstruction
summary: Recent developments in feed-forward 3D reconstruction resulted in models which can recover dense scene representations and camera motion solely from an image stream. However, such predictions are prone to becoming inconsistent over long trajectories, specifically in demanding environments with repetitive structures, weak textures and dynamic objects or people. One way to mitigate those challenges is to use an omnidirectional camera, which provides wide spatial coverage and captures richer visual information. Yet, the majority of models do not offer support for 360-degree imagery or require additional fine-tuning. To bridge these two aspects, we present RIGOR: a large-scale reconstruction pipeline for gravity-aligned omnidirectional videos that retains a frozen feed-forward perspective backbone and exploits each panorama as a four-view virtual rig. The rig structure is used to detect and repair locally inconsistent predictions, to retrieve loop closures through cyclic four-view consensus, and to geometrically verify candidate revisits before global optimization. Verified constraints drive a Sim(3) pose graph that corrects accumulated rotation, translation, and scale drift along the sequence. We demonstrate that the proposed consistency mechanisms improve both trajectory accuracy and reconstructed geometry over a feed-forward baseline on challenging construction-site sequences. The code is made available under this link: https://github.com/TangentH/RIGOR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RIGOR：面向重力对齐全景视频的大规模重建流程，冻结前馈透视骨干网络，将每张全景图视为四视图虚拟刚体，用于检测与修复局部不一致、检索回环并几何验证重访约束，最终驱动 Sim(3) 位姿图优化，修正累积漂移。
AI.motivation: 前馈三维重建虽能仅凭图像流恢复稠密场景与相机运动，但在长轨迹及重复结构、弱纹理、动态物体等困难环境下预测易不一致。全景相机具宽覆盖与更丰富视觉信息，但多数模型不支持360度图像或需额外微调。
AI.method: 保留冻结的前馈透视骨干网络；将每张全景图构建为四视图虚拟刚体；利用该刚体结构检测并修复局部不一致预测；通过循环四视图一致性检索回环；对候选重访进行几何验证；以验证后的约束构建 Sim(3) 位姿图。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的建筑工地序列上，所提一致性机制相对前馈基线同时提升了轨迹精度与重建几何质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过全景四视图虚拟刚体与一致性约束驱动 Sim(3) 位姿图优化，可在不微调骨干网络的前提下有效缓解长轨迹漂移，提升全景视频重建的轨迹与几何精度，代码已开源。

title: From Token Probabilities to Semantic Constraints: Towards Declarative Probabilistic Evaluation of Language Models
summary: While Large Language Models have improved rapidly, many fundamental questions remain about how to evaluate the knowledge and reasoning abilities they acquire, and how such evaluations relate to the learning signals used in pre-training. In this paper, we propose ModelLog, a declarative probabilistic framework for pre-training evaluation that makes the semantic structure of model behavior explicit and provides new formal tools for relating evaluation to learning. ModelLog specifies evaluation targets as symbolic constraints over token-level predictions and measures how strongly a model's distribution satisfies those constraints. We explore the framework through a new suite of tasks targeting negation, mutual exclusivity, and consistency, finding systematic failures that are difficult to characterize through token likelihood or answer accuracy alone. We further show that these evaluation scores can also be interpreted as losses, whose gradients reflect logical strength, informativeness, and variable-level sensitivity. This links evaluation and learning through a shared semantics, suggesting evaluation methods that diagnose model behavior while also helping to clarify the semantic structure of learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ModelLog，一个面向预训练评估的声明式概率框架，将语义结构显式化，统一评估与学习信号。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型快速进步，但如何评估其获得的知识与推理能力、以及这些评估与预训练学习信号如何关联，仍是未解的基础问题。
AI.method: ModelLog 将评估目标指定为对词元级预测的符号约束，衡量模型分布满足这些约束的强度；并用一套针对否定、互斥性和一致性的新任务套件进行探索。
AI.result: 发现仅靠词元似然或答案准确率难以刻画的系统性失败；评估分数可解释为损失，其梯度反映逻辑强度、信息量和变量级敏感度。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享语义将评估与学习联系起来，提出既能诊断模型行为、又有助于厘清学习语义结构的评估方法。

title: Generative Interpretability via Scalable Neuro-Symbolic Models
comment: ACM AI Summit 2026
summary: As the use of Large Language Models moves from chatbots into agentic systems, where outputs become actions with irreversible consequences on reality, the existing paradigm on AI Interpretability research, post-hoc interpretability, is structurally inadequate for safe and trustworthy model deployment: it explains behavior after the fact but cannot audit or intervene in an inference computation before it commits to an output. We therefore argue for a shift toward \emph{generative interpretability}, an architectural property under which a model's inference pass natively exposes semantically meaningful checkpoints that are human-understandable and amenable to causal intervention. We show the merits of generative interpretability as comparison to other interpretability research paradigms, and propose Neuro-Symbolic Models as a concrete instantiation.

AI.tldr: 本文主张从"事后可解释性"转向"生成式可解释性"——一种模型推理过程原生暴露语义化检查点、可支持因果干预的架构属性，并提出神经符号模型作为具体实现途径。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型从聊天机器人走向智能体系统，其输出转化为对现实具有不可逆后果的动作，而主流的事后可解释性范式只能在事实发生之后解释行为，无法在推理计算提交输出之前进行审计或干预，因而在结构上不足以支撑安全可信的模型部署。
AI.method: 本文属于立场/观点性研究，采用范式对比与论证分析的方法：将生成式可解释性与其他可解释性研究范式进行比较，论证其优势，并提出神经符号模型（Neuro-Symbolic Models）作为该范式的具体实例化方案。
AI.result: 通过范式间的对比分析，论证了生成式可解释性在推理过程中提供人类可理解、可因果干预的语义检查点方面的优势，并表明神经符号模型能够作为其可行的具体实现。
AI.conclusion: 在智能体化部署背景下，事后可解释性存在结构性不足，应推动可解释性研究向生成式可解释性转变，并将神经符号模型作为该方向的具体落地路径。

title: Harmfulness Propagation Dynamics: Layer-wise Trajectories of Adversarial Intent in Large Language Models
comment: International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) Workshop on Mechanistic Interpretability in 2026, accepted in South Korea. https://openreview.net/pdf?id=SGnAkwZ3VV
summary: We identify \textbf{Harmfulness Propagation Dynamics (HPD)}: for harmful prompts, the projection of the last-token hidden state onto a learned harm direction rises monotonically with transformer depth, whereas benign prompts remain flat or oscillatory. This cross-layer signature reflects harmful intent as a \emph{progressively resolved} semantic property: surface form appears early, while pragmatic intent consolidates later, making the \emph{trajectory shape} more informative than any single-layer snapshot. Moreover, LDA-based harm directions, learned per layer, remain stable across random splits (pairwise cosine similarity $>0.97$), supporting the projection sequence as a reproducible structured signal. Building on HPD, we introduce \textbf{\herald{}} (\textbf{H}armful \textbf{E}ncoding \textbf{R}ecognition via \textbf{A}ctivation \textbf{L}ayer \textbf{D}ynamics). This lightweight input moderator extracts a seven-dimensional feature record, slope, curvature, monotonicity, onset layer, and related statistics from the cross-layer projection sequence and classifies it with a 288-parameter MLP. \herald{} stores one $d$-dimensional direction per layer ($262$\,KB for a 32-layer, $d{=}4096$ model), requires no gradient computation during training, and adds only $2.6{\times}10^{-6}$ prefill FLOPs at inference. Across eight prompt-harmfulness benchmarks and four model families, \herald{} achieves an average F1 of $89.3$ on OLMo2-7B, surpassing all tested guard models on adversarial jailbreak detection ($98.4$ vs.\ $96.9$ F1) and outperforming prior latent-based methods by $2.3$-$4.1$ F1 points on every backbone. Per-instance trajectories provide machine-readable audit records that reveal \emph{when} and \emph{how} harmfulness emerges, offering an interpretability advantage over single-layer approaches.

AI.tldr: 论文发现有害提示的隐状态在Transformer各层的投影随深度单调上升（良性提示则平坦或振荡），提出HPD现象并据此设计轻量级输入审核器HERALD，用跨层投影序列的七维特征配合288参数MLP分类，在八个基准与四个模型族上取得领先F1，且开销极低并提供可解释的审计记录。
AI.motivation: 现有提示有害性检测多依赖单层隐状态快照或生成式防御，忽略了有害意图在Transformer深度上逐步语义解析的动态特性；单层表示无法刻画意图的"涌现时机"与"轨迹形状"，且现有潜空间方法在对抗越狱检测上仍有提升空间，同时需要兼顾推理开销与可解释性。
AI.method: 首先识别HPD现象：将最后一token隐状态投影到逐层学习的伤害方向，发现有害提示投影随深度单调上升，良性提示平坦或振荡，且基于LDA学习的逐层方向在随机划分下稳定（两两余弦相似度>0.97）。据此提出HERALD审核器：从跨层投影序列提取斜率、曲率、单调性、起始层等七维特征，输入288参数MLP分类；每层存储一个d维方向（32层、d=4096约262KB），训练无需梯度计算，推理仅增加2.6e-6倍prefill FLOPs。
AI.result: 在八个提示有害性基准和四个模型族上，HERALD在OLMo2-7B上平均F1达89.3；对抗越狱检测F1为98.4，超过所有被测guard模型（最优96.9）；在每个backbone上比先前的潜空间方法高出2.3–4.1 F1。
AI.conclusion: 跨层投影轨迹形状比单层快照更具判别力，HERALD以极低存储与计算开销实现领先检测性能；逐实例轨迹提供机器可读的审计记录，能揭示有害性在何时与如何涌现，相较单层方法具有可解释性优势。

title: Towards Practical Precision Agriculture: Real-Time Fruit Detection and Video Analytics on Embedded Edge Hardware
summary: Static-image benchmarks do not capture the computational and temporal requirements of practical orchard video analytics. This study presents an end-to-end framework for real-time fruit detection, tracking, and counting on the NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super. A lightweight YOLO26s detector is trained independently on four public datasets representing apples, mangoes, blueberries, and strawberries under a common protocol. The models are deployed on embedded platform using PyTorch and TensorRT at FP32, FP16, and INT8 precision. APPLE MOTS is then used for temporal video analytics because it provides orchard sequences with persistent fruit identities, enabling evaluation of multi-object tracking and unique-fruit counting. The selected FP16 TensorRT detector is integrated into an NVIDIA DeepStream pipeline combining hardware-accelerated decoding, ByteTrack tracking, and motion-aware line-crossing analytics. Across the four detection tasks, mean test mAP@50:95 ranges from 0.4957 to 0.8656. On the Jetson, TensorRT FP16 achieves 66.76-74.56 images/s at 13.41-14.98 ms prediction latency, while reducing mAP@50:95 by only 0.0020-0.0054 and gross energy consumption by approximately 64-66% relative to PyTorch FP32. The complete detector-tracker-analytics pipeline reaches 44.96-54.11 FPS and sustains the configured 30-FPS input rate without output-frame loss. On held-out orchard video sequences, HOTA ranges from 0.345 to 0.538, event-level counting F1 from 0.611 to 0.803, and relative count error from 6.2% to 51.6%. Performance varies across acquisition geometries: near-lateral row viewing yields the most stable tracking and counting, whereas forward traversal remains association- and recall-limited despite spatially adaptive counting geometry. These results show that practical edge-based fruit monitoring requires efficient detection and acquisition geometries that support reliable temporal association.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了面向果园视频分析的端到端实时果实检测、跟踪与计数框架，在 Jetson Orin Nano Super 上通过 YOLO26s + TensorRT/DeepStream 实现边缘部署，并揭示采集几何对时序关联可靠性的关键影响。
AI.motivation: 静态图像基准无法反映实际果园视频分析在计算与时序上的需求；实际边缘部署需同时满足实时性、低能耗与可靠的时序关联（跟踪与计数），而现有研究缺乏统一的跨数据集检测协议与端到端视频级评测。
AI.method: 在统一协议下，用四个公开数据集（苹果、芒果、蓝莓、草莓）独立训练轻量 YOLO26s 检测器；在嵌入式平台以 PyTorch 与 TensorRT 的 FP32/FP16/INT8 精度部署；采用 Apple MOTS 果园序列（含持续果实身份）评测多目标跟踪与唯一果实计数；将选定 FP16 TensorRT 检测器接入 NVIDIA DeepStream 流水线，结合硬件加速解码、ByteTrack 跟踪与运动感知越线计数。
AI.result: 四类检测任务测试集 mAP@50:95 为 0.4957–0.8656；Jetson 上 TensorRT FP16 达 66.76–74.56 images/s、预测延迟 13.41–14.98 ms，相比 PyTorch FP32 仅下降 mAP@50:95 0.0020–0.0054，总能耗降低约 64–66%；完整检测-跟踪-分析流水线达 44.96–54.11 FPS，可稳定维持 30 FPS 输入且无输出丢帧。在留出果园视频序列上，HOTA 为 0.345–0.538，事件级计数 F1 为 0.611–0.803，相对计数误差 6.2%–51.6%。近侧向行视角跟踪与计数最稳定；前行穿越视角受关联与召回限制，即使采用空间自适应计数几何仍表现受限。
AI.conclusion: 实用的边缘果实监测不仅依赖高效检测，还要求采集几何能够支撑可靠的时序关联；FP16 TensorRT + DeepStream 是在边缘实现实时且低能耗果园视频分析的有效方案，而不同视角下的跟踪与计数性能差异显著。

title: Domain-Specific Jargon in Large Language Models: A Comparative Analysis between General-Purpose and Specialist Models
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 main conference
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable proficiency on general-purpose tasks, yet their performance often degrades in highly-specialized technical domains. Moreover, little is known about how parametric knowledge of domain-specific terms is encoded within these models. We address this gap by contributing two novel medical jargon evaluation benchmarks and evaluate a general-purpose Llama-3.1 model against a variant fine-tuned on medical-domain data. Surprisingly, the general-purpose model outperforms the medically fine-tuned model on both tasks. Using mechanistic interpretability tools, we find systematic patterns of miscalibration for the medically fine-tuned model. Instead of reorganizing parametric knowledge, the fine-tuned model places greater emphasis on a small subset of model components associated with jargon-favoring predictions. We find that applying component reweighting strategies against the benchmark tasks successfully suppresses these components and closes the gap with the general-purpose baseline. We also observe that some jargon-sensitive components transfer knowledge to the same tasks involving materials science jargon, suggesting they encode a partially domain-agnostic notion of specialized terminology. Our results provide a case study in which a medically fine-tuned checkpoint does not improve jargon comprehension over its general-purpose counterpart, highlighting that domain adaptation should not be assumed to yield better performance on specialized terminology.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建两个医学行话评测基准，发现通用Llama-3.1在行话理解上优于医学微调版本，并利用机制可解释性工具揭示微调模型的系统性误校准。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在通用任务上表现优异，但在高度专业的技术领域性能常出现退化；同时，领域专业术语的参数化知识如何在这些模型中被编码仍不清楚，尤其是领域微调是否真正改善专业术语理解缺乏实证。
AI.method: 提出两个新的医学行话评测基准；对比通用Llama-3.1与其医学领域数据微调变体；采用机制可解释性工具分析参数化知识的编码与模型组件的贡献，并施加组件重加权策略进行干预验证，同时测试其向材料科学行话任务的迁移性。
AI.result: 通用模型在两个任务上均优于医学微调模型；医学微调模型表现出系统性误校准，并未重组参数化知识，而是更依赖与"偏好行话预测"相关的一小部分模型组件；组件重加权可抑制这些组件并缩小与通用基线的差距；部分行话敏感组件可迁移至材料科学行话任务，表明其编码了部分领域无关的专业术语概念。
AI.conclusion: 医学微调检查点并未提升行话理解能力，反而低于其通用对应版本，说明领域适配不应被默认视为能带来更好的专业术语表现；机制可解释性方法可定位并修正此类误校准。

title: How User-AI Mistreatment Occurs and Matters in Conversational Systems?
comment: Accepted by the 10th Workshop on Online Abuse and Harms (WOAH 2026) at EMNLP 2026
summary: Safety research often focuses on model-generated harms, but users may also direct hostility, coercion, and adversarial pressure at models. Understanding how and when that occurs is essential for accurately interpreting model behaviour, alignment drift, and real-world deployment risks. In this paper, we audit 777K English LMSYS-Chat-1M conversations with two independent detectors: an eight-category lexicon for hostility directed at the model, and the dataset's moderation signal; and show that they capture different, weakly overlapping phenomena. The lexicon identifies insults, threats, and jailbreak coercion aimed at the assistant, while moderation flags are dominated by toxic-content solicitation rather than hostility at the model. Together, they mark about 5% of user turns; adjusting the narrower lexicon-harassment union for measured precision puts mistreatment aimed at the assistant at 0.90%. These absolute rates describe arena-style evaluation traffic and should not be read as deployment-wide base rates. We find that user hostility varies 13-fold across models, driven largely by who each model attracts rather than by model behaviour: first-turn hostility spreads far wider than post-response hostility, and more than fifteenfold separates the extremes even after deduplicating opening prompts. Within conversations, assistant apologies are consistently associated with higher odds of next-turn hostility under both detectors; the effect survives restricting to non-refused prior turns and to jailbreak-free conversations, and is positive in 20 of 23 models. Yet across models, more apologetic models receive less hostility overall. Finally, hostility also shows temporal structure, with coercive openings front-loading the first turn while affective hostility accumulates over a session. We release the lexicon, the detector cross-validation pipeline, and all derived tables.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了777K条LMSYS-Chat-1M英文对话，用两套独立检测器区分"针对模型的敌意"与"毒性内容索取"，发现二者仅弱重叠：词典法标记敌意/越狱胁迫，审核信号主要标记毒性内容索取。约5%的用户轮次被任一检测器标出，经精度校正后针对助手的虐待率为0.90%。
AI.motivation: 安全研究多关注模型生成的危害，却忽视用户对模型的敌意、胁迫与对抗性施压。理解这类行为发生的方式与时机，对准确解读模型行为、对齐漂移及真实部署风险至关重要。
AI.method: 构建八类词典检测器（针对模型的敌意）并与数据集自带moderation信号交叉验证；对777K英文对话做双检测器审计；按模型、轮次（首轮/回复后）、对话内顺序分层统计；以道歉-下一轮敌意关联做对话内分析，并在排除拒绝轮次与越狱对话后做稳健性检验（23个模型中20个方向为正）。
AI.result: 两检测器捕获的现象不同且弱重叠；合计标记约5%用户轮次，词典-骚扰并集经精度校正后针对助手的虐待为0.90%；模型间用户敌意差异达13倍，主要由模型吸引的用户群体决定而非模型行为；首轮敌意分布远大于回复后敌意，去重开场提示后极值仍相差15倍以上；助手道歉与下一轮敌意升高稳定相关；跨模型看，更常道歉的模型反而总体收到更少敌意；敌意具时间结构，胁迫性开场集中于首轮，情感性敌意随会话累积。
AI.conclusion: 针对模型的用户虐待是低基数（约0.90%）但结构清晰的现象，需与"毒性内容索取"区分测量；其模型间差异主要源于用户自选择，而非模型回应策略；道歉与后续敌意的正相关提示礼貌回应可能存在反效果风险。绝对比率仅描述竞技场式评测流量，不代表部署基线率。作者公开词典、检测器交叉验证流程及全部衍生表格。

title: Toward Complete Hospital Discharge Summarization with Abstract Meaning Representation
comment: Published in the 2026 IEEE 14th International Conference on Healthcare Informatics (ICHI). 10 pages, 6 figures
summary: Discharge summaries are lengthy medical documents that summarize a hospital in-patient visit. Automatically generating them can reduce documentation burden and return clinician time to patient care. Whereas Large Language Model (LLMs) could be used for this task, their Achilles heel is hallucinations, which can have drastic consequences for clinical documentation. We present an evidence-driven alignment framework for discharge summarization at the clinical encounter level, that treats provenance as a first-class constraint, using semantic graphs and deep learning models. Each summary sentence is selected and organized via cross-document semantic alignment and is accompanied by explicit evidence links to its source spans. We show our results on two corpora: a publicly available corpus (MIMIC-III) and clinical notes written by physicians at the University of Illinois Hospital (UIC Health). Additionally, we make source code and trained models available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种以证据为驱动的出院小结生成对齐框架，将溯源作为首要约束，利用语义图与深度学习模型实现跨文档语义对齐，为每句摘要选择并组织内容，并附上指向原始文本片段的显式证据链接，从而降低大语言模型的幻觉风险。
AI.motivation: 出院小结篇幅长、撰写负担重，自动生成可减轻文档负担并将医生时间还给患者护理。尽管大语言模型可胜任该任务，但其"阿喀琉斯之踵"是幻觉，在临床文档场景中后果严重，因此需要一种能保证内容溯源与证据支持的生成方法。
AI.method: 提出证据驱动的对齐框架，在临床就诊层面进行出院小结生成；将溯源视为一等约束，采用语义图与深度学习模型，通过跨文档语义对齐来选择和组织每一句摘要，并为每句附上指向其来源文本片段的显式证据链接。
AI.result: 在两个语料上展示了实验结果：公开语料库 MIMIC-III，以及伊利诺伊大学医院（UIC Health）医生撰写的临床笔记。此外，作者公开了源代码和训练好的模型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明以证据链接和跨文档语义对齐为核心的对齐框架可用于出院小结生成，在缓解幻觉的同时提供可追溯的证据支撑，并在公开与真实临床语料上验证了有效性，同时开放资源以促进后续研究。

title: Same Patient, Different Order: Action-Level Reliability of Clinical LLM Agents Under Repeated Runs
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Code, run records and the rerun harness: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/clinical-agent-action-reliability ; github: https://github.com/rohithreddybc/clinical-agent-action-reliability
summary: A clinical agent benchmark can report the same verdict on identical inputs while the agent files a materially different order on each run. Such agents order tests, request medications and place referrals, yet benchmarks typically score one run per task and rarely ask whether identical inputs produce identical actions; MedAgentBench, the benchmark we use, scores a single attempt and says so. To measure this gap we introduce "same-input rerun", which replays a task with every input held fixed and compares the orders rather than the score, with six reliability metrics, and apply it to 1000 MedAgentBench runs across 50 tasks from its five write-capable families, two open-weight models below ten billion parameters quantised to four bits, and two temperatures. The study establishes that action-level divergence exists and can pass unrecorded by the score, not that any rate generalises. Under the 8B model at temperature 0.7, all 43 ordering groups emit a different set of orders across five identical runs, 26 emit the order on some runs and not others, and 28 record a different coded value, dose or analyte. In 22 of those 43 the benchmark reports the same failing verdict for materially different behaviour, as it does for all 10 divergent groups of the 4B model at 0.7. Orders also reach different endpoints across runs, one of which the record server rejects while the agent is told it succeeded. These findings motivate repeated-run evaluation, action-level stability reporting and execution-faithful environment feedback in clinical-agent benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"同输入重跑"（same-input rerun）方法，在输入完全固定的条件下重复执行临床智能体任务并比较其生成的医嘱而非评分，配合六项可靠性指标。对MedAgentBench中50个任务、1000次运行（两个<10B量化模型、两个温度）的测试表明：动作层面的分歧真实存在，且常被评分掩盖。
AI.motivation: 临床智能体基准通常只对每个任务单次运行评分，极少检验相同输入是否产生相同动作；MedAgentBench即只计一次尝试。这导致智能体在相同输入下可能生成实质不同的医嘱，却报告相同结论，评分无法反映动作层面的不稳定性，而这类动作直接涉及开检查、开药和转诊。
AI.method: 提出"same-input rerun"：在保持所有输入不变的情况下重放任务，比较各次运行生成的医嘱（orders）而非分数，并设计六项可靠性指标。实验覆盖MedAgentBench的50个任务（来自五个可写大类）、共1000次运行，使用两个参数量低于100亿、4比特量化的开放权重模型，并在两个温度下测试。
AI.result: 8B模型在温度0.7下，全部43个开单组在五次相同运行中产生不同的医嘱集合，26组在某些运行中开单而其他运行不开单，28组记录了不同的编码值、剂量或分析物；其中22组的基准对不同行为给出相同的失败判定。4B模型在0.7温度下的10个分歧组也全部如此。此外，医嘱在不同运行中到达不同终点，其中一种被记录服务器拒绝，但智能体被告知成功。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了动作层面的分歧确实存在且可逃过评分的记录，但不对任何比率的泛化性作断言。这些发现支持在临床智能体基准中引入重复运行评估、动作级稳定性报告以及忠实反映执行结果的环境反馈。

title: From Vision to Harvest: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Multi-Arm Robotic Fruit Harvesting
summary: Multi-arm robotic harvesting offers a promising path to improve harvesting efficiency and reduce reliance on manual labor. However, practical deployment remains challenging because the system must generalize across diverse environments while efficiently coordinating multiple arms in a shared workspace. Existing methods often require substantial data collection in target environments or rely on simplifying assumptions that limit planning quality. In this work, we introduce the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on zero-shot multi-arm fruit harvesting planning. Our benchmark uses real-world apple and citrus orchard images and compares a VLM-based planning pipeline with a traditional perception-and-planning pipeline. The VLM pipeline directly generates harvesting sequences and waypoints for each arm, while a lightweight trajectory verifier checks for collisions. Our results show that frontier VLMs can generate effective multi-arm harvesting plans zero-shot, but a practical deployment remains limited by accurate 3D waypoint generation and collision-aware coordination. These results highlight both the promise and current limitations of pretrained VLMs for multi-arm robotic harvesting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个评估预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）在零样本多臂水果采摘规划中表现的综合性基准，基于真实苹果与柑橘果园图像，将VLM规划流程与传统感知-规划流程进行对比。
AI.motivation: 多臂机器人采摘有望提升采摘效率并降低对人工的依赖，但实际部署困难：系统既需跨多样环境泛化，又需在共享工作空间内高效协调多臂。现有方法通常需在目标环境中大量采集数据，或依赖简化假设而限制规划质量。
AI.method: 构建首个面向零样本多臂水果采摘规划的VLM评测基准，使用真实苹果与柑橘果园图像，对比VLM规划流程与传统感知-规划流程。VLM流程直接为每条机械臂生成采摘序列与路点，并由轻量级轨迹验证器进行碰撞检测。
AI.result: 前沿VLM能够零样本生成有效的多臂采摘规划，但实际部署仍受限于精确的3D路点生成与具备碰撞感知的协调能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果同时体现了预训练VLM在多臂机器人采摘中的潜力与当前局限。

title: In the Blind: Building Pseudo-References for MT Evaluation
comment: Accepted at Eleventh Conference on Machine Translation (WMT) @ EMNLP 2026
summary: The WMT26 General MT task evaluates systems on 10 language pairs that have no human references (neither translated from scratch nor post-edited from MT output by humans). We describe how we built the pseudo-references for these pairs and six other language pairs (in which some forms of human references are available): seven models translate the 3,277 official documents under up to five prompt conditions, giving a total of 26 system-prompt combinations; then three reference-free quality estimation (QE) models score every candidate; and a per-document selector picks one translation, which GPT-5.5 post-edits where needed. Working without references exposed a failure mode of QE-guided selection: the metrics rank fluent output in the wrong language above correct translations. Adding a confidence-scaled language identification penalty to the score fusion drives the wrong-language count to zero, and the resulting selector still scores better on MetricX than the rank-fusion baseline it replaces. Since no references were available for these pairs while we were building them, we calibrate every selection decision on last year's WMT25 human judgments. The human evaluation, released after construction, shows the cost of getting selection wrong: our references stand with the strongest participating systems when the selector kept a frontier-model candidate, and fall up to 17 ESA points below them when it did not. We release the selection method and the provenance of every reference (https://github.com/surrey-nlp/PseudoRef)

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 WMT26 通用机器翻译任务中无人工参考译文语言对的伪参考构建流程：七种模型在至多五种提示条件下翻译 3,277 篇官方文档，生成 26 种系统-提示组合，经三种无参考质量估计（QE）模型打分，再由逐文档选择器择优，并在需要时由 GPT-5.5 进行后编辑。
AI.motivation: WMT26 通用机器翻译任务涉及 10 个无人工参考的语言对，既没有从零人工翻译，也没有人工后编辑的译文，因此无法直接使用传统依赖参考的评价与选择方法，需要构建伪参考并解决无参考条件下的候选选择问题。
AI.method: 对 10 个无参考语言对及 6 个具备部分人工参考的语言对，使用七种模型在至多五种提示条件下翻译 3,277 篇官方文档，共形成 26 种系统-提示组合；用三个无参考 QE 模型对每个候选打分；逐文档选择器依据融合分数选定一个译文，必要时由 GPT-5.5 后编辑。针对 QE 引导选择将目标语言错误但流畅的输出排在正确译文之上的失效模式，在分数融合中加入按置信度缩放的语言识别惩罚项。由于构建期间无参考可用，所有选择决策均在 WMT25 人工评判数据上校准。
AI.result: 加入置信度缩放的语言识别惩罚后，错误语言计数降至零，且所得选择器在 MetricX 上的表现仍优于其所替代的排名融合基线。构建完成后发布的人工评估显示：当选择器保留了前沿模型候选时，本文伪参考与最强参赛系统相当；当未保留时，最多落后 17 个 ESA 分。
AI.conclusion: 无参考条件下的 QE 引导选择存在跨语言流畅性误导的失效模式，通过引入置信度缩放的语言识别惩罚可有效消除错误语言输出并提升选择质量；选择正确与否对伪参考质量影响显著，最多可达 17 个 ESA 分。作者公开了选择方法及每个参考的来源（https://github.com/surrey-nlp/PseudoRef）。
